items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.tier_cd, SUM(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate AS T3 ON T2.currency_cd = T3.currency_cd AND T2.ord_dt = T3.eff_dt WHERE T1.region_cd = 'NA' AND T1.is_actv = 1 AND T2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T2.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, T1.tier_cd HAVING SUM(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) > 1000.00 ORDER BY SUM(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) DESC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Show the event type and the count of website events for each event type that occurred via the APP channel between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, evt_type ASC

items.question: For each customer segment in the month of July 2026, show the segment code and the count of unique customers.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) DESC, segment_cd ASC

items.question: Show the year-month and the count of purchase events recorded on the web channel for each month from November 2025 to February 2026.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m'), COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2026-02-28 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ASC

items.question: Show the promotion name and the total order revenue generated by orders using promotions that started in November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt * T4.rate_to_usd) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id JOIN fx_rate AS T4 ON T3.currency_cd = T4.currency_cd AND T3.ord_dt = T4.eff_dt WHERE T1.starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T1.starts_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY T1.promo_id, T1.promo_nm ORDER BY SUM(T3.ord_total_amt * T4.rate_to_usd) DESC, T1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: List each customer segment code and the average signup duration in days for customers in that segment as of 2026-08-01.
items.sql: SELECT T1.segment_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF('2026-08-01', T2.signup_dt)) FROM cust_segment_hist AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.month_dt = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY T1.segment_cd ORDER BY AVG(DATEDIFF('2026-08-01', T2.signup_dt)) DESC, T1.segment_cd ASC

items.question: Show the session ID and the count of events for sessions that had more than 3 clickstream events on 2025-11-09.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-09 23:59:59' GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer loyalty tier code and the count of customers who signed up during the third quarter of 2022 (2022-07-01 to 2022-09-30).
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-09-30' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, tier_cd ASC

items.question: For orders placed in 2026-04, list the order status and the total order total amount grouped by order status.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, ord_status ASC

items.question: Show the month start date and the number of distinct customers who were in the VIP segment for each month from June 2026 to October 2026.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-10-01' GROUP BY month_dt ORDER BY month_dt ASC

items.question: List the promotion code and the number of distinct orders that applied each promotion during the period from 2025-11-01 to 2026-01-31.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T3.ord_dt <= '2026-01-31' GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ord_id) DESC, T1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: Show the channel code and the total order amount for all orders placed through the store or app channels during May 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd IN ('STR', 'APP') AND ord_dt >= '2026-05-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: For each month between 2025-11-01 and 2026-03-31, display the month and the total count of cart addition events on the web channel.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m-01'), COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'CART' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2026-03-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m-01') ASC

items.question: Show the customer region code and the count of customers who are active and belong to the platinum tier.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, region_cd ASC

items.question: List the promotion name and its discount percentage for promotions that are valid throughout the entire month of January 2026.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2026-01-01' AND ends_dt >= '2026-01-31' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID and the count of distinct months each customer appeared in the RISK segment during the year 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'RISK' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT month_dt) DESC, cust_id ASC

items.question: For orders placed in July 2026, show the currency code and the average order total amount for each currency.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY AVG(ord_total_amt) DESC, currency_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and the total number of times each promotion was applied to orders where the order date falls between its start and end dates.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt >= T1.starts_dt AND T3.ord_dt <= T1.ends_dt GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY COUNT(T2.ord_id) DESC, T1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the month start date and the count of active customers who transitioned to the NEW segment in that month for all months in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'NEW' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY month_dt ORDER BY month_dt ASC

items.question: Show the customer name and the total count of web view events for customers who logged in and viewed products during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT T2.cust_nm, COUNT(*) FROM web_event AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND T1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T1.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T1.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY T2.cust_id, T2.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, T2.cust_nm ASC

items.question: For each loyalty tier, show the tier code and the maximum order total amount converted to USD for orders placed in the first quarter of 2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31).
items.sql: SELECT T1.tier_cd, MAX(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate AS T3 ON T2.currency_cd = T3.currency_cd AND T2.ord_dt = T3.eff_dt WHERE T2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T2.ord_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY T1.tier_cd ORDER BY MAX(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) DESC, T1.tier_cd ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for items in category HOM that have a list price over 50 USD, ordered by list price descending and then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for facilities located in the NA sales region, sorted by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: What are the supplier name and lead days for products supplied by supplier 1, sorted by lead days ascending and then product SKU?
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, T2.lead_days FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.sup_id = 1 ORDER BY T2.lead_days ASC, T2.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and total on-hand quantity across all warehouses for items in category ELC, ordered by total inventory descending and SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY T1.sku ORDER BY SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: For inventory in warehouse W1, calculate the sum of on-hand quantities and the sum of reorder points grouped by product category from the catalog, ordered by category code.
items.sql: SELECT T1.categ_cd, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty), SUM(T2.reorder_pt) FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.wh_id = 'W1' GROUP BY T1.categ_cd ORDER BY T1.categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the SKU, product name, and primary supplier name for products where the catalog list price exceeds 100 USD, sorted by list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T3.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku INNER JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T1.list_prc > 100.00 AND T2.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY T1.list_prc DESC;

items.question: For each month in Q4 2025 (from 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31), report the month start date, movement type, and total absolute movement quantity for IN and OUT movements, ordered by month and movement type.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth, mv_type, SUM(ABS(qty)) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' AND mv_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m-01'), mv_type ORDER BY mth ASC, mv_type ASC;

items.question: Compare the total units moved via OUT stock movements between October 2025 ('2025-10-01' to '2025-10-31') and November 2025 ('2025-11-01' to '2025-11-30'). Show the period start date and total units removed (expressed as a positive sum), ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m-01') AS period_start, SUM(-qty) AS total_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND ((mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59') OR (mv_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59')) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY period_start ASC;

items.question: Provide a weekly breakdown for October 2025 (defined as weeks starting 2025-10-01, 2025-10-08, 2025-10-15, 2025-10-22) showing the week start date, warehouse ID, and total stock movement quantity, ordered by week start date and warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN mv_ts < '2025-10-08 00:00:00' THEN '2025-10-01' WHEN mv_ts < '2025-10-15 00:00:00' THEN '2025-10-08' WHEN mv_ts < '2025-10-22 00:00:00' THEN '2025-10-15' ELSE '2025-10-22' END AS week_start, wh_id, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts < '2025-10-29 00:00:00' GROUP BY week_start, wh_id ORDER BY week_start ASC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and total units ordered across all order lines for each product in category KIT, ordered by total units descending and SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, SUM(T2.qty) FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY T1.sku, T1.prod_nm ORDER BY SUM(T2.qty) DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for items where current stock is at or below the reorder point, sorted by warehouse ID and SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY wh_id ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: For each supplier, report the supplier ID, supplier name, and the count of products they provide, ordered by product count descending and supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY COUNT(T2.sku) DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Calculate the year-over-year monthly stock movement totals for OUT movements comparing October 2025 and October 2026. Show year-month string and total units moved out, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS yr_mth, SUM(-qty) AS total_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND ((mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59') OR (mv_ts >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2026-10-31 23:59:59')) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY yr_mth ASC;

items.question: Provide a monthly aggregation for Q4 2025 (October, November, December 2025) of total order line quantities for products in the ELC category. Show month start date and total quantity, sorted by month start date.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(T1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth, SUM(T2.qty) FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND T1.ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(T1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Analyze trailing 30-day stock movements from 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30. Report the warehouse ID, movement type, and sum of quantity, sorted by warehouse ID and movement type.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, mv_type, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY wh_id, mv_type ORDER BY wh_id ASC, mv_type ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products whose list price is between 30 and 80 USD inclusive, ordered by list price ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc BETWEEN 30.00 AND 80.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC;

items.question: List each warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the total count of inventory records held in that warehouse, ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) FROM warehouse AS T1 LEFT JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY T1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: For products supplied by supplier ID 5, return the SKU, lead days, and an indicator for whether it is the primary supplier, sorted by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days, is_primary FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 5 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: For the trailing 60-day period ending 2025-11-30 (starting 2025-10-02), calculate the total net quantity moved per product SKU for ADJ movements, ordered by total quantity descending and SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-02 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Compare order quantities across sales channels for orders placed in November 2025 ('2025-11-01' to '2025-11-30'). Show the sales channel code and total order line quantity, sorted by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.channel_cd, SUM(T2.qty) FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY T1.channel_cd ORDER BY SUM(T2.qty) DESC;

items.question: Generate a weekly summary of IN stock movements for November 2025 (weeks starting 2025-11-01, 2025-11-08, 2025-11-15, 2025-11-22). Show the week start date, SKU, and total quantity received, ordered by week start date and SKU.
items.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN mv_ts < '2025-11-08 00:00:00' THEN '2025-11-01' WHEN mv_ts < '2025-11-15 00:00:00' THEN '2025-11-08' WHEN mv_ts < '2025-11-22 00:00:00' THEN '2025-11-15' ELSE '2025-11-22' END AS week_start, sku, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-29 00:00:00' GROUP BY week_start, sku ORDER BY week_start ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for discontinued products (disc_flag = 1) in the OFC category, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'OFC' ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: List all suppliers from the US, returning supplier ID and supplier name, sorted by supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_nm ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse, report the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and total inventory units on hand, sorted by total units on hand descending and warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) DESC, T1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: An active customer is defined as one with is_actv = 1. Show the customer name and signup date for all active customers in the Asia Pacific region (region_cd = 'AP').
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP';

items.question: An electronics product is defined as one belonging to category code 'ELC'. List the product name and list price for all electronics products that are not discontinued (disc_flag = 0).
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0;

items.question: A delivered order is defined as an order with status code 'D'. Show the order ID and order total amount for delivered orders placed through the mobile app (channel_cd = 'APP') on 2026-04-03, ordered by order total amount descending, then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: A high-value order line is defined as one where the quantity ordered is greater than 3. Show the SKU, quantity ordered, and unit price for order lines belonging to order 'O-5001', sorted by quantity descending and SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, qty, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' AND qty > 3 ORDER BY qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: A premium tier customer is defined as a customer with tier code 'P'. Retrieve the customer ID and customer name for premium tier customers in the North America region ('NA'), ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC;

items.question: A kitchen category product is defined by category code 'KIT'. Find the product name and list price for kitchen products priced over 80 USD, sorted by list price descending, then product name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc > 80.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC;

items.question: A local currency order is defined as one placed in British Pounds ('GBP'). Show the order ID and order total amount for orders placed in GBP during April 2026 (between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30').
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'GBP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30';

items.question: A discounted order line is defined as a line item where the discount percentage is greater than zero. Show the order ID, line number, and discount percentage for lines on order 'O-5024' that received a discount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, disc_pct FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5024' AND disc_pct > 0.00;

items.question: A platinum customer is defined as a customer with tier code 'P'. For each sales region, show the region code and the count of platinum customers, sorted by the count descending, then region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_count DESC, region_cd ASC;

items.question: A completed order is defined as an order with status 'D'. For each sales channel, find the channel code and the total sum of order amounts for completed orders placed in June 2026 (between '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30'), ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

items.question: A large order is defined as an order with a total amount exceeding 500 USD equivalent. Retrieve the order ID, customer name, and order total amount for large orders placed in USD during July 2026, ordered by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t2.cust_nm, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN cust_master t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t1.ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC;

items.question: A heavy product line is defined as an order line where the ordered quantity is 4 or more. For each product, show the product SKU, product name, and total quantity ordered across all heavy order lines, sorted by total quantity descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.qty >= 4 GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, t1.sku ASC;

items.question: An active customer is defined as a customer record with is_actv = 1. For each loyalty tier code, list the tier code and the average list price of products ordered by active customers, ordered by average price descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, AVG(t4.list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_line t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog t4 ON t3.sku = t4.sku WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY t1.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC;

items.question: A web-channel order is defined as an order placed through channel code 'WEB'. For each customer who placed web orders, show the customer ID, customer name, and count of their web orders, restricted to customers with more than 1 web order, sorted by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS web_order_count FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY web_order_count DESC;

items.question: An expensive item is defined as a product with a list price greater than 100.00. For each product category, show the category code and the count of expensive items that are currently sold (disc_flag = 0), ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS expensive_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 100.00 AND disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY expensive_count DESC;

items.question: A high-volume order is defined as an order containing 3 or more distinct line items. Retrieve the order ID and the count of line items for high-volume orders placed in April 2026, sorted by line count descending, then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, COUNT(t2.line_no) AS line_count FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY t1.ord_id HAVING COUNT(t2.line_no) >= 3 ORDER BY line_count DESC, t1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: A high-value transaction is defined as an order line where the net line value (calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price) exceeds 300.00. For each such line, show the order ID, SKU, quantity, unit price, and net line value, sorted by net line value descending, then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, sku, qty, unit_prc, (qty * unit_prc) AS net_val FROM ord_line WHERE (qty * unit_prc) > 300.00 ORDER BY net_val DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: A top-tier customer is defined as a customer with tier code 'P'. For each sales region, show the region code, total number of customers, and the count of top-tier customers, sorted by the count of top-tier customers descending, then region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_tier_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY top_tier_count DESC, region_cd ASC;

items.question: A multi-currency customer is defined as a customer who has placed orders in more than one distinct currency. List the customer ID and customer name for all multi-currency customers, ordered by customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.currency_cd) > 1 ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: A high-revenue product is defined as a product whose total sales revenue (sum of quantity multiplied by unit price across all order lines) exceeds 500.00. Show the SKU, product name, and total sales revenue for such products, ordered by total revenue descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, SUM(t1.qty * t1.unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM ord_line t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm HAVING SUM(t1.qty * t1.unit_prc) > 500.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

items.question: A recurring customer is defined as a customer who placed 2 or more orders in January 2026. Show the customer ID, customer name, and total amount spent across their January 2026 orders, sorted by total amount descending, then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_spent FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) >= 2 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: A discounted line item is defined as an order line with a discount percentage greater than zero. For each sales channel, show the channel code, total count of order lines, and the count of discounted line items, sorted by the proportion of discounted lines descending, then channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.channel_cd, COUNT(t2.line_no) AS total_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.disc_pct > 0.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_lines FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.channel_cd ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.disc_pct > 0.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t2.line_no)) DESC, t1.channel_cd ASC;

items.question: A large-scale order is defined as an order with an order total amount greater than 300.00. For each customer loyalty tier, show the tier code, total count of orders, and count of large-scale orders, sorted by the count of large-scale orders descending, then tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.ord_total_amt > 300.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS large_orders FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.tier_cd ORDER BY large_orders DESC, t1.tier_cd ASC;

items.question: An active account is defined as a customer record where is_actv = 1. For each sales region, display the region code, total count of active customers, and the average list price of products associated with orders placed by those active customers, sorted by average list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) AS active_cust_count, AVG(t4.list_prc) AS avg_prod_price FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_line t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog t4 ON t3.sku = t4.sku WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY avg_prod_price DESC;

items.question: An 'at-risk customer' is anyone currently marked with a segment of RISK in the monthly customer segment history for October 2025. Show the customer name and tier code for every at-risk customer in the EU region, ordered alphabetically by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2025-10-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t1.region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: A 'high-value order' is any order with a total amount strictly exceeding 500.00 USD. For all high-value orders placed in April 2026, show the order ID, the order date, and the customer name, sorted by order date descending and then by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t2.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND t1.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A 'critical support ticket' is any ticket with a severity level of 1. Show the ticket ID, the opened timestamp, and the customer ID for all critical tickets opened in April 2026, ordered by opened timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts, cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC

items.question: A 'duplicate-charge refund' is any refund request where the reason code is DUP. Show the refund request ID, order ID, and requested amount for all duplicate-charge refunds requested in 2025, ordered by requested amount descending then refund ID.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DUP' AND req_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: A 'finance department employee' is any staff member whose department code is FIN. Show the full name and hire date of every finance department employee, ordered by hire date ascending then name.
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm, hire_dt FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN' ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_nm ASC

items.question: A 'pending refund' is any refund request currently having a status code of P. Show the refund request ID, the requested date, and the requested amount for all pending refunds requested since November 1, 2025, ordered by requested date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' AND req_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY req_dt ASC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: An 'approved refund' is a refund request with a status code of A. For each employee who approved at least one refund, show the employee name and the count of approved refunds they decided, ordered by the count descending then employee name.
items.sql: SELECT t2.emp_nm, COUNT(t1.rfd_id) FROM refund_req AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.approver_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t1.rfd_id) DESC, t2.emp_nm ASC

items.question: A 'delivered shipment' is any shipment where the shipment status is D and the delivery date is not null. For each carrier code, show the carrier code and the count of delivered shipments dispatched in November 2025, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(ship_id) FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND ship_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(ship_id) DESC, carrier_cd ASC

items.question: A 'platinum customer' is a customer whose loyalty tier code is P. Show the customer ID, customer name, and total order amount for all platinum customers who placed orders in 2026, grouped by customer, sorted by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: A 'support ticket with activity' is any ticket that has recorded events in the ticket history table. Show the category code and the average number of history events per ticket for each category of support tickets opened in April 2026, sorted by category code.
items.sql: SELECT t1.categ_cd, COUNT(t2.evt_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.tkt_id) FROM support_tkt AS t1 INNER JOIN tkt_event AS t2 ON t1.tkt_id = t2.tkt_id WHERE t1.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t1.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.categ_cd ORDER BY t1.categ_cd ASC

items.question: A 'billing ticket' is any support ticket with a category code of BILL. For each support department employee assigned to billing tickets, show the employee name and the count of assigned billing tickets, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.emp_nm, COUNT(t1.tkt_id) FROM support_tkt AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.assigned_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'BILL' GROUP BY t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t1.tkt_id) DESC, t2.emp_nm ASC

items.question: A 'cancelled order' is any order with an order status of C. Show the sales region and the total sum of cancelled order amounts for all cancelled orders placed in 2026, grouped by sales region, ordered by the total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.region_cd, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_status = 'C' AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t2.region_cd ORDER BY SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) DESC, t2.region_cd ASC

items.question: A 'settled online payment' is any payment attempt made via the WEB channel where the payment status is S. Show the customer name, the order ID, and the payment amount for all settled online payments made in November 2025, ordered by payment amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t3.cust_nm, t1.ord_id, t1.pay_amt FROM payment AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id INNER JOIN cust_master AS t3 ON t2.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t1.pay_status = 'S' AND t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t1.paid_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY t1.pay_amt DESC, t1.pay_id ASC

items.question: A 'damaged refund request' is any refund request where the reason code is DMG and the request date is in 2025. Show the employee name of the approver and the average requested amount of damaged refund requests they decided, grouped by approver, ordered by the average amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.emp_nm, AVG(t1.rfd_amt) FROM refund_req AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.approver_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND t1.req_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm ORDER BY AVG(t1.rfd_amt) DESC, t2.emp_nm ASC

items.question: A 'high-value customer' is any customer who has placed at least one order with a total amount exceeding 500.00 USD. Show the customer name, the count of their high-value orders, and their average high-value order amount for all high-value customers in the NA region, sorted by average order amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id), AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'NA' AND t2.ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND t2.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: An 'escalated support ticket' is any support ticket that has at least one event of type ESCAL in its history. For each department of the employees who opened these tickets or were assigned to them, show the department code and the count of unique escalated tickets, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t3.dept_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.tkt_id) FROM support_tkt AS t1 INNER JOIN tkt_event AS t2 ON t1.tkt_id = t2.tkt_id INNER JOIN emp AS t3 ON t1.assigned_emp_id = t3.emp_id WHERE t2.evt_type = 'ESCAL' GROUP BY t3.dept_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t1.tkt_id) DESC, t3.dept_cd ASC

items.question: A 'discounted order line' is any order line where the discount percentage is greater than zero. For each product category, show the category code and the total revenue generated from discounted order lines in 2026 (calculated as qty multiplied by unit_prc minus the discount), ordered by total revenue descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.categ_cd, SUM(t1.qty * t1.unit_prc * (1.0 - t1.disc_pct / 100.0)) FROM ord_line AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.disc_pct > 0.00 AND t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t2.categ_cd ORDER BY SUM(t1.qty * t1.unit_prc * (1.0 - t1.disc_pct / 100.0)) DESC, t2.categ_cd ASC

items.question: A 'large refund request' is any refund request where the requested amount exceeds the policy threshold of 250.00 USD in force during 2025. Show the approver employee name, the count of large refund requests they approved in 2025, and the total approved amount, ordered by the total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.emp_nm, COUNT(t1.rfd_id), SUM(t1.rfd_amt) FROM refund_req AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.approver_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.status_cd = 'A' AND t1.rfd_amt > 250.00 AND t1.req_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm ORDER BY SUM(t1.rfd_amt) DESC, t2.emp_nm ASC

items.question: A 'returned order' is any order with an order status of R. Show the customer name, the loyalty tier code, and the count of returned orders for customers who have more than one returned order, sorted by the count of returned orders descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_status = 'R' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: An 'active support staff member' is any employee in the support department who has been assigned at least 3 support tickets. Show the employee name, the department code, and the count of assigned tickets for every active support staff member, ordered by ticket count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.emp_nm, t2.dept_cd, COUNT(t1.tkt_id) FROM support_tkt AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.assigned_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t2.dept_cd = 'SUP' GROUP BY t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm, t2.dept_cd HAVING COUNT(t1.tkt_id) >= 3 ORDER BY COUNT(t1.tkt_id) DESC, t2.emp_nm ASC

items.question: A 'fast-resolved ticket' is any support ticket that was closed with a resolution time of less than 24 hours from its opening timestamp. For each support channel, show the channel code and the count of fast-resolved tickets opened in April 2026, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(tkt_id) FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts) < 24 GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY COUNT(tkt_id) DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: A 'multi-payment order' is any order that has more than one payment attempt recorded. Show the order ID, the order total amount, and the count of payment attempts for all multi-payment orders placed in November 2025, ordered by the payment attempt count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, COUNT(t2.pay_id) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN payment AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt HAVING COUNT(t2.pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(t2.pay_id) DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A 'promoted high-value order' is any order that used a promotion and had a total amount exceeding 300.00 USD. For each promotion name, show the promotion name and the count of promoted high-value orders, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t3.promo_nm, COUNT(t1.ord_id) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id INNER JOIN promo AS t3 ON t2.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > 300.00 GROUP BY t3.promo_id, t3.promo_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t1.ord_id) DESC, t3.promo_nm ASC

items.question: A 'fully refunded order' is any order where the sum of approved refunds equals or exceeds the order total amount. Show the order ID, the order total amount, and the total approved refund amount for all fully refunded orders decided in 2025, ordered by the order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, SUM(t2.rfd_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN refund_req AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.status_cd = 'A' AND t2.decided_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt HAVING SUM(t2.rfd_amt) >= t1.ord_total_amt ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: An at-risk customer is defined as anyone who had an active browsing session in the WEB channel during the month of April 2026 who has not placed a single order since 2026-04-01. List the customer id and customer name for these at-risk customers, ordered alphabetically by customer name, then by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t2.evt_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND t1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01') GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: A late shipment is classified as any shipment that was delivered more than 5 days after its ship date. For all late shipments dispatched from the Newark Hub warehouse during 2026, show the shipment id, the order id, the carrier code, the ship date, and the delivery date, sorted chronologically by ship date then by shipment id.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ship_id, t1.ord_id, t1.carrier_cd, t1.ship_dt, t1.deliv_dt FROM shipment AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' AND t1.ship_status = 'D' AND t1.ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND DATEDIFF(t1.deliv_dt, t1.ship_dt) > 5 ORDER BY t1.ship_dt ASC, t1.ship_id ASC

items.question: A high-value order is any order where the order total amount in USD exceeds 500. For each high-value order placed through the WEB channel in 2026, list the order id, customer id, the order date, and the order total amount, sorted by order total amount in descending order then by order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A problem payment attempt is defined as any payment attempt that either failed or was refunded after settling. Find all problem payment attempts made via credit card during April 2026; show the payment attempt id, the order id, the payment amount, and the payment status code, ordered by payment amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, pay_status FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status IN ('F', 'R') AND paid_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC

items.question: A stock deficit is when a product's current inventory on-hand quantity falls below its specified reorder point. Retrieve the product SKU, product name, warehouse name, and current on-hand quantity for every stock deficit present at the Rotterdam Hub warehouse, ordered by on-hand quantity ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, t3.wh_nm, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN warehouse AS t3 ON t1.wh_id = t3.wh_id WHERE t3.wh_nm = 'Rotterdam Hub' AND t1.on_hand_qty < t1.reorder_pt ORDER BY t1.on_hand_qty ASC

items.question: An active customer is any customer who holds a platinum loyalty tier and has signed up on or before 2022-06-30. Count the total number of active customers residing in the European sales region.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'EU' AND signup_dt <= '2022-06-30'

items.question: A heavy inventory movement is any stock movement where the absolute quantity moved is greater than 100 units. For all heavy inventory movements that occurred in October 2025, list the movement id, the SKU, the movement type, and the quantity moved, ordered by movement id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, mv_type, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' AND ABS(qty) > 100 ORDER BY mv_id ASC

items.question: A refunded order is any order that has an order status code of returned or cancelled. For orders placed in the North America region that ended up as refunded orders during the first half of 2026, list the order id, customer id, order status, and order total amount, ordered by order date descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.cust_id, t1.ord_status, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.region_cd = 'NA' AND t1.ord_status IN ('R', 'C') AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt DESC

items.question: An expedited carrier partner is any shipment handled by either UPS or DHL. For all shipments handled by an expedited carrier partner from any warehouse in April 2026, show the warehouse id, carrier code, and the total count of shipments, grouped by warehouse id and carrier code, ordered by total count descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd IN ('UPS', 'DHL') AND ship_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-04-30' GROUP BY wh_id, carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC

items.question: A discounted line item is any order line where the discount percentage is strictly greater than zero. For all discounted line items belonging to orders placed in April 2026, list the order id, line number, SKU, quantity, unit price, and discount percentage, ordered by discount percentage descending then by order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.line_no, t1.sku, t1.qty, t1.unit_prc, t1.disc_pct FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' AND t1.disc_pct > 0.00 ORDER BY t1.disc_pct DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A high-risk support ticket is defined as any support ticket with a severity level of 1 (critical) or 2 (high). Count the total number of high-risk support tickets opened through the APP channel during April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl IN (1, 2) AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59'

items.question: A high-value refund request is any refund request where the requested amount is greater than 100 USD. For all high-value refund requests decided in December 2025, show the refund request id, the order id, the requested amount, the status code, and the decided date, sorted by requested amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt, status_cd, decided_dt FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_amt > 100.00 AND decided_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC

items.question: A premium product is any item in the product catalog categorized under electronics with a list price greater than 80 USD. List the SKU, product name, and list price for all premium products, ordered by list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 80.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC

items.question: A multi-payment order is any order that has more than one payment attempt recorded. List the order id and the exact count of payment attempts for all multi-payment orders, ordered by the count of payment attempts in descending order, then by order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY payment_count DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A primary supplier item is any product linked to a supplier where is_primary equals 1. Show the product SKU, product name, and supplier id for all primary supplier items provided by suppliers located in the USA, ordered by product SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, t1.sup_id FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t1.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t1.is_primary = 1 AND t3.country = 'US' ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: A promotion-backed order is any order that had a promotion applied using a promotion code. For all promotion-backed orders placed in November 2025, show the order id, promotion id, and the promotion code, sorted by order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.promo_id, t2.promo_cd FROM ord_promo AS t1 JOIN promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A closed critical support ticket is any support ticket with a severity level of 1 that has a non-null closed timestamp. Find the average resolution time in hours for all closed critical support tickets opened during April 2026; show the result as the average hours.
items.sql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts)) FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59'

items.question: A settled credit card payment is any payment attempt made via credit card with a settled status. Calculate the total settled amount for all settled credit card payments in USD during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59'

items.question: An unassigned support ticket is any support ticket where the assigned employee ID is null and the ticket status has not been closed (i.e. closed timestamp is null). Count the total number of unassigned support tickets currently present.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NULL AND closed_ts IS NULL

items.question: A high-volume warehouse is any warehouse that serves the North America region. List the warehouse id and warehouse name for all high-volume warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: A repeat customer is any customer who has placed more than 3 orders in total across all time. List the customer id and customer name for all repeat customers, sorted by customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) > 3 ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A cancelled order is an order with an order status code of C. For all cancelled orders placed through the phone channel, show the order id, customer id, and order date, ordered by order date descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' AND channel_cd = 'PHN' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC

items.question: A multi-item order is any order that contains more than 3 distinct lines of products. Retrieve the order id and the count of lines for all multi-item orders placed in 2026, ordered by the count of lines descending, then by order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY line_count DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: An active promotional campaign is any promotion record where the ends date is on or after 2026-01-01 and the discount percentage is greater than or equal to 15 percent. List the promotion id, promotion code, promotion name, and discount percentage for all active promotional campaigns, sorted by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE ends_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC

items.question: An at-risk customer is defined as anyone who had the segment code 'RISK' during the month of 2026-09-01. Show the customer name and signup date for all at-risk customers from the AP region, ordered by signup date ascending then customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND T2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND T1.region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY T1.signup_dt ASC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A high-value order is any order with a total amount greater than 500.00 USD. For all high-value orders placed in 2026 via the web channel ('WEB'), show the order ID, order date, and order total amount, sorted by order total descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A flash sale promo is any promotion with 'Flash sale' as its promotion name. Show the promotion code, start date, and end date for all flash sale promos that begin on or after 2025-12-01, ordered by start date ascending then promo code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, starts_dt, ends_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_nm = 'Flash sale' AND starts_dt >= '2025-12-01' ORDER BY starts_dt ASC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: A VIP segment customer is any customer whose segment code was 'VIP' in the month of 2026-10-01. List the customer ID and customer name of these VIP customers who belong to the NA region, sorted alphabetically by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND T2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND T1.region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: An app-based browsing session is any web event record captured through the 'APP' channel. For sessions occurring on 2025-11-09, list the distinct session IDs along with the corresponding SKU involved, sorted by session ID ascending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT session_id, sku FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-09 23:59:59' ORDER BY session_id ASC, sku ASC

items.question: A cancelled order is an order header whose status code is 'C'. Show the count of cancelled orders placed through each sales channel, displaying the channel code and the order count, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: A discounted promotion is any promotion offering a discount percentage greater than 15.00 percent. Show the promotion name, promotion code, and discount percentage for all such promotions active during the year 2026, sorted by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 AND starts_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND ends_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: An active promotional order is an order where a promotion was applied and the order status is shipped ('S'). For all such orders in April 2026, list the order ID, order date, and promotion ID, ordered by order date ascending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.ord_dt, T2.promo_id FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.ord_status = 'S' AND T1.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY T1.ord_dt ASC, T1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A newly registered customer is a customer who signed up on or after 2022-07-01 and held the segment code 'NEW' in November 2025. Show the customer name, sign-up date, and region code for these customers, sorted by sign-up date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.signup_dt, T1.region_cd FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND T2.month_dt = '2025-11-01' ORDER BY T1.signup_dt ASC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A converted clickstream session is a web event session that includes a 'PURCHASE' event type resulting in an order. For all such sessions in November 2025, list the session ID, customer ID, and the generated order ID, ordered by session ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND ord_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY session_id ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A recurring active customer is an active customer (is_actv = 1) who has placed more than one order in total. Show the customer ID, customer name, and total order count for each such customer, ordered by order count descending then customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, COUNT(T2.ord_id) AS total_orders FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(T2.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY total_orders DESC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A promotional checkout event is a clickstream event of type 'CHECKOUT' originating from the web channel ('WEB'). For each customer who performed this action in November 2025, show the customer ID and the total number of checkout events, ordered by event count descending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS checkout_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY checkout_count DESC, cust_id ASC

items.question: A high-impact promotion is any promotion with a discount percentage of 20.00 or higher. For each high-impact promotion, calculate the total order amount across all orders where it was applied, showing the promotion name and total revenue, ordered by total revenue descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T1.disc_pct >= 20.00 GROUP BY T1.promo_id, T1.promo_nm ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, T1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: A transitioned customer is a customer whose segment code was 'NEW' in November 2025 but changed to 'REG' in December 2025. List the customer ID and customer name for all such transitioned customers, sorted by customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T3 ON T1.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T2.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND T2.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND T3.segment_cd = 'REG' AND T3.month_dt = '2025-12-01' ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: An unpromoted high-value order is any order with a total amount over 400.00 USD that did not use any promotional code. Show the order ID, order date, and order total amount for these orders placed in the first half of 2026 (Jan to Jun), ordered by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 400.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' AND ord_id NOT IN (SELECT ord_id FROM ord_promo) ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A multi-promo order is an order that had more than one promotion applied to it. List the order ID and the count of promotions applied for all such orders, sorted by promotion count descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(promo_id) AS promo_count FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY promo_count DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A browser-loyal customer is an active customer from the EU region who exclusively uses the 'WEB' channel for all their clickstream events (no 'APP' events). List the customer ID and customer name for these customers, ordered by customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'EU' AND T1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T2.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND COUNT(T2.evt_id) > 0 ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A multi-session purchaser is a customer who completed purchases across two or more distinct web event sessions. Show the customer ID, customer name, and the count of distinct sessions where a purchase event occurred, ordered by the session count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.session_id) AS session_count FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND T2.cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.session_id) >= 2 ORDER BY session_count DESC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: An active promotional campaign is any promotion that was utilized on at least 3 different orders. For each such campaign, show the promotion code, promotion name, and the total count of orders it was applied to, sorted by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, T1.promo_nm, COUNT(T2.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id GROUP BY T1.promo_id, T1.promo_cd, T1.promo_nm HAVING COUNT(T2.ord_id) >= 3 ORDER BY ord_count DESC, T1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: A multi-segment customer is any customer who has held at least 2 different segment codes across all recorded months in the segment history. Show the customer ID, customer name, and the number of distinct segments they belonged to, sorted by distinct segment count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.segment_cd) AS segment_count FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.segment_cd) >= 2 ORDER BY segment_count DESC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A cross-channel shopper is a customer who has generated web events using both 'WEB' and 'APP' channels. List the customer ID and customer name for all cross-channel shoppers, ordered alphabetically by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T2.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN T2.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A top promotional month is any month where total order revenue using promotions exceeded 500.00 USD. For each such month (derived from order date truncated to the first of the month), show the month and the total promotional order revenue, ordered by revenue descending.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(T1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, SUM(T1.ord_total_amt) AS promo_revenue FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY month_start HAVING SUM(T1.ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY promo_revenue DESC, month_start ASC

items.question: A promotion-dependent customer is an active customer who has placed orders, but 100% of their orders had a promotion applied. List the customer ID and customer name for these customers, ordered by customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(T2.ord_id) > 0 AND COUNT(T2.ord_id) = SUM(CASE WHEN T2.ord_id IN (SELECT ord_id FROM ord_promo) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: An elite stagnant customer is a platinum tier customer ('P') who held the segment code 'RISK' in October 2026 and has placed zero orders in the entire year 2026. Show the customer ID, customer name, and sign-up date for these customers, ordered by sign-up date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, T1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.tier_cd = 'P' AND T2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND T2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND T1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') ORDER BY T1.signup_dt ASC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A late shipment is a shipment where the delivery date is later than the shipment date by more than 5 days. For all shipments dispatched in November 2025 from the Newark Hub warehouse (wh_id = 'W1'), show the carrier code and the count of such late shipments, ordered by the count descending then carrier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS late_shipment_cnt FROM shipment AS T1 WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.ship_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T1.ship_dt <= '2025-11-30' AND DATEDIFF(T1.deliv_dt, T1.ship_dt) > 5 GROUP BY T1.carrier_cd ORDER BY late_shipment_cnt DESC, T1.carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: A high-value order is an order header with an order total amount greater than 500.00 USD. For orders placed in Q4 2025 using the web channel (channel_cd = 'WEB'), show the customer ID and the count of high-value orders they placed, ordered by the count descending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, COUNT(*) AS high_val_cnt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T1.currency_cd = 'USD' AND T1.ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' AND T1.ord_total_amt > 500.00 GROUP BY T1.cust_id ORDER BY high_val_cnt DESC, T1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: An at-risk customer is one who has the risk segment code ('RISK') in their monthly history for December 2025. Show the customer name and loyalty tier code for all at-risk customers whose tier code is Platinum ('P'), ordered by the customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.tier_cd FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND T1.tier_cd = 'P' ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: A bulk stock movement is a stock movement where the absolute quantity moved is 100 units or more. For all stock movements recorded in October 2025, show the SKU, the warehouse ID, and the total absolute quantity moved for bulk movements, ordered by the total quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.wh_id, SUM(ABS(T1.qty)) AS tot_abs_qty FROM inv_move AS T1 WHERE T1.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND T1.mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' AND ABS(T1.qty) >= 100 GROUP BY T1.sku, T1.wh_id ORDER BY tot_abs_qty DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: A primary supplier is one listed as the main supplier for a product (is_primary = 1). Show the supplier name and the count of products they are the primary supplier for, ordered by the product count descending then supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS primary_prod_cnt FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_prod_cnt DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: A heavily discounted order line is an order line with a line discount percentage of 15.00 or higher. For order lines placed in November 2025, show the SKU and the sum of ordered quantities for heavily discounted lines, ordered by the total ordered quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, SUM(T1.qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T2.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' AND T1.disc_pct >= 15.00 GROUP BY T1.sku ORDER BY tot_qty DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: A critical support ticket is a support ticket with a severity level of 1 (sev_lvl = 1). For critical tickets opened in April 2026, show the category code and the count of such tickets, ordered by the count descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS crit_tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt AS T1 WHERE T1.sev_lvl = 1 AND T1.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND T1.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY T1.categ_cd ORDER BY crit_tkt_cnt DESC, T1.categ_cd ASC;

items.question: A large inventory item is a product where the current on-hand quantity is greater than 500 units. Show the warehouse name and the count of large inventory items held in each warehouse, ordered by the count descending then warehouse name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS large_item_cnt FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.on_hand_qty > 500 GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY large_item_cnt DESC, T1.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: A high-lead supplier is one where the lead days for supplying a product are greater than 30 days. Show the supplier name and the count of products they supply with a high lead time, ordered by the count descending then supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS high_lead_cnt FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T2.lead_days > 30 GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY high_lead_cnt DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: An expensive product is one from the electronics category (categ_cd = 'ELC') with a list price greater than 75.00 USD. Show the SKU and product name for all expensive electronics products that are not discontinued (disc_flag = 0), ordered by list price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND T1.list_prc > 75.00 AND T1.disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY T1.list_prc DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: A cancelled order is an order header with status code 'C'. For customers who signed up in 2022 and are currently active (is_actv = 1), show the customer name and the count of cancelled orders they placed, ordered by the count descending then customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, COUNT(T2.ord_id) AS cancelled_cnt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND T1.signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' AND T1.is_actv = 1 AND T2.ord_status = 'C' GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm ORDER BY cancelled_cnt DESC, T1.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: A damaged refund is a refund request where the reason code is 'DMG' and the status code is approved ('A'). For refund requests decided in December 2025, show the employee ID of the approver and the sum of approved refund amounts for damaged items, ordered by the sum descending then approver employee ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.approver_emp_id, SUM(T1.rfd_amt) AS tot_dmg_rfd FROM refund_req AS T1 WHERE T1.status_cd = 'A' AND T1.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND T1.decided_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND T1.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY T1.approver_emp_id ORDER BY tot_dmg_rfd DESC, T1.approver_emp_id ASC;

items.question: A high-value payment is a payment attempt where the payment amount is greater than 200.00 USD and the status is settled ('S'). For payments made in November 2025, show the payment method code and the count of high-value settled payments, ordered by the count descending then method code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.method_cd, COUNT(*) AS high_val_pay_cnt FROM payment AS T1 WHERE T1.pay_status = 'S' AND T1.currency_cd = 'USD' AND T1.pay_amt > 200.00 AND T1.paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T1.paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY T1.method_cd ORDER BY high_val_pay_cnt DESC, T1.method_cd ASC;

items.question: An active promotion is a promotion that starts on or before 2025-11-25 and ends on or after 2025-11-25. Show the promotion code and promotion name for all active promotions during that date, ordered by promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, T1.promo_nm FROM promo AS T1 WHERE T1.starts_dt <= '2025-11-25' AND T1.ends_dt >= '2025-11-25' ORDER BY T1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: A restock movement is a stock movement where the movement type is 'IN' (restock). For restock movements occurring in October 2025, show the warehouse name and the total quantity added through restocks, ordered by total quantity descending then warehouse name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.wh_nm, SUM(T1.qty) AS tot_restock_qty FROM inv_move AS T1 JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.mv_type = 'IN' AND T1.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND T1.mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY T2.wh_id, T2.wh_nm ORDER BY tot_restock_qty DESC, T2.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: A reorder-trigger item is a product in a warehouse where the current on-hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point. Show the warehouse ID, SKU, and on-hand quantity for all reorder-trigger items in the Newark Hub warehouse ('W1'), ordered by on-hand quantity ascending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.sku, T1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS T1 WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.on_hand_qty <= T1.reorder_pt ORDER BY T1.on_hand_qty ASC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: A VIP customer segment is a customer monthly history record where the segment code is 'VIP'. For the month of December 2025, show the region code and the count of unique VIP customers, ordered by the count descending then region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.cust_id) AS vip_cust_cnt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' GROUP BY T1.region_cd ORDER BY vip_cust_cnt DESC, T1.region_cd ASC;

items.question: A web purchase event is a web clickstream event where the event type is 'PURCHASE' and the channel code is 'WEB'. For web purchase events recorded in November 2025, show the customer ID and the count of purchase events, ordered by the count descending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, COUNT(*) AS web_purchase_cnt FROM web_event AS T1 WHERE T1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND T1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T1.cust_id IS NOT NULL AND T1.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T1.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY T1.cust_id ORDER BY web_purchase_cnt DESC, T1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: A high-revenue product is a product that has generated a total line revenue greater than 1,000.00 USD across all order lines (calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price). Show the SKU and total revenue for all high-revenue products, ordered by total revenue descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, SUM(T1.qty * T1.unit_prc) AS tot_rev FROM ord_line AS T1 GROUP BY T1.sku HAVING tot_rev > 1000.00 ORDER BY tot_rev DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: An escalated support ticket is a support ticket that has at least one ticket event of type 'ESCAL' in its history. Show the category code and the count of such escalated tickets opened in April 2026, ordered by the count descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.categ_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.tkt_id) AS escalated_cnt FROM support_tkt AS T1 JOIN tkt_event AS T2 ON T1.tkt_id = T2.tkt_id WHERE T1.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND T1.opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND T2.evt_type = 'ESCAL' GROUP BY T1.categ_cd ORDER BY escalated_cnt DESC, T1.categ_cd ASC;

items.question: A multi-payment order is an order header that has more than one payment attempt recorded in the payment table. Show the order ID and the count of payment attempts for all multi-payment orders placed in November 2025, ordered by the payment count descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, COUNT(T2.pay_id) AS pay_cnt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN payment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY T1.ord_id HAVING pay_cnt > 1 ORDER BY pay_cnt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: A discounted promotion order is an order that used a promotion with a discount percentage of 20.00 or higher. Show the promotion code and the count of orders that used such promotions in November 2025, ordered by the order count descending then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T1.disc_pct >= 20.00 AND T3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T3.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY T1.promo_id, T1.promo_cd ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, T1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: A multi-item order is an order header that contains more than 3 distinct order lines. Show the order ID and the count of distinct lines for all multi-item orders placed in November 2025, ordered by the line count descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, COUNT(T2.line_no) AS line_cnt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY T1.ord_id HAVING line_cnt > 3 ORDER BY line_cnt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: A prolific employee is an employee who has approved more than 2 refund requests. Show the employee name and the count of approved refund requests they handled, ordered by the approval count descending then employee name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_nm, COUNT(T2.rfd_id) AS app_rfd_cnt FROM emp AS T1 JOIN refund_req AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.approver_emp_id WHERE T2.status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm HAVING app_rfd_cnt > 2 ORDER BY app_rfd_cnt DESC, T1.emp_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id, customer name, and total order count for active customers in the NA sales region who have placed more than 2 orders, sorted by total order count descending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: WITH cust_orders AS (SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' AND c.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(o.ord_id) > 2) SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, ord_cnt FROM cust_orders ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for electronic products whose list price is strictly greater than the average list price across all electronic products, ordered by list price descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH avg_elc AS (SELECT AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC') SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p, avg_elc a WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND p.list_prc > a.avg_prc ORDER BY p.list_prc DESC, p.sku ASC;
