items.question: For orders placed in 2026, calculate the overall gross revenue in USD by multiplying the order total amount by the applicable FX rate for the order currency on the order date, grouped by sales channel code, and show the channel code and total USD revenue sorted by revenue descending.
items.sql: WITH rev_calc AS (SELECT o.channel_cd, o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd AS usd_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt >= f.eff_dt AND o.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(f.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31') SELECT channel_cd, SUM(usd_amt) AS total_usd_rev FROM rev_calc GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_usd_rev DESC;

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the count of unique customers in that tier who signed up during the year 2022, sorted by the customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC;

items.question: Identify SKUs that appear in order lines with a quantity greater than 3, and show their SKU, product name, and the maximum unit price recorded for them, sorted by maximum unit price descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH high_qty_skus AS (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM ord_line WHERE qty > 3) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, MAX(l.unit_prc) AS max_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN high_qty_skus h ON p.sku = h.sku JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY max_prc DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Find customers who placed orders in both the WEB channel and the APP channel during 2026. Show their customer id and customer name, sorted by customer id ascending.
items.sql: WITH web_cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01'), app_cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01') SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_cust w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id JOIN app_cust a ON c.cust_id = a.cust_id ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the sales region code and the average customer order total amount in USD for orders placed in Q2 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026), sorted by average USD amount descending.
items.sql: WITH q2_orders AS (SELECT o.cust_id, o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd AS usd_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt >= f.eff_dt AND o.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(f.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-06-30') SELECT c.region_cd, AVG(q.usd_amt) AS avg_usd_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN q2_orders q ON c.cust_id = q.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY avg_usd_amt DESC;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and total quantity ordered for the top 5 most ordered products across all order lines, sorted by total quantity descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, p.sku ASC LIMIT 5;

items.question: For each loyalty tier code, calculate the total number of customers and the percentage of those customers who are currently active (is_actv = 1), and show the tier code, total customers, and active percentage, sorted by active percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS total_cust, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(cust_id) AS active_pct FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY active_pct DESC;

items.question: Find orders that have more than 2 distinct order lines, and show the order id, customer id, order date, and the count of lines, ordered by the line count descending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: WITH multi_line AS (SELECT ord_id, COUNT(line_no) AS line_cnt FROM ord_line GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(line_no) > 2) SELECT o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_dt, m.line_cnt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN multi_line m ON o.ord_id = m.ord_id ORDER BY m.line_cnt DESC, o.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the product category code and the count of discontinued products (disc_flag = 1) in each category, ordered by the discontinued count descending, then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(sku) AS disc_cnt FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY disc_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Calculate the monthly total order revenue in USD for the year 2026, showing the month (as extracted from order date) and total USD revenue, sorted by month ascending.
items.sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(o.ord_dt, 1, 7) AS ord_month, o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd AS usd_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt >= f.eff_dt AND o.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(f.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31') SELECT ord_month, SUM(usd_amt) AS total_usd_rev FROM monthly_rev GROUP BY ord_month ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who have placed orders totaling more than 1000 USD in total across all their orders in 2026, sorted by total USD amount descending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: WITH cust_spend AS (SELECT o.cust_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt >= f.eff_dt AND o.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(f.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY o.cust_id HAVING SUM(o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) > 1000.00) SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_spend s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id ORDER BY s.total_usd DESC, c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the order status code and the count of orders for each status where the order date is in the first half of 2026 (from '2026-01-01' to '2026-06-30'), sorted by the order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC;

items.question: Find products whose average discount percentage across all order lines is greater than 10 percent. Show the SKU, product name, and average discount percentage, sorted by average discount percentage descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH avg_disc AS (SELECT sku, AVG(disc_pct) AS avg_dp FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING AVG(disc_pct) > 10.0) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, a.avg_dp FROM prod_catalog p JOIN avg_disc a ON p.sku = a.sku ORDER BY a.avg_dp DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: For each sales region code, count how many customers signed up in 2022 and show the region code and customer count, sorted by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS signup_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the currency code and the maximum order total amount for orders placed in 2026, sorted by maximum amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY max_amt DESC;

items.question: Identify products that have never been ordered on any order line, and show their SKU and product name, sorted by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM ord_line) ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Calculate the conversion rate from viewed to purchased for each product category during 2026. Show the category code, total views, total purchases, and the purchase-to-view percentage, sorted by the percentage descending.
items.sql: WITH view_counts AS (SELECT p.categ_cd, COUNT(w.evt_id) AS view_cnt FROM web_event w JOIN prod_catalog p ON w.sku = p.sku WHERE w.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND w.evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.categ_cd), pur_counts AS (SELECT p.categ_cd, COUNT(w.evt_id) AS pur_cnt FROM web_event w JOIN ord_line l ON w.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND w.evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.categ_cd) SELECT v.categ_cd, v.view_cnt, COALESCE(p.pur_cnt, 0) AS pur_cnt, (COALESCE(p.pur_cnt, 0) * 100.0) / v.view_cnt AS conv_pct FROM view_counts v LEFT JOIN pur_counts p ON v.categ_cd = p.categ_cd ORDER BY conv_pct DESC;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for products belonging to the office category ('OFC') that have a list price below 100 USD, sorted by list price ascending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC' AND list_prc < 100.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: For each sales channel code, calculate the total number of orders placed in 2026 and the average order total amount in USD, and show the channel code, order count, and average USD amount, sorted by average USD amount descending.
items.sql: WITH ch_orders AS (SELECT o.channel_cd, o.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd AS usd_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN fx_rate f ON o.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND o.ord_dt >= f.eff_dt AND o.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(f.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31') SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt, AVG(usd_amt) AS avg_usd_amt FROM ch_orders GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY avg_usd_amt DESC;

items.question: Find customers who have placed at least 1 order and also have at least 1 support ticket. Show their customer id and customer name, sorted by customer id ascending.
items.sql: WITH cust_ords AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr), cust_tkts AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM support_tkt) SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_ords o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN cust_tkts t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the average list price of products ordered by customers in each tier during 2026, sorted by average list price descending.
items.sql: WITH tier_prods AS (SELECT c.tier_cd, p.list_prc FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN ord_line l ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31') SELECT tier_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM tier_prods GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC;

items.question: List the order id, customer id, and order total amount for orders that used the 'USD' currency and had a total amount greater than 500, ordered by order total amount descending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id and the total order amount for each customer who placed orders in 2026, ordering by total order amount descending and customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY total_amt DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the employee id and total number of support tickets assigned to each employee for tickets opened since 2026-04-01, sorting by ticket count descending then employee id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT assigned_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY tkt_count DESC, emp_id ASC;

items.question: Show the tier code and the count of customers in each tier who signed up during 2022, ordered by tier code.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC;

items.question: List the reason code and the sum of refund amounts for each refund reason for requests made in 2025, ordering by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY total_rfd DESC;

items.question: Show the category code and the count of support tickets for each category where the channel code is WEB, sorted by category code.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;

items.question: List the order status and the average order total amount for orders placed through the APP channel in 2026, ordered by order status.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_status ASC;

items.question: Show the department code and the number of employees in each department who were hired before 2021-01-01, ordered by employee count descending.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM emp WHERE hire_dt < '2021-01-01' GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY emp_count DESC;

items.question: List the status code and the count of refund requests for each status where the amount is greater than 100, sorted by status code.
items.sql: SELECT status_cd, COUNT(*) AS rfd_count FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_amt > 100.00 GROUP BY status_cd ORDER BY status_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id and the count of orders for customers who have placed more than 3 orders in total, ordered by order count descending and customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY ord_count DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the employee id, employee name, and the total refund amount approved by each employee for requests decided in 2025, sorting by total approved amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, SUM(r.rfd_amt) AS total_approved FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND r.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm ORDER BY total_approved DESC;

items.question: Show the region code and the total order amount for active customers in the NA region for orders placed in 2026, ordered by total order amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT c.region_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' AND c.is_actv = 1 AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.region_cd;

items.question: List the severity level and the average resolution time in hours for closed support tickets opened in April 2026, ordered by severity level ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sev_lvl, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts)) AS avg_hours FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC;

items.question: Show the employee id and the count of ticket events performed by each employee where the event type is REPLY, ordered by event count descending.
items.sql: SELECT actor_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(*) AS reply_count FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'REPLY' AND actor_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actor_emp_id ORDER BY reply_count DESC;

items.question: List the customer id and the maximum order total amount for customers whose maximum order amount exceeds 500, sorted by maximum amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING MAX(ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY max_amt DESC;

items.question: Show the channel code and the total number of support tickets for categories where the category code is TECH, grouped by channel and ordered by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'TECH' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY tkt_count DESC;

items.question: List the category code and total refund requests count for support tickets categorized under REFD, grouped by assigned employee id, ordered by employee id.
items.sql: SELECT assigned_emp_id AS emp_id, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'REFD' AND assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY emp_id ASC;

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who placed orders in both 2025 and 2026, ordering by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' AND c.cust_id IN (SELECT o2.cust_id FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Using a CTE, calculate the total order amount per customer in 2026, then show the customer id and total amount for customers whose total exceeds the overall average customer total for that year, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: WITH cust_totals AS (SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS tot FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT cust_id, tot FROM cust_totals WHERE tot > (SELECT AVG(tot) FROM cust_totals) ORDER BY tot DESC;

items.question: Using a CTE to find the average order amount per customer, list the customer id, tier code, and their total order amount for customers whose average order value is higher than the average order value of their respective loyalty tier in 2026.
items.sql: WITH tier_avg AS (SELECT c.tier_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_tier FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.tier_cd), cust_avg AS (SELECT c.cust_id, c.tier_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS tot, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) AS avg_cust FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.tier_cd) SELECT ca.cust_id, ca.tier_cd, ca.tot FROM cust_avg ca JOIN tier_avg ta ON ca.tier_cd = ta.tier_cd WHERE ca.avg_cust > ta.avg_tier ORDER BY ca.tot DESC;

items.question: Using a CTE, calculate the total refund amount requested per customer, then return the customer id and total refund amount for customers whose total refund amount is in the top 5 highest refund getters among all customers, ordered by total refund descending.
items.sql: WITH cust_rfd AS (SELECT o.cust_id, SUM(r.rfd_amt) AS total_rfd FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id GROUP BY o.cust_id) SELECT cust_id, total_rfd FROM cust_rfd ORDER BY total_rfd DESC LIMIT 5;

items.question: Using a CTE to compute the count of support tickets handled by each employee, show the employee id, department code, and ticket count for employees whose ticket count is strictly greater than the average ticket count of all support department employees.
items.sql: WITH emp_tkt AS (SELECT e.emp_id, e.dept_cd, COUNT(s.tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM emp e LEFT JOIN support_tkt s ON e.emp_id = s.assigned_emp_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.dept_cd), sup_avg AS (SELECT AVG(tkt_cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM emp_tkt WHERE dept_cd = 'SUP') SELECT et.emp_id, et.dept_cd, et.tkt_cnt FROM emp_tkt et, sup_avg sa WHERE et.dept_cd = 'SUP' AND et.tkt_cnt > sa.avg_cnt ORDER BY et.tkt_cnt DESC;

items.question: Using a CTE, find the total number of orders placed per month in 2026, and calculate the month-over-month difference in order counts using lag, showing the month and the order count difference, ordered by month ascending.
items.sql: WITH monthly_ord AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS ord_month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_month) SELECT ord_month, cnt - LAG(cnt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ord_month ASC) AS diff FROM monthly_ord ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Using a CTE to find each customer's first order date in 2026, count how many customers had their first order in each month of 2026, and return the month and customer count, ordered by month ascending.
items.sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT cust_id, MIN(ord_dt) AS first_dt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING MIN(ord_dt) >= '2026-01-01' AND MIN(ord_dt) <= '2026-12-31'), monthly_first AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(first_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS new_cust_cnt FROM first_orders GROUP BY mth) SELECT mth, new_cust_cnt FROM monthly_first ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Using a CTE, rank employees within each department by the number of refund requests they approved in 2025, and return the department code, employee id, and approval count for the top-ranked employee in each department, ordered by department code ascending.
items.sql: WITH emp_approvals AS (SELECT e.dept_cd, e.emp_id, COUNT(r.rfd_id) AS app_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_cd ORDER BY COUNT(r.rfd_id) DESC) as rk FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND r.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY e.dept_cd, e.emp_id) SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, app_cnt FROM emp_approvals WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY dept_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and total units currently on hand across all their stocked products.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, T1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: List each carrier code and the total number of shipments they handled.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: For each payment method code, give the total payment amount and count of payment attempts that settled successfully ('S').
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS success_count FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY total_amount DESC, method_cd ASC;

items.question: List every product category code and the count of products in each category.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_count DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total absolute quantity of stock moved for all stock movements of type 'OUT'.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_out_qty DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Display the channel code and total order amount for all delivered orders ('D') placed through each channel.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: Get the SKU, product name, and list price for all products where the discontinued flag is 0 and the list price exceeds 80.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 AND list_prc > 80.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Count the number of warehouses in each sales region, showing the region code and warehouse count.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS wh_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY wh_count DESC, region_cd ASC;

items.question: Show warehouse ID and the count of inventory items where the on hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS low_stock_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY low_stock_count DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the carrier code and average delivery lead time in days (calculated as delivery date minus shipment date) for all delivered shipments.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_lead_days FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY avg_lead_days ASC, carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: For each currency code, show the total payment amount for payment attempts that settled successfully ('S') during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY total_settled DESC, currency_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of the top 3 products with the highest total units ordered across all order lines.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm, SUM(T1.qty) AS total_ordered FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku GROUP BY T1.sku, T2.prod_nm ORDER BY total_ordered DESC, T1.sku ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the count of distinct products held in inventory that are currently below their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS below_reorder_count FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.on_hand_qty <= T2.reorder_pt GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY below_reorder_count DESC, T1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: For each sales channel code, report the total order amount and the average order amount for all orders placed in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer ID and total order revenue for customers who have placed more than 1 order in total.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each stock movement type, calculate the total absolute quantity moved and the total number of movement transactions.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY total_qty DESC, mv_type ASC;

items.question: Identify warehouses where the total on-hand inventory quantity for all products combined is greater than 2000 units. Show warehouse ID and total on-hand quantity.
items.sql: WITH WhStock AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_qty FROM WhStock WHERE total_qty > 2000 ORDER BY total_qty DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Find products whose total order line quantity is strictly greater than the average total order line quantity across all products. Show SKU and total quantity ordered.
items.sql: WITH ProdQty AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku), AvgQty AS (SELECT AVG(tot_qty) AS avg_tot FROM ProdQty) SELECT T1.sku, T1.tot_qty FROM ProdQty AS T1 CROSS JOIN AvgQty AS T2 WHERE T1.tot_qty > T2.avg_tot ORDER BY T1.tot_qty DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse, calculate the percentage of its inventory items that are currently at or below their reorder point. Show warehouse ID, total items, low stock items, and the percentage.
items.sql: WITH WhSummary AS (SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS total_items, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_items FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_items, low_items, (low_items * 100.0 / total_items) AS low_pct FROM WhSummary ORDER BY low_pct DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: List customers who placed orders in both the WEB channel and the APP channel. Show customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' INTERSECT SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each carrier, compute the overall shipment volume and the count of shipments delivered on or before 2026-04-02. Show carrier code, total shipments, and early/on-time delivered shipments.
items.sql: WITH CarrierAll AS (SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS tot_ship FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd), CarrierDeliv AS (SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS deliv_ship FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt <= '2026-04-02' GROUP BY carrier_cd) SELECT T1.carrier_cd, T1.tot_ship, COALESCE(T2.deliv_ship, 0) AS deliv_ship FROM CarrierAll AS T1 LEFT JOIN CarrierDeliv AS T2 ON T1.carrier_cd = T2.carrier_cd ORDER BY T1.tot_ship DESC, T1.carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: Compare order volume through WEB versus APP: compute total order amount for WEB orders and total order amount for APP orders in a single comparison row, showing WEB revenue, APP revenue, and the ratio of WEB revenue to APP revenue.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS web_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'APP' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS app_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'APP' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS web_to_app_ratio FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31';

items.question: Track the conversion funnel for orders placed on 2026-01-08: show total orders placed, total orders that had at least one payment attempt, and total orders that resulted in a shipment.
items.sql: WITH DayOrders AS (SELECT ord_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-01-08'), PaidOrders AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.ord_id FROM DayOrders AS T1 JOIN payment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id), ShippedOrders AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.ord_id FROM DayOrders AS T1 JOIN shipment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DayOrders) AS placed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PaidOrders) AS paid_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ShippedOrders) AS shipped_count;

items.question: For each payment method, calculate its percentage share of the total settled payment amount across all methods for payments in USD. Show method code, settled amount for the method, total settled USD amount, and percentage share.
items.sql: WITH MethodUSD AS (SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS meth_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd), TotalUSD AS (SELECT SUM(pay_amt) AS tot_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S') SELECT T1.method_cd, T1.meth_amt, T2.tot_amt, (T1.meth_amt * 100.0 / T2.tot_amt) AS share_pct FROM MethodUSD AS T1 CROSS JOIN TotalUSD AS T2 ORDER BY share_pct DESC, T1.method_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders that used each promotion since 2026-01-01, ordered by the count descending then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC, T1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion name and the total order amount generated by orders using each promotion in the year 2026, sorted by the total amount descending then promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt * T4.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id JOIN fx_rate AS T4 ON T3.currency_cd = T4.currency_cd AND T3.ord_dt = T4.eff_dt WHERE T3.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T3.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY T1.promo_nm ORDER BY total_usd DESC, T1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion code and the average order amount for orders applied with each promotion code where the average amount exceeds 200, ordered by the average amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, AVG(T3.ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.promo_cd HAVING AVG(T3.ord_total_amt) > 200.00 ORDER BY avg_amt DESC;

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of unique customers who used each promotion, ordered by the customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.cust_id) AS cust_count FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY cust_count DESC;

items.question: Show the promotion name for promotions that have never been applied to any order, ordered by the promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm FROM promo WHERE promo_id NOT IN (SELECT promo_id FROM ord_promo) ORDER BY promo_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the event type and the count of website events recorded in the APP channel during November 2025, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY event_count DESC;

items.question: Show the SKU and the count of website view events for each product in December 2025, ordered by the view count descending, limiting to the top 5.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND sku IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 5;

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of purchase events originating from web sessions that included a cart addition event, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count FROM web_event WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART') AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY session_count DESC;

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of customer segment history records for the month of July 2026, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) AS segment_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY segment_count DESC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who were in the VIP segment in October 2026, ordered by the customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND T2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of distinct customers who held that segment at least once during 2026, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_cust_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY distinct_cust_count DESC;

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the count of customers in each tier who were classified as VIP in September 2026, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.tier_cd, COUNT(T1.cust_id) AS vip_count FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND T2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' GROUP BY T1.tier_cd ORDER BY vip_count DESC;

items.question: Show the sales region code and the count of active customers in each region, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_count DESC;

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the average total order amount for orders placed by customers in each tier during 2026, ordered by the average amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.tier_cd, AVG(T2.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY T1.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_ord_amt DESC;

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders for promotions where the discount percentage is greater than 15.00, ordered by the promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id WHERE T1.disc_pct > 15.00 GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY T1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion name and its discount percentage for promotions active on 2026-04-01, ordered by the discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2026-04-01' AND ends_dt >= '2026-04-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC;

items.question: Show the session ID and the count of events in each session for sessions recorded on 2025-11-09, ordered by the event count descending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-09 23:59:59' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY event_count DESC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and the total number of website events for customers who logged in and generated more than 2 events in November 2025, ordered by the total events descending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY event_count DESC;

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of distinct customer IDs that performed a purchase event through the WEB channel in 2025, ordered by the customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS cust_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY cust_count DESC;

items.question: Show the month date and the count of customer segment history records for the 'RISK' segment across all months, ordered by the month date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'RISK' GROUP BY month_dt ORDER BY month_dt ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who have never been assigned a segment in the customer segment history table, ordered by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist) ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion name and the number of distinct orders associated with each promotion, restricted to promotions starting in 2025, ordered by the order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, COUNT(T2.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM promo AS T1 LEFT JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id WHERE T1.starts_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND T1.starts_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY T1.promo_nm ORDER BY ord_count DESC;

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of orders placed using that channel that also applied any promotion during the first quarter of 2026, ordered by the order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ord_id) AS promo_order_count FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY T1.channel_cd ORDER BY promo_order_count DESC;

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the total number of customers in each tier, ordered by the total count descending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and current total on-hand quantity for every product stored in the Newark Hub warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm, T1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku INNER JOIN warehouse AS T3 ON T1.wh_id = T3.wh_id WHERE T3.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub'

items.question: List the supplier name and lead days for every supplier providing the product with SKU 'ELC-024', ordering the output from longest lead time to shortest, and breaking ties by supplier name alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, T2.lead_days FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T2.sku = 'ELC-024' ORDER BY T2.lead_days DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for all products in the electronics category code that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0

items.question: List the warehouse name and the count of inventory items currently held in each warehouse located in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and on-hand quantity for any product where the current stock is at or below its defined reorder point across all warehouses, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm, T1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.on_hand_qty <= T1.reorder_pt ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the movement type and the sum of units moved for all stock movements that occurred in the Rotterdam Hub warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT T1.mv_type, SUM(T1.qty) FROM inv_move AS T1 INNER JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.wh_nm = 'Rotterdam Hub' GROUP BY T1.mv_type

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price of products that are supplied by the supplier named 'Orion Electronics'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku INNER JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T3.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics'

items.question: List the SKU and total absolute quantity moved for every product that had an adjustment movement type ('ADJ'), ordered by total adjusted quantity descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_adj_qty DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the total units currently on hand for all products in the kitchen category code ('KIT') stored in that warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm

items.question: Find the supplier name that provides the highest number of distinct products in the catalog, showing the supplier name and their product count.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS prod_count FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY prod_count DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: List each product SKU and its primary supplier's name for all products where the primary supplier is located in the United States ('US').
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T3.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T1.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T1.is_primary = 1 AND T3.country = 'US'

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the count of inbound stock movements ('IN') that occurred in October 2025 (between '2025-10-01' and '2025-10-31').
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, COUNT(T2.mv_id) FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inv_move AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.mv_type = 'IN' AND T2.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND T2.mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm

items.question: Find all products whose list price is strictly greater than the average list price of all products within their respective category code. Show the SKU, product name, category code, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.categ_cd, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE T1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(T2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS T2 WHERE T2.categ_cd = T1.categ_cd)

items.question: List the warehouse name and the percentage of its inventory items that currently have an on-hand quantity at or below their reorder point, ordered by the percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.on_hand_qty <= T2.reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(T2.sku) AS low_stock_pct FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY low_stock_pct DESC

items.question: Identify the top 3 warehouses by total current on-hand inventory units across all products, showing the warehouse name and total units.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC, T1.wh_nm ASC LIMIT 3

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that are supplied by both 'Orion Electronics' and 'Pacific Metalworks'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku INNER JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T1.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T3.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics' AND T1.sku IN (SELECT T4.sku FROM prod_supplier AS T4 INNER JOIN supplier AS T5 ON T4.sup_id = T5.sup_id WHERE T5.sup_nm = 'Pacific Metalworks')

items.question: For each category code, find the product with the highest list price. Show the category code, SKU, product name, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT T1.categ_cd, T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE T1.list_prc = (SELECT MAX(T2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS T2 WHERE T2.categ_cd = T1.categ_cd)

items.question: List the supplier name and the average lead days for all suppliers whose average lead days across their supplied products exceed 25 days, ordered by average lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, AVG(T2.lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm HAVING AVG(T2.lead_days) > 25.0 ORDER BY avg_lead DESC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that appear as an order line item in at least 2 distinct orders.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku GROUP BY T1.sku, T2.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ord_id) >= 2 ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and total quantity ordered across all order lines for the top 5 most frequently ordered products by total units sold.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, SUM(T1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS T1 GROUP BY T1.sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, T1.sku ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products that have never been included in any stock movement record.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE T1.sku NOT IN (SELECT T2.sku FROM inv_move AS T2)

items.question: Find the warehouse name that holds the highest total stock units for products in the electronics category ('ELC'), showing the warehouse name and total units.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) AS total_elc FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_elc DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: List the supplier name and the count of products they are designated as the primary supplier for, ordering by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS primary_count FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_count DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and maximum line unit price ever recorded for any product whose maximum line unit price exceeds 200.00.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm, MAX(T1.unit_prc) AS max_price FROM ord_line AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku GROUP BY T1.sku, T2.prod_nm HAVING MAX(T1.unit_prc) > 200.00 ORDER BY max_price DESC

items.question: Show the product names of electronics that have list prices under 100 dollars and are not discontinued, ordered by list price descending then product name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc < 100.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC;

items.question: List the customer names and their sign-up dates for active platinum tier customers in the North America region, sorted by sign-up date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1 ORDER BY signup_dt ASC;

items.question: What are the distinct order IDs and their order dates for orders placed through the web channel in USD currency with a total amount greater than 500?
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find the SKU and unit price for order lines on order 'O-5001' where the quantity is at least 2, ordered by unit price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' AND qty >= 2 ORDER BY unit_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the full names of employees in the finance department who were hired between 2018-01-01 and 2021-12-31, sorted by hire date.
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN' AND hire_dt BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse names and their region codes for warehouses located in the Asia Pacific or Europe regions.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd IN ('AP', 'EU') ORDER BY region_cd ASC, wh_nm ASC;

items.question: Retrieve the promotion codes and names for promotions that offer a discount percentage of at least 20 percent and are valid as of 2025-12-01.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct >= 20.00 AND starts_dt <= '2025-12-01' AND ends_dt >= '2025-12-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and list price for all home category products whose list price is greater than the average list price of home products.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM') ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Find the customer IDs and names of customers who have placed an order with a total amount over 800 in USD during July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' AND o.ord_total_amt > 800.00 AND o.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: For orders placed in April 2026, show the order ID, order total amount, and the count of line items on each order.
items.sql: SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt, COUNT(l.line_no) AS line_count FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt ORDER BY line_count DESC, h.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the product name and total ordered quantity across all order lines for products in the kitchen category.
items.sql: SELECT p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, p.prod_nm ASC;

items.question: List the customer names who have both gold tier status and placed at least one order using the app channel.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'G' AND o.channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: Find the SKUs of products that have a stock movement of type 'OUT' with a quantity less than -3.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND qty < -3 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Show the currency code and the maximum order total amount for each currency among orders placed in the year 2026.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY max_total DESC;

items.question: List the SKUs of products that have been ordered in order line quantities greater than 3 but have never been included in any refund request (via their order).
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.sku FROM ord_line l WHERE l.qty > 3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refund_req r WHERE r.ord_id = l.ord_id) ORDER BY l.sku ASC;

items.question: Find the customer IDs and names of customers who placed orders in both April 2026 and June 2026.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o1 WHERE o1.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30') ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKUs of products that appear in the product catalog with list prices above 100 and also have inventory records where the on-hand quantity is below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > 100.00 AND p.sku IN (SELECT i.sku FROM inventory i WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt) ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the customer IDs of customers who have signed up in 2022 and placed an order via the store channel, excluding any customers who have raised a support ticket in the billing category.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND o.channel_cd = 'STR' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM support_tkt t WHERE t.cust_id = c.cust_id AND t.categ_cd = 'BILL') ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Retrieve the order IDs that had a payment attempt with status 'S' (settled) and an order total amount greater than the average order total of all orders.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT h.ord_id FROM ord_hdr h JOIN payment p ON h.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE p.pay_status = 'S' AND h.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY h.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find the product names of electronics products that have a list price greater than 50 and are supplied by supplier ID 1.
items.sql: SELECT p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND p.list_prc > 50.00 AND ps.sup_id = 1 ORDER BY p.list_prc DESC, p.prod_nm ASC;

items.question: List the customer names who have active status in the Asia Pacific region and have at least one web event of type 'PURCHASE'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN web_event w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'AP' AND w.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total inventory on hand quantity for warehouses that hold products from the office category.
items.sql: SELECT i.wh_id, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'OFC' GROUP BY i.wh_id ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, i.wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the order IDs and total amounts for orders that have a refund request approved by employee 'E-002'.
items.sql: SELECT h.ord_id, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN refund_req r ON h.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' AND r.approver_emp_id = 'E-002' ORDER BY h.ord_total_amt DESC, h.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find the SKUs and product names of items that have been ordered with a discount percentage greater than 10 percent on any order line.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE l.disc_pct > 10.00 ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id and name for anyone who bought both the product SKU 'ELC-024' and 'ELC-025'. List them by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN ord_line AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.sku = 'ELC-024' AND T1.cust_id IN (SELECT T4.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS T4 JOIN ord_line AS T5 ON T4.ord_id = T5.ord_id WHERE T5.sku = 'ELC-025') ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Give me the customer id and name for people who placed an order via the web channel ('WEB') but never ordered through the app channel ('APP'), ordered by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT T3.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS T3 WHERE T3.channel_cd = 'APP') ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Which customer IDs and names placed orders using either currency 'EUR' or 'GBP'? Return distinct rows sorted by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.currency_cd = 'EUR' UNION SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.currency_cd = 'GBP' ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the employee id and full name for support staff in department 'SUP' who have at least one direct report. Sort by employee id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.mgr_emp_id WHERE T1.dept_cd = 'SUP' ORDER BY T1.emp_id ASC;

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of items that appear in order lines for both order 'O-5001' and order 'O-5003'. Sort by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.ord_id = 'O-5001' AND T1.sku IN (SELECT T3.sku FROM ord_line AS T3 WHERE T3.ord_id = 'O-5003') ORDER BY T1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the customer ID and name for customers who have raised support tickets categorized as 'TECH' but never raised any categorized as 'BILL'. Order by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN support_tkt AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.categ_cd = 'TECH' AND T1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT T3.cust_id FROM support_tkt AS T3 WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'BILL') ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for items that have a list price over 30.00 and are not discontinued (disc_flag = 0). Sort by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 30.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for facilities located in region 'NA' or 'EU', ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' OR region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the refund request ID, order ID, and refund amount for all requests that were approved (status_cd = 'A') and decided by employee 'E-003'. Order by refund ID.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND approver_emp_id = 'E-003' ORDER BY rfd_id ASC;

items.question: Give me the employee ID and full name of employees hired between '2019-01-01' and '2020-12-31' who belong to department 'FIN'. Order by hire date then employee id.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN' AND hire_dt BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_id ASC;

items.question: List the customer ID and name of customers who placed orders in region 'AP' and have a loyalty tier of 'P'. Sort by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'AP' AND T1.tier_cd = 'P' ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion ID, promotion name, and discount percentage for active promotions starting on or after '2025-11-01'. Order by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY promo_id ASC;

items.question: Find the order ID and order total amount for orders that used currency 'USD' and were placed through channel 'WEB' on '2026-04-03'. Order by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the support ticket ID and customer ID for tickets that have a severity level of 1 and were opened via channel 'APP'. Order by ticket ID.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY tkt_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for products in category 'ELC' that have a list price under 50.00. Order by list price descending then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc < 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who signed up in 2022 (from '2022-01-01' to '2022-12-31') and are currently active (is_actv = 1). Order by signup date then customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Give me the SKU and product name for products supplied by supplier ID 1 that have a lead time of 6 days or less. Order by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 1 AND T1.lead_days <= 6 ORDER BY T1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find the shipment ID, order ID, and carrier code for shipments handled by carrier 'UPS' that were delivered on or after '2025-11-01'. Order by shipment ID.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, carrier_cd FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND deliv_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY ship_id ASC;

items.question: Show the payment attempt ID, order ID, and payment amount for successful credit card payments (method_cd = 'CC' and pay_status = 'S') where the amount exceeds 100.00. Order by payment attempt ID.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'S' AND pay_amt > 100.00 ORDER BY pay_id ASC;

items.question: List the refund request ID and refund amount for requests with reason code 'DMG' that asked for more than 50.00. Order by refund amount descending then refund ID.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND rfd_amt > 50.00 ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC;

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name of employees who have never been assigned as an approver for any refund request. Order by employee ID.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT approver_emp_id FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id ASC;

items.question: Find the SKU, warehouse ID, and on hand quantity for inventory records where the current stock is at or below the reorder point (on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt). Order by SKU then warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the ticket ID and customer ID for support tickets that have no associated ticket events recorded in the tkt_event table. Order by ticket ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.tkt_id, T1.cust_id FROM support_tkt AS T1 WHERE T1.tkt_id NOT IN (SELECT T2.tkt_id FROM tkt_event AS T2) ORDER BY T1.tkt_id ASC;

items.question: List the supplier ID, supplier name, and country for all suppliers located in country 'US' or 'CA'. Order by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' OR country = 'CA' ORDER BY sup_id ASC;

items.question: Can you list the shipment ID, order ID, and warehouse ID for all shipments handled by the UPS carrier that were dispatched on or after 2026-05-01?
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND ship_dt >= '2026-05-01';

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for facilities located in the North America region (NA code).
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: Give me the SKU and on-hand quantity for every product stored in warehouse W1 where the on-hand stock is lower than its reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt;

items.question: Find all payment attempts made using PayPal (PP) with a payment amount greater than 200.00, returning the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'PP' AND pay_amt > 200.00;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for all items in the electronics category (ELC) that are currently not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0;

items.question: What are the order ID, order date, and total amount for orders placed through the web channel (WEB) during April 2026?
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30';

items.question: List the SKU, movement ID, and moved quantity for all stock adjustments (ADJ) recorded in inventory movements.
items.sql: SELECT sku, mv_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ';

items.question: Show the shipment ID and delivery date for all shipments assigned to warehouse W2 that have successfully been marked as delivered (D status), ordered by delivery date ascending then shipment ID descending.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND ship_status = 'D' ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC, ship_id DESC;

items.question: For each carrier code, count the total number of shipments and show the carrier code along with that count, sorted from highest to lowest count.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the warehouse ID and the total current on-hand quantity of all inventory items combined for each warehouse, returning warehouse ID and total stock.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC;

items.question: Retrieve the order ID and payment amount for the single highest settled payment (S status) recorded in the payment table.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC LIMIT 1;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that are supplied by supplier ID 1 as their primary supplier.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sup_id = 1 AND t1.is_primary = 1;

items.question: Calculate the average order total amount for each sales channel in the order header table, showing the channel code and average amount.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_order_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY avg_order_amt DESC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name of items that had at least one inventory movement of type 'OUT' with a quantity less than -3.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.mv_type = 'OUT' AND t1.qty < -3 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find SKUs that have current inventory stock in both warehouse W1 and warehouse W2, returning the SKU ordered alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku FROM inventory AS t1 WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS t2 WHERE t2.wh_id = 'W2' AND t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Identify SKUs that appear in inventory at warehouse W1 but do NOT have any inventory record in warehouse W2, showing the SKU and its W1 on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS t2 WHERE t2.wh_id = 'W2' AND t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: List SKUs that are stocked in either warehouse W3 or warehouse W4 (or both), without duplication, returning the SKU and warehouse ID sorted by SKU then warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W3' UNION SELECT sku, wh_id FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W4' ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Find all products (SKU and product name) that have a list price greater than 80.00 and were also ordered in at least one order line with a quantity of 3 or more.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.list_prc > 80.00 AND t2.qty >= 3 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find the order ID and sum of payment amounts for orders that received multiple payment attempts, returning order ID and total paid.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_paid FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY total_paid DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the count of distinct shipments handled by each warehouse where the carrier is either 'DHL' or 'UPS'.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ship_id) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd IN ('DHL', 'UPS') GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY shipment_count DESC;

items.question: Retrieve the SKU and product name for products whose list price is strictly higher than the average list price of all products in the same category.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = t1.categ_cd) ORDER BY t1.categ_cd ASC, t1.list_prc DESC;

items.question: List the order ID, shipment ID, and carrier code for orders placed in EUR currency that were shipped via 'FDX' from warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t2.ship_id, t2.carrier_cd FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN shipment AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.currency_cd = 'EUR' AND t2.carrier_cd = 'FDX' AND t2.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC;

items.question: Find the customer ID and total order amount for customers who placed orders totaling more than 1000.00 USD across all their USD orders.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS cumulative_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY cust_id HAVING cumulative_amt > 1000.00 ORDER BY cumulative_amt DESC;

items.question: For every warehouse, show its warehouse ID and the total absolute quantity of inventory movements (both positive and negative) that were recorded as 'OUT' or 'IN'.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_moved_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_moved_qty DESC;

items.question: Show the customer id and name for all customers in the NA region who are currently in the VIP segment as of '2026-10-01'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'NA' AND T2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'VIP'

items.question: List the promotion id and name for any promotion that was applied to at least one order placed through the store channel ('STR').
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.promo_id, T1.promo_nm FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.channel_cd = 'STR'

items.question: Find the customer id and name of customers who made a purchase using the web channel ('WEB') but never used the app channel ('APP') across all web events.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 WHERE T1.cust_id IN (SELECT T2.cust_id FROM web_event AS T2 WHERE T2.channel_cd = 'WEB') AND T1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT T3.cust_id FROM web_event AS T3 WHERE T3.channel_cd = 'APP')

items.question: Show the promotion code and name for promotions that ran starting on or after '2026-01-01' and offered a discount percentage greater than 15.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer id and name for customers who had a website event of type 'CART' in '2025-11' and also had a website event of type 'PURCHASE' in '2025-11'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.evt_type = 'CART' AND T2.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T2.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND T1.cust_id IN (SELECT T3.cust_id FROM web_event AS T3 WHERE T3.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND T3.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T3.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00')

items.question: Show the channel code and the total order amount for orders placed in Q2 2026 (from '2026-04-01' to '2026-06-30') grouped by channel.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and name for active customers in the AP region who signed up during 2022.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: List promotion codes that were used on orders placed on '2026-04-03' or orders placed on '2026-04-04', returning distinct promotion codes.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.promo_cd FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' UNION SELECT DISTINCT T1.promo_cd FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt = '2026-04-04' ORDER BY promo_cd ASC

items.question: Find customers who were in the 'VIP' segment in June 2026 ('2026-06-01') and also in the 'VIP' segment in July 2026 ('2026-07-01').
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND T1.cust_id IN (SELECT T3.cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist AS T3 WHERE T3.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND T3.segment_cd = 'VIP')

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the count of customers in each tier for active customers in the EU region.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' AND is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, tier_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer id and name for customers who placed at least one order using the phone channel ('PHN') and also had at least one support ticket assigned a severity level of 1.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN support_tkt AS T3 ON T1.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T2.channel_cd = 'PHN' AND T3.sev_lvl = 1

items.question: Find the customer id and name of customers who have placed an order in currency 'USD' but have never placed an order in currency 'EUR'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 WHERE T1.cust_id IN (SELECT T2.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS T2 WHERE T2.currency_cd = 'USD') AND T1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT T3.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS T3 WHERE T3.currency_cd = 'EUR')

items.question: Show the promotion name and discount percentage for promotions that end after '2026-06-01' and have a discount percentage of at least 20.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE ends_dt > '2026-06-01' AND disc_pct >= 20.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm ASC

items.question: List the promotion id and name for promotions that were applied to orders placed on '2026-01-08' and also applied to orders placed on '2026-02-23'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_id, T1.promo_nm FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt = '2026-01-08' AND T1.promo_id IN (SELECT T4.promo_id FROM ord_promo AS T4 JOIN ord_hdr AS T5 ON T4.ord_id = T5.ord_id WHERE T5.ord_dt = '2026-02-23')

items.question: Show the segment code and count of customer segment history records for the month of '2026-09-01'.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-09-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, segment_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and name for customers who signed up in the LA region with a platinum tier code ('P').
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'LA' AND tier_cd = 'P' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: List promotion codes that were used either in web events with channel 'APP' or in orders with channel 'APP'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.promo_cd FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.channel_cd = 'APP' UNION SELECT DISTINCT T1.promo_cd FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN web_event AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY promo_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and name of customers who had a segment history record of 'REG' in '2026-07-01' but were never in the 'VIP' segment on any recorded month.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'REG' AND T1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT T3.cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist AS T3 WHERE T3.segment_cd = 'VIP')

items.question: Show the order status and count of orders for orders placed on or after '2026-01-01'.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ord_status ASC

items.question: List the customer id and name for customers who triggered a 'VIEW' web event and a 'PURCHASE' web event within the same session ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.cust_id IS NOT NULL AND T2.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND T2.session_id IN (SELECT T3.session_id FROM web_event AS T3 WHERE T3.evt_type = 'PURCHASE')

items.question: Show the channel code and count of web events recorded for channel 'APP' or 'WEB' where the customer id is not null.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND channel_cd IN ('APP', 'WEB') GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and name for all customers whose name starts with 'Elena'.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_nm LIKE 'Elena%' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: List promotion ids that are associated with orders placed in the 'NA' region and also associated with orders placed in the 'EU' region.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.promo_id FROM ord_promo AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id JOIN cust_master AS T3 ON T2.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T3.region_cd = 'NA' AND T1.promo_id IN (SELECT T4.promo_id FROM ord_promo AS T4 JOIN ord_hdr AS T5 ON T4.ord_id = T5.ord_id JOIN cust_master AS T6 ON T5.cust_id = T6.cust_id WHERE T6.region_cd = 'EU')

items.question: Show the promotion code and discount percentage for promotions that start before '2026-02-01' and end after '2026-02-01'.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt < '2026-02-01' AND ends_dt > '2026-02-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC
