items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and list price for all electronics products in the ELC category that have never been moved in or out of any warehouse since 2025-10-01, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku AND t2.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00') ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items supplied by both supplier ID 1 and supplier ID 6, sorted by product name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sup_id = 1 AND t1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 6) ORDER BY t2.prod_nm ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold inventory for every single product in the HOM category, sorted by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT t2.sku FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT t3.sku FROM inventory AS t3 WHERE t3.wh_id = t1.wh_id AND t3.sku = t2.sku)) ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the product SKU and product name of items that are supplied by supplier ID 3 but are not stocked in the Newark Hub warehouse (wh_id 'W1'), ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sup_id = 3 AND t1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1') ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for all products that have had at least one stock movement of type 'OUT' and at least one stock movement of type 'IN' since 2025-10-01, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku AND t2.mv_type = 'OUT' AND t2.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.mv_type = 'IN' AND t3.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00') ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide at least one product from category 'KIT' and at least one product from category 'ELC', ordered by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier AS t2 JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t2.sup_id = t1.sup_id AND t3.categ_cd = 'KIT') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier AS t4 JOIN prod_catalog AS t5 ON t4.sku = t5.sku WHERE t4.sup_id = t1.sup_id AND t5.categ_cd = 'ELC') ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that have stock movements recorded for product 'ELC-026' or product 'ELC-027', ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku IN ('ELC-026', 'ELC-027') ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name of items that appear in order line items with a quantity greater than 3, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.qty > 3 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name of discontinued products (disc_flag = 1) that still have an on-hand inventory quantity greater than 0 in any warehouse, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.disc_flag = 1 AND t2.on_hand_qty > 0 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that have a list price greater than 50.00 and are provided by supplier ID 5, ordered by list price descending, then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.list_prc > 50.00 AND t2.sup_id = 5 ORDER BY t1.list_prc DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and total on-hand inventory quantity across all products for each warehouse, ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID, supplier name, and count of products they supply as the primary supplier (is_primary = 1), ordered by the product count descending, then supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS primary_prod_cnt FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_prod_cnt DESC, t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products where the sum of their inventory on-hand quantity across all warehouses is less than 500, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm HAVING SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) < 500 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the region code and count of warehouses in each region, ordered by the warehouse count descending, then region code.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(wh_id) AS wh_cnt FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY wh_cnt DESC, region_cd ASC

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and maximum lead days among all suppliers who provide each product, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, MAX(t2.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and average reorder point for products stored in each warehouse, sorted by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, AVG(t2.reorder_pt) AS avg_reorder_pt FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items whose on-hand quantity in warehouse 'W1' is strictly less than their reorder point in that same warehouse, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.wh_id = 'W1' AND t2.on_hand_qty < t2.reorder_pt ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide products in both the 'HOM' category and the 'OFC' category, ordered by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND t1.sup_id IN (SELECT t4.sup_id FROM prod_supplier AS t4 JOIN prod_catalog AS t5 ON t4.sku = t5.sku WHERE t5.categ_cd = 'OFC') ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that have stock movements of type 'ADJ' but have never had any stock movement of type 'OUT', ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku AND t2.mv_type = 'ADJ') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.mv_type = 'OUT') ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the category code and average list price for each product category, ordered by average list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products supplied by supplier ID 1 or supplier ID 2 that have a list price above 75.00, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.sup_id IN (1, 2) AND t1.list_prc > 75.00 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold inventory for product 'ELC-024' and also hold inventory for product 'ELC-025', ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-024' AND t1.wh_id IN (SELECT wh_id FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'ELC-025') ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that are stocked in warehouse 'W2' but are not supplied by supplier ID 2, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W2' AND t1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 2) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and count of distinct product categories they supply, ordered by category count descending, then supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.categ_cd) AS categ_cnt FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY categ_cnt DESC, t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer name, order ID, and order total for every order placed in 2026 where the total amount was higher than the average order total for that specific customer. Order by customer name alphabetically, then order ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_id, t2.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND t2.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t3 WHERE t3.cust_id = t2.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC, t2.ord_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for all products whose list price is strictly above the average list price of products in their respective category. Sort the result by category code and then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = t1.categ_cd) ORDER BY t1.categ_cd ASC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find customers in the Europe sales region who have never placed a single order through the mobile app channel. Show customer ID and customer name, sorted by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_hdr.cust_id = cust_master.cust_id AND ord_hdr.channel_cd = 'APP') ORDER BY cust_nm ASC

items.question: Retrieve the order ID and order total amount for the single largest order placed by each platinum tier customer. Show order ID and order total, sorted by order total descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.tier_cd = 'P' AND t1.ord_total_amt = (SELECT MAX(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t3 WHERE t3.cust_id = t1.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and list price of the most expensive product in the electronics category. Order by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc = (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC') ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for all gold tier customers who signed up before July 2022. Sort by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' AND signup_dt < '2022-07-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Identify orders where every single line item on the order had a unit price greater than 100 USD. Show order ID and order total amount, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line AS t2 WHERE t2.ord_id = t1.ord_id AND t2.unit_prc <= 100.00) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line AS t3 WHERE t3.ord_id = t1.ord_id) ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Get the SKU, unit price, and discount percentage for all order lines associated with order O-5001, sorted by line number.
items.sql: SELECT sku, unit_prc, disc_pct FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' ORDER BY line_no ASC

items.question: Find customers who placed an order in July 2026 where the order total exceeded the overall average order total for that specific month. Show customer ID, customer name, and order total, sorted by order total descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' AND t2.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t3 WHERE t3.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31') ORDER BY t2.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the currency code and the maximum rate to_usd recorded for each currency across all effective dates. Sort by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, MAX(rate_to_usd) FROM fx_rate GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC

items.question: List all active customers in the North America region who have placed at least three orders in total. Show customer ID and customer name, sorted by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 WHERE t1.region_cd = 'NA' AND t1.is_actv = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id) >= 3 ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Retrieve the SKU and product name of products that appear in the order lines with the highest quantity ordered for their respective SKUs. Order by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.qty = (SELECT MAX(t3.qty) FROM ord_line AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the order ID, order date, and order total amount for the most recent order placed by customer C-1006. Sort by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006' AND ord_dt = (SELECT MAX(ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006') ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID, customer name, and loyalty tier for all customers who have never had any cancelled orders. Sort by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_hdr.cust_id = cust_master.cust_id AND ord_hdr.ord_status = 'C') ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for all discontinued products in the home category. Sort by list price descending, then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the code value and code description from the code lookup table for all entries belonging to the sales region code type. Sort by code value.
items.sql: SELECT code_val, code_desc FROM code_lookup WHERE code_type = 'REGION' ORDER BY code_val ASC

items.question: Identify orders where the order total amount is strictly greater than the sum of all line item totals (unit price multiplied by quantity) for that order. Show order ID and order total amount, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT SUM(t2.unit_prc * t2.qty) FROM ord_line AS t2 WHERE t2.ord_id = t1.ord_id) ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who registered in the Asia Pacific region. Sort by signup date ascending, then customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all products whose list price is higher than the maximum list price of any product in the kitchen category. Show SKU, product name, and list price, sorted by list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT') ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Retrieve the currency code, effective date, and exchange rate to USD for all currency records where the rate is exactly 1.000000. Sort by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, eff_dt, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE rate_to_usd = 1.000000 ORDER BY currency_cd ASC

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for orders placed using the web channel in 2026 where the order total is higher than the average order total for web channel orders in that same year. Sort by order total descending, then order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and category code for products that have never appeared in any order line. Sort by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line WHERE ord_line.sku = prod_catalog.sku) ORDER BY SKU ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID, customer name, and region code for customers whose signup date matches the earliest signup date in their respective region. Sort by region code, then customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.region_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 WHERE t1.signup_dt = (SELECT MIN(t2.signup_dt) FROM cust_master AS t2 WHERE t2.region_cd = t1.region_cd) ORDER BY t1.region_cd ASC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the order ID, order status, and order total amount for all orders that have a status of delivered. Sort by order total amount descending, then order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_status, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the support ticket id and opened timestamp for all tickets in the shipping category opened after 2026-04-05.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'SHIP' AND opened_ts > '2026-04-05 00:00:00'

items.question: List the employee id and full name for every employee hired in the support department before 2020-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'SUP' AND hire_dt < '2020-01-01'

items.question: Retrieve the order id and order total amount for orders placed through the web channel with a status of delivered.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'D'

items.question: Find the refund request id and refund amount for requests where the reason code is damaged and the status is approved.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND status_cd = 'A'

items.question: Display the customer id and customer name for platinum tier customers located in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: Get the rule key and rule value from policy rules that were in force during 2025.
items.sql: SELECT rule_key, rule_val FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2025-12-31' AND (eff_to >= '2025-01-01' OR eff_to IS NULL)

items.question: List the ticket id and customer id for support tickets assigned to employee E-007 that have not been closed yet.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id = 'E-007' AND closed_ts IS NULL

items.question: Show the order id and order date for orders whose total amount is greater than 500.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 500.00

items.question: Find the employee id and full name of employees in the billing department whose direct manager is employee E-002.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'BIL' AND mgr_emp_id = 'E-002'

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who have placed at least one order through the mobile app channel.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd = 'APP'

items.question: Show the support ticket id and count of events for tickets that have logged more than 2 history events.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM tkt_event GROUP BY tkt_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

items.question: Retrieve the refund request id and requested amount for refund requests decided by employee E-003 with an approved status.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id = 'E-003' AND status_cd = 'A'

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who raised support tickets categorized under billing but never raised any refund requests.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.categ_cd = 'BILL' AND c.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN refund_req rr ON oh.ord_id = rr.ord_id)

items.question: Show the employee id and full name of employees who approved at least one refund request where the requested amount exceeded 100.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN refund_req r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.rfd_amt > 100.00

items.question: Find the ticket category code and the total number of support tickets opened for each category in April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY categ_cd

items.question: List the order id and order total amount for orders that used the payment method card and were successfully settled.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE p.method_cd = 'CC' AND p.pay_status = 'S'

items.question: Find support tickets that took longer than the critical ticket SLA hours defined in the policy rules during April 2026. Return the ticket id and customer id.
items.sql: SELECT s.tkt_id, s.cust_id FROM support_tkt s JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'sla_hours_sev1' AND s.opened_ts >= p.eff_from AND (s.opened_ts <= p.eff_to OR p.eff_to IS NULL) WHERE s.sev_lvl = 1 AND s.closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, s.opened_ts, s.closed_ts) > CAST(p.rule_val AS SIGNED)

items.question: List refund requests where the requested amount is strictly greater than the average refund request amount for the same reason code. Return the refund request id, reason code, and requested amount.
items.sql: SELECT r.rfd_id, r.reason_cd, r.rfd_amt FROM refund_req r WHERE r.rfd_amt > (SELECT AVG(r2.rfd_amt) FROM refund_req r2 WHERE r2.reason_cd = r.reason_cd)

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers whose latest order total amount exceeds the average order total of all orders placed by customers in the same region. Order by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_id = (SELECT o2.ord_id FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = c.cust_id ORDER BY o2.ord_dt DESC, o2.ord_id DESC LIMIT 1) AND o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(o3.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o3 JOIN cust_master c3 ON o3.cust_id = c3.cust_id WHERE c3.region_cd = c.region_cd) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the order id and order total amount for orders whose total amount is higher than every order placed by customer C-1001. Sort by order total amount descending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > (SELECT MAX(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001') ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find employees who have never been assigned a single support ticket. Return the employee id and full name, ordered by employee id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM support_tkt WHERE support_tkt.assigned_emp_id = emp.emp_id) ORDER BY emp_id ASC

items.question: List support tickets that received an escalation event in their history. Return the ticket id, customer id, and opened timestamp, ordered by opened timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.tkt_id, s.cust_id, s.opened_ts FROM support_tkt s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tkt_event te WHERE te.tkt_id = s.tkt_id AND te.evt_type = 'ESCAL') ORDER BY s.opened_ts ASC

items.question: Identify refund requests that required manager approval because their requested amount exceeded the active policy threshold rule of 'refund_approval_threshold' on their request date. Return the refund request id, request date, and requested amount.
items.sql: SELECT r.rfd_id, r.req_dt, r.rfd_amt FROM refund_req r JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND r.req_dt >= p.eff_from AND (r.req_dt <= p.eff_to OR p.eff_to IS NULL) WHERE r.rfd_amt > CAST(p.rule_val AS DECIMAL(10,2))

items.question: Find customers who have placed orders across multiple different channels. Return the customer id and customer name, sorted by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.channel_cd) > 1 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Which warehouses in the NA region have items where the current on-hand quantity is below the reorder point? Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and SKU, sorted by warehouse ID ascending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T2.wh_nm, T1.sku FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.region_cd = 'NA' AND T1.on_hand_qty <= T1.reorder_pt ORDER BY T1.wh_id ASC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: Find all shipments managed by the DHL carrier that were delivered after 2026-04-01. Show the shipment ID, order ID, and delivery date, ordered by delivery date descending then shipment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND deliv_dt > '2026-04-01' ORDER BY deliv_dt DESC, ship_id ASC

items.question: What are the IDs and names of products that have never had a stock movement of type 'OUT'? List them alphabetically by product name, showing the SKU and product name.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') ORDER BY prod_nm ASC

items.question: Show the count of payment attempts and the sum of payment amounts for each payment method that has a settled status ('S') in USD currency. Return the method code, transaction count, and total amount, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, COUNT(pay_id) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC

items.question: For each warehouse, find the highest individual payment amount for orders shipped from that warehouse. Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the maximum payment amount, ordered by the maximum amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT T3.wh_id, T3.wh_nm, MAX(T1.pay_amt) AS max_pay_amt FROM payment AS T1 JOIN shipment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id JOIN warehouse AS T3 ON T2.wh_id = T3.wh_id GROUP BY T3.wh_id, T3.wh_nm ORDER BY max_pay_amt DESC

items.question: Which products have an on-hand quantity in warehouse 'W1' that is strictly greater than the average on-hand quantity across all warehouses for that same SKU? Show the SKU and on-hand quantity, sorted by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS T1 WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS T2 WHERE T2.sku = T1.sku) ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List all inventory records for products belonging to the electronic category ('ELC') that have an on-hand quantity greater than 300. Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity, ordered by on-hand quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.wh_id, T1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND T1.on_hand_qty > 300 ORDER BY T1.on_hand_qty DESC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: Identify the latest shipment date for each carrier code. Show the carrier code and the maximum shipment date, ordered by the carrier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, MAX(ship_dt) AS latest_ship_dt FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY carrier_cd ASC

items.question: Find all payment attempts made using credit cards ('CC') where the payment amount is greater than 200 USD. Show the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount, ordered by payment amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_amt > 200.00 ORDER BY pay_amt DESC

items.question: Find products whose list price is higher than the average list price of all products within their respective category code. Show the SKU, product name, category code, and list price, ordered by category code ascending then list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.categ_cd, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE T1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(T2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS T2 WHERE T2.categ_cd = T1.categ_cd) ORDER BY T1.categ_cd ASC, T1.list_prc DESC

items.question: For each warehouse, count how many shipments were dispatched using the 'UPS' carrier. Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the shipment count, ordered by shipment count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, COUNT(T2.ship_id) AS ups_shipment_cnt FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN shipment AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.carrier_cd = 'UPS' GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY ups_shipment_cnt DESC

items.question: Which orders have multiple payment attempts recorded? Show the order ID and the count of payment attempts, ordered by the count descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(pay_id) AS attempt_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY attempt_count DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: List all warehouse names and their respective region codes where at least one inventory item has an on-hand quantity exceeding 900 units. Show warehouse name and region code, ordered by warehouse name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.wh_nm, T1.region_cd FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.on_hand_qty > 900 ORDER BY T1.wh_nm ASC

items.question: Find the stock movement with the largest negative quantity (greatest out-flow) for each SKU that has experienced an 'OUT' movement. Show the SKU and the minimum quantity, sorted by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, MIN(qty) AS max_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Show all orders placed via the web channel ('WEB') that were shipped from the 'Newark Hub' warehouse. Return the order ID, order date, and shipment date, sorted by order date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.ord_dt, T2.ship_dt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN shipment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id JOIN warehouse AS T3 ON T2.wh_id = T3.wh_id WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T3.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' ORDER BY T1.ord_dt ASC

items.question: Get the total inventory on hand for each product category across all warehouses. Show the category code and the sum of on-hand quantities, ordered by the total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.categ_cd, SUM(T1.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku GROUP BY T2.categ_cd ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC

items.question: Which shipments were delivered on the exact same day they were shipped? Show the shipment ID, order ID, and ship date, ordered by ship date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt = deliv_dt ORDER BY ship_dt ASC

items.question: List the SKUs and product names of items that have a list price greater than 100 USD and are not discontinued (disc_flag = 0). Show SKU and product name, ordered by list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 100.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC

items.question: Find the latest payment attempt timestamp for each order that has a settled payment status ('S'). Show the order ID and the maximum paid timestamp, ordered by order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, MAX(paid_ts) AS latest_paid_ts FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY ord_id ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: For each carrier, count the total number of shipments that are currently in transit ('I'). Show the carrier code and in-transit count, sorted by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(ship_id) AS in_transit_cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'I' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY in_transit_cnt DESC

items.question: Identify orders that have a total amount greater than the average order total for all orders placed through the same sales channel. Show the order ID, channel code, and order total amount, ordered by channel code ascending then order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.channel_cd, T1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 WHERE T1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(T2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS T2 WHERE T2.channel_cd = T1.channel_cd) ORDER BY T1.channel_cd ASC, T1.ord_total_amt DESC

items.question: Show all stock adjustments ('ADJ') where the movement quantity was positive. Return the movement ID, SKU, warehouse ID, and quantity, ordered by movement ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, wh_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty > 0 ORDER BY mv_id ASC

items.question: Find warehouses that hold inventory for every single product present in the product catalog. Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name, ordered by warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT T2.sku FROM prod_catalog AS T2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT T3.sku FROM inventory AS T3 WHERE T3.wh_id = T1.wh_id AND T3.sku = T2.sku)) ORDER BY T1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the SKU, product name, and list price of the single most expensive product in the product catalog.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Can you list the promotion code and promotion name for all promotions that started during 2025?
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND starts_dt <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: What are the session id and customer id for web events on 2025-11-23 that were of type cart? Sort by session id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-23 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-23 23:59:59' AND evt_type = 'CART' ORDER BY session_id ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and signup date for all active customers in the North America region who signed up after July 2022. Order by signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt > '2022-07-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Give me the promotion ID and total number of orders that used each promotion, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, COUNT(ord_id) FROM ord_promo GROUP BY promo_id ORDER BY COUNT(ord_id) DESC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer name and tier code for customers who were in the VIP segment during July 2026. Order by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: What is the average order total amount for orders placed through the web channel in USD during the first half of 2026?
items.sql: SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30'

items.question: List the promotion name and discount percentage for promotions that have never been applied to any order. Order by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, t1.disc_pct FROM promo AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo AS t2 WHERE t2.promo_id = t1.promo_id) ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID and order total amount for the single largest order placed in April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: Show the promotion code, promotion name, and order count for promotions that were applied to more than 1 order. Order by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who have web events of type view but have never placed an order.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr AS t3 WHERE t3.cust_id = t1.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Identify orders whose total amount is strictly greater than the average order total for their respective sales channel during 2026. Return order ID, channel code, and order total amount, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.channel_cd, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND t1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.channel_cd = t1.channel_cd AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID, month date, and segment code for customers whose segment code changed from the previous month in the segment history table. Order by customer ID then month date.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.month_dt, t1.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cust_segment_hist AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id AND t2.month_dt = DATE_SUB(t1.month_dt, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND t2.segment_cd <> t1.segment_cd) ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC, t1.month_dt ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, what is the customer ID and customer name of the customer who signed up earliest? Order by tier code.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 WHERE t1.signup_dt = (SELECT MIN(t2.signup_dt) FROM cust_master AS t2 WHERE t2.tier_cd = t1.tier_cd) ORDER BY t1.tier_cd ASC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the session ID and the count of web events for sessions that had more than 2 distinct event types recorded. Order by event count descending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(DISTINCT evt_type) FROM web_event GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT evt_type) > 2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT evt_type) DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: Which promotion codes were used on orders placed exclusively through the application channel? List the promotion code and promotion name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm HAVING MAX(t3.channel_cd) = 'APP' AND MIN(t3.channel_cd) = 'APP' ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID and customer name for customers who placed orders in every single quarter of 2026 (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Order by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT QUARTER(t2.ord_dt)) FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') = 4 ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and total spend in USD (order total amount) for active customers in the Europe region whose total spend exceeds 500. Order by total spend descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'EU' AND t1.is_actv = 1 AND t2.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY t1.cust_id HAVING SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the promotion name and start date for promotions that started on or after the start date of the 'Black Friday' promotion. Order by start date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, starts_dt FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= (SELECT starts_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_nm = 'Black Friday') ORDER BY starts_dt ASC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID, month date, and segment code for customers who were in the 'REG' segment in June 2026 and 'VIP' segment in July 2026. Order by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.month_dt, t1.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND t1.segment_cd = 'REG' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the order ID and order total amount for orders that used more than 1 promotion. Order by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt HAVING COUNT(t2.promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who have never had a web event of type purchase. Order by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event WHERE web_event.cust_id = cust_master.cust_id AND web_event.evt_type = 'PURCHASE') ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: What is the promotion ID and count of distinct customers who placed orders using each promotion? Order by customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.cust_id) FROM ord_promo AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t2.cust_id) DESC, t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: Identify customers who placed an order in April 2026 and also had a web event of type checkout in April 2026. Return customer ID and customer name, ordered by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN web_event AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' AND t3.evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t3.evt_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND t3.evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: For each sales region, what is the total order amount in USD across all delivered orders placed in 2026? Return region code and total amount, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_status = 'D' AND t2.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.region_cd ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU and list price for any item whose list price is strictly above the average list price of all products in its category, ordered by list price descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = t1.categ_cd) ORDER BY t1.list_prc DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for every inventory record where the on-hand quantity is higher than the average on-hand quantity across all warehouses for that specific product, sorted by SKU then warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.wh_id, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 WHERE t1.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(t2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC, t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Which suppliers provide products with a lead time greater than the average lead time of all suppliers for that exact product? Show supplier ID, SKU, and lead days, ordered by lead days descending, then supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sku, t1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS t1 WHERE t1.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(t2.lead_days) FROM prod_supplier AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.lead_days DESC, t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and order ID of any order line where the unit price is greater than the average unit price of all order lines for that same product, sorted by SKU then order ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.ord_id FROM ord_line AS t1 WHERE t1.unit_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.unit_prc) FROM ord_line AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the supplier ID and supplier name for any supplier whose lead days for product 'ELC-024' are greater than the average lead days for that product across all suppliers who supply it, ordered by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t1.sku = 'ELC-024' AND t1.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(t3.lead_days) FROM prod_supplier AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = 'ELC-024') ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold inventory for at least one product categorized as 'ELC', ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t1.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for all products that are flagged as discontinued, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Display the supplier ID, supplier name, and country for all suppliers located in the United States ('US'), ordered by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Find the warehouse ID and warehouse name for the Newark Hub warehouse, showing its region code.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE wh_nm = 'Newark Hub'

items.question: List the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for inventory records where the current stock is below the reorder point, ordered by SKU ascending, then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products in the kitchen category ('KIT') whose list price is between 50 and 150 dollars inclusive, sorted by list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc BETWEEN 50.00 AND 150.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC

items.question: Get the movement ID, timestamp, and quantity for all stock movements of type 'ADJ' that occurred at warehouse 'W1', ordered by movement timestamp descending, then movement ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY mv_ts DESC, mv_id ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide more than 2 different products, ordered by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(t1.sku) > 2 ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that are supplied by supplier ID 1 as their primary supplier (is_primary = 1), ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sup_id = 1 AND t1.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the category code and the count of products in each category, ordered by the product count descending, then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_cnt FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and total on-hand inventory quantity across all products held in that warehouse, ordered by total quantity descending, then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm, SUM(t1.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the SKU, product name, and maximum list price across the entire product catalog, showing just one row.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Show the supplier ID and average lead days for each supplier, ordered by average lead days ascending, then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY avg_lead ASC, sup_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for any product that has never had any stock movement recorded in the inv_move table, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the supplier ID and supplier name for any supplier who does not supply any products with a lead time greater than 30 days, ordered by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier AS t2 WHERE t2.sup_id = t1.sup_id AND t2.lead_days > 30) ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that are held in every single warehouse in the warehouse table, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.wh_id) FROM inventory AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold inventory for every single product in the product catalog, ordered by warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS t1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.sku) FROM inventory AS t2 WHERE t2.wh_id = t1.wh_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prod_catalog) ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the SKU, warehouse ID, and movement timestamp for the very latest stock movement recorded for each distinct product and warehouse combination, ordered by SKU ascending, then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.wh_id, t1.mv_ts FROM inv_move AS t1 WHERE t1.mv_ts = (SELECT MAX(t2.mv_ts) FROM inv_move AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku AND t2.wh_id = t1.wh_id) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC, t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for the inventory record with the highest on-hand quantity in each warehouse, ordered by warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.wh_id, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 WHERE t1.on_hand_qty = (SELECT MAX(t2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS t2 WHERE t2.wh_id = t1.wh_id) ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Could you list the top 3 customers by total order amount in USD for the NA region, showing the customer ID, customer name, and total amount spent?
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, SUM(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) AS total_spent FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate AS T3 ON T2.currency_cd = T3.currency_cd AND T2.ord_dt >= T3.eff_dt AND T2.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(T3.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE T1.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm ORDER BY total_spent DESC, T1.cust_id ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: For each loyalty tier, what is the customer ID, customer name, and signup date of the customer who signed up first? Show tier code, customer ID, customer name, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM (SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd, signup_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY tier_cd ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) AS rn FROM cust_master) AS sub WHERE rn = 1;

items.question: I need a running total of order amounts in USD for customer C-1001, ordered by the order date and order ID. Show the order date, order ID, order total in USD, and the cumulative total.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_dt, T1.ord_id, (T1.ord_total_amt * T2.rate_to_usd) AS ord_usd, SUM(T1.ord_total_amt * T2.rate_to_usd) OVER(ORDER BY T1.ord_dt ASC, T1.ord_id ASC) AS running_total FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN fx_rate AS T2 ON T1.currency_cd = T2.currency_cd AND T1.ord_dt >= T2.eff_dt AND T1.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(T2.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE T1.cust_id = 'C-1001';

items.question: For each order placed by customer C-1006, show the order ID, order date, current order amount, and the amount of the immediately preceding order by the same customer based on order date.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, LAG(ord_total_amt, 1, 0) OVER(ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS prev_ord_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006';

items.question: What percentage of total global sales (in USD) does each sales region account for? Show the region code and the percentage of total sales.
items.sql: WITH regional_sales AS (SELECT T1.region_cd, SUM(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) AS reg_total FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate AS T3 ON T2.currency_cd = T3.currency_cd AND T2.ord_dt >= T3.eff_dt AND T2.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(T3.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY T1.region_cd), global_sales AS (SELECT SUM(reg_total) AS tot FROM regional_sales) SELECT T1.region_cd, (T1.reg_total / T2.tot) * 100 AS pct_total FROM regional_sales AS T1 JOIN global_sales AS T2 ORDER BY pct_total DESC, T1.region_cd ASC;

items.question: Rank products within each product category by their list price in descending order, and show only those ranked in the top 2. Return category code, SKU, product name, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC) as rnk FROM prod_catalog) AS sub WHERE rnk <= 2;

items.question: For each customer, find their very first order and very last order date. Show the customer ID, first order date, and last order date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, MIN(ord_dt) AS first_ord_dt, MAX(ord_dt) AS last_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show all active customers in the AP region who signed up after July 1st, 2022. Return customer ID and customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP' AND signup_dt > '2022-07-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Find the average list price of products in the electronics category (ELC). Return just the average price.
items.sql: SELECT AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC';

items.question: List all order IDs and their total amounts for orders placed using the WEB channel in USD currency.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_id ASC;

items.question: How many customers are there in each loyalty tier? Show the tier code and the customer count.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products that are currently discontinued (disc_flag = 1).
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Find the total quantity ordered for each SKU across all order lines. Show the SKU and total quantity ordered, sorted by quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: For each sales channel, what is the total revenue generated in the order's native currency? Show channel code and total revenue.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

items.question: Identify the top 5 most expensive products by list price. Show the SKU, product name, category code, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 5;

items.question: Find all customers who have placed at least 2 orders. Show the customer ID and their order count.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(ord_id) >= 2 ORDER BY ord_count DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: What is the total order amount in USD for each order status? Show the order status code and the sum of order amounts converted to USD.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_status, SUM(T1.ord_total_amt * T2.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN fx_rate AS T2 ON T1.currency_cd = T2.currency_cd AND T1.ord_dt >= T2.eff_dt AND T1.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(T2.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY T1.ord_status ORDER BY total_usd DESC;

items.question: List the order ID, line number, SKU, and unit price for all order lines where the discount percentage is greater than 10 percent.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE disc_pct > 10.00 ORDER BY ord_id ASC, line_no ASC;

items.question: Get a count of customers by their sales region and loyalty tier. Show region code, tier code, and customer count.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd, tier_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC, tier_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the maximum and minimum order amount in USD for orders handled through the APP channel.
items.sql: SELECT MAX(T1.ord_total_amt * T2.rate_to_usd) AS max_usd, MIN(T1.ord_total_amt * T2.rate_to_usd) AS min_usd FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN fx_rate AS T2 ON T1.currency_cd = T2.currency_cd AND T1.ord_dt >= T2.eff_dt AND T1.ord_dt < DATE_ADD(T2.eff_dt, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'APP';

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who registered in the year 2022.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Retrieve the SKU and product name for all products in the home category (HOM) with a list price under 50 dollars.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND list_prc < 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: How many orders have been placed in each currency? Show the currency code and the order count.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY ord_count DESC;

items.question: List all distinct sales regions present in the customer master table.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT region_cd FROM cust_master ORDER BY region_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the support ticket id, customer id, and opened timestamp for all tickets opened on 2026-04-01.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE DATE(opened_ts) = '2026-04-01' ORDER BY tkt_id ASC;

items.question: List the refund request id, order id, and requested amount for all pending refunds where the amount exceeds 100.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' AND rfd_amt > 100.00 ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC;

items.question: Show the employee id, full name, and department code for all employees hired before 2020-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE hire_dt < '2020-01-01' ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_id ASC;

items.question: List the customer id, customer name, and signup date for all active customers in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the order id, order date, and total amount for orders placed in 2026 with a status of delivered.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: List the rule key, rule value, and effective from date for all policy rules active as of 2026-04-01.
items.sql: SELECT rule_key, rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2026-04-01' AND (eff_to IS NULL OR eff_to >= '2026-04-01') ORDER BY rule_key ASC;

items.question: Show the category code and the count of support tickets for each category for tickets opened since 2026-04-01, ordered by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: For each employee who approved refunds, show the approver employee id and the total sum of refund amounts they approved.
items.sql: SELECT approver_emp_id, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_approved FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY approver_emp_id ORDER BY total_approved DESC, approver_emp_id ASC;

items.question: List the customer id and the count of orders for each customer who has placed more than one order in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the channel code and the average order total amount for each sales channel for orders placed in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY avg_total DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: List the reason code and the count of refund requests for each reason where the request date is in 2025 or 2026.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(*) AS rfd_cnt FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY rfd_cnt DESC, reason_cd ASC;

items.question: For each severity level, show the severity level and the average duration in hours between opened timestamp and closed timestamp for closed support tickets.
items.sql: SELECT sev_lvl, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts)) AS avg_duration_hrs FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC;

items.question: For each support ticket, find the first event timestamp and the last event timestamp recorded in the ticket history, showing the ticket id, first event timestamp, and last event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, MIN(evt_ts) AS first_evt_ts, MAX(evt_ts) AS last_evt_ts FROM tkt_event GROUP BY tkt_id ORDER BY tkt_id ASC;

items.question: Calculate the running total of refund amounts requested per customer over time, showing customer id, request date, refund amount, and the cumulative refund amount ordered by customer id and request date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, req_dt, rfd_amt, SUM(rfd_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY req_dt ASC, rfd_id ASC) AS running_total FROM (SELECT r.cust_id, rq.req_dt, rq.rfd_amt, rq.rfd_id FROM refund_req rq JOIN ord_hdr r ON rq.ord_id = r.ord_id) sub ORDER BY cust_id ASC, req_dt ASC, rfd_id ASC;

items.question: For each department, find the employee with the earliest hire date. Show the department code, employee id, full name, and hire date, breaking hire date ties by employee id.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, emp_nm, hire_dt FROM (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd, hire_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_cd ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_id ASC) AS rn FROM emp) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_cd ASC;

items.question: For each support ticket, use LAG to find the time difference in minutes between consecutive events, and show the ticket id, event id, current event timestamp, and the previous event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, evt_id, evt_ts, LAG(evt_ts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY tkt_id ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC) AS prev_evt_ts FROM tkt_event ORDER BY tkt_id ASC, evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC;

items.question: For each sales channel, find the single largest order total amount placed in 2026, showing the sales channel code, order id, and order total amount. Break amount ties by order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY channel_cd ASC;

items.question: Calculate the percentage contribution of each refund request amount relative to the total sum of refund amounts for its respective reason code. Show the refund request id, reason code, refund amount, and percentage share.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, reason_cd, rfd_amt, (rfd_amt * 100.0 / SUM(rfd_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_cd)) AS pct_share FROM refund_req ORDER BY reason_cd ASC, pct_share DESC, rfd_id ASC;

items.question: For each customer, find the most recent order they placed, showing the customer id, order id, order date, and order total amount. Break date ties by order id descending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Find the top 2 highest refund requests for each reason code based on refund amount. Show the reason code, refund request id, and refund amount, breaking ties with refund request id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM (SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY reason_cd ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC) AS drnk FROM refund_req) sub WHERE drnk <= 2 ORDER BY reason_cd ASC, rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC;

items.question: For each support ticket that has multiple events, calculate the time gap in seconds between the last event and the first event, showing the ticket id, first event timestamp, last event timestamp, and duration in seconds.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, MIN(evt_ts) AS first_ts, MAX(evt_ts) AS last_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(evt_ts), MAX(evt_ts)) AS duration_secs FROM tkt_event GROUP BY tkt_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY duration_secs DESC, tkt_id ASC;

items.question: Using LEAD, list every support ticket event alongside the timestamp of the immediately following event on the same ticket, showing ticket id, event id, event timestamp, and next event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, evt_id, evt_ts, LEAD(evt_ts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY tkt_id ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC) AS next_evt_ts FROM tkt_event ORDER BY tkt_id ASC, evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC;

items.question: For each region, rank customers by their signup date from earliest to latest. Show the region code, customer id, customer name, signup date, and rank, breaking ties by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_cd ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) AS rnk FROM cust_master ORDER BY region_cd ASC, rnk ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each employee who has been assigned support tickets, find the ticket with the earliest opened timestamp assigned to them, showing the assigned employee id, ticket id, and opened timestamp, breaking timestamp ties by ticket id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT assigned_emp_id, tkt_id, opened_ts FROM (SELECT assigned_emp_id, tkt_id, opened_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC) AS rn FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY assigned_emp_id ASC;

items.question: Show me the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount for all transactions where the payment status was settled in USD.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD';

items.question: Can you list the warehouse ID and name for all locations that belong to the North America sales region?
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: What are the SKU, product name, and list price for all items in the electronics category that are not discontinued?
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0;

items.question: Retrieve the shipment ID, order ID, and ship date for all shipments handled by the DHL carrier.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL';

items.question: Show the total payment amount grouped by payment method code for all settled transactions in USD.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY method_cd;

items.question: Find the average on-hand inventory quantity for each warehouse ID across all stored products.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id;

items.question: Give me the total number of orders placed through the web sales channel during the first quarter of 2026.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' and '2026-03-31';

items.question: List each warehouse name along with the total count of stock movement records associated with it.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, COUNT(t2.mv_id) AS movement_count FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_nm ORDER BY movement_count DESC, t1.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: For orders placed in 2026, show the order ID, order total amount, and the maximum payment attempt amount recorded for each order.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, MAX(t2.pay_amt) AS max_pay_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN payment AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' and '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the product SKU, warehouse ID, and current on-hand quantity for any inventory item whose quantity is less than its reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: For each carrier code, list the carrier code and the total number of shipments delivered on or after 2026-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS delivered_shipments FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY delivered_shipments DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: Display the warehouse name and the total quantity moved for all IN movement types recorded in stock movements.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.qty) AS total_in_qty FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_in_qty DESC, t1.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: For each product category, find the product name and list price of the single most expensive item, breaking list price ties alphabetically by product name.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC) AS rnk FROM prod_catalog) AS sub WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Calculate a running total of payment amounts for each currency code ordered by the paid timestamp and payment ID, showing currency code, paid timestamp, payment ID, and the running total.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, paid_ts, pay_id, SUM(pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) AS running_total FROM payment ORDER BY currency_cd ASC, paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse, find the top 2 products with the highest on-hand inventory quantity, displaying warehouse ID, SKU, and on-hand quantity, sorted by warehouse ID and inventory descending with SKU tie-breaker.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC) AS rnk FROM inventory) AS sub WHERE rnk <= 2 ORDER BY wh_id ASC, on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: For each order with multiple payment attempts, find the time gap in seconds between each consecutive payment attempt for the same order, returning order ID, payment ID, paid timestamp, and the gap to the previous payment.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, pay_id, paid_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAG(paid_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC), paid_ts) AS seconds_since_prev FROM payment ORDER BY ord_id ASC, paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC;

items.question: For every inventory record, show the SKU, warehouse ID, on-hand quantity, and the total on-hand quantity across all warehouses for that SKU as a percentage of the total stock for that product.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, (on_hand_qty * 100.0 / SUM(on_hand_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY sku)) AS pct_of_sku_total FROM inventory ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Rank payment attempts within each currency code by their payment amount in descending order (with payment ID tie-breaker), and filter to keep only those whose rank is 3 or lower.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, pay_amt, pay_status FROM (SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, pay_amt, pay_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC) AS rnk FROM payment) AS sub WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY currency_cd ASC, rnk ASC;

items.question: For each payment currency, identify the very first payment attempt recorded (earliest paid timestamp, then lowest payment ID), and show the currency code, paid timestamp, and payment amount.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, paid_ts, pay_amt FROM (SELECT currency_cd, paid_ts, pay_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) AS rn FROM payment) AS sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY currency_cd ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse, find the latest stock movement timestamp recorded, displaying the warehouse ID and the maximum movement timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, MAX(mv_ts) AS latest_mv_ts FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the order ID, customer ID, order date, and order total amount for orders where the total amount is strictly greater than the average order total amount for their respective sales channels.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd) AS avg_channel_amt FROM ord_hdr) AS sub WHERE ord_total_amt > avg_channel_amt ORDER BY ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the product SKU, category code, list price, and the difference between the product's list price and the average list price of its category.
items.sql: SELECT sku, categ_cd, list_prc, (list_prc - AVG(list_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd)) AS diff_from_categ_avg FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: For each customer who placed orders, determine their first order date and their most recent order date using analytical window functions, returning customer ID, order ID, order date, and order status for both extremes per customer.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cust_id, FIRST_VALUE(ord_id) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS first_ord_id, FIRST_VALUE(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS first_ord_dt, LAST_VALUE(ord_id) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_ord_id, LAST_VALUE(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each shipment carrier, list the shipment ID, order ID, ship date, and the immediately preceding ship date for that same carrier.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt, LAG(ship_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier_cd ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC) AS prev_ship_dt FROM shipment ORDER BY carrier_cd ASC, ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC;

items.question: Can you list all promotions that started on or after 2025-11-01, showing the promotion code and its name, sorted by promotion id?
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY promo_id ASC;

items.question: Show me the web event ID, session ID, and event timestamp for all web events that occurred on 2025-11-01 through the web channel.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY evt_id ASC;

items.question: Please retrieve the customer ID, name, and loyalty tier for all active platinum tier customers in the North American region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the order ID, order date, and total amount for orders placed via the web channel in currency USD that exceed 500 dollars.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_id ASC;

items.question: List the customer ID and month date for customers whose segment code was VIP during the month of July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt = '2026-07-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Provide the promotion ID, code, and discount percentage for promotions with a discount greater than 15 percent, ordered by discount descending then promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID, name, and signup date for customers who signed up after August 2022 in the Asia Pacific region, sorted by signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt > '2022-08-31' AND region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each promotion ID, calculate the total number of orders it was applied to, showing the promotion ID and the order count, restricted to promotions with more than 1 order.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_count FROM ord_promo GROUP BY promo_id HAVING COUNT(ord_id) > 1 ORDER BY promo_id ASC;

items.question: List the customer ID, order ID, and order total amount for orders placed in 2026 where the customer is in the gold tier.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.tier_cd = 'G' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC;
