items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm, COUNT(t2.rfd_id) FROM emp AS t1 INNER JOIN refund_req AS t2 ON t1.emp_id = t2.approver_emp_id WHERE t2.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND t2.status_cd = 'A' AND t2.decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.rfd_id) DESC

items.question: A phone support ticket is a support ticket where the channel code is 'PHN'. Show the category code and count of such tickets opened in April 2026, ordered by the ticket count descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(tkt_id) FROM support_tkt WHERE channel_cd = 'PHN' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY COUNT(tkt_id) DESC

items.question: An active customer is a customer whose active flag is 1 and who signed up during 2022. Show the region code and count of such active customers, ordered by the customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY COUNT(cust_id) DESC

items.question: A high-value refund is a refund request where the refund amount exceeds 100.00. Show the reason code and count of such refund requests requested in 2025, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(rfd_id) FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_amt > 100.00 AND req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY COUNT(rfd_id) DESC

items.question: A billing support ticket is a support ticket where the category code is 'BILL'. Show the employee ID, full name, and count of billing support tickets assigned to them that were closed in April 2026, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm, COUNT(t2.tkt_id) FROM emp AS t1 INNER JOIN support_tkt AS t2 ON t1.emp_id = t2.assigned_emp_id WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'BILL' AND t2.closed_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND t2.closed_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.tkt_id) DESC

items.question: A settled payment attempt is a payment attempt where the payment status code is 'S'. Show the method code and total sum of payment amounts for all settled payment attempts in November 2025, ordered by the sum descending.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY SUM(pay_amt) DESC

items.question: A closed support ticket is a support ticket where the closed timestamp is not null. Show the customer ID, customer name, and count of closed support tickets for each customer opened since 2026-04-01, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.tkt_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN support_tkt AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND t2.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.tkt_id) DESC

items.question: A management department employee is an employee whose department code is 'MGT'. Show the employee ID and full name of all employees in the management department hired in 2020, ordered by hire date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'MGT' AND hire_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2020-12-31' ORDER BY hire_dt ASC

items.question: A returned order is an order where the order status code is 'R'. Show the channel code and count of returned orders placed during November 2025, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(ord_id) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'R' AND ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY COUNT(ord_id) DESC

items.question: An electronics product is a product whose category code is 'ELC'. Show the stock keeping unit (SKU), product name, and list price for all active (not discontinued, disc_flag = 0) electronics products, ordered by list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC

items.question: A multi-payment order is an order that has more than one payment attempt recorded. Show the order ID and the count of payment attempts for all multi-payment orders that occurred in November 2025, ordered by the payment count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, COUNT(t1.pay_id) FROM payment AS t1 WHERE t1.paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND t1.paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.ord_id HAVING COUNT(t1.pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(t1.pay_id) DESC

items.question: A fast lead-time supplier relationship is a product supplier record where the lead days are less than or equal to 7 and it is the primary supplier (is_primary = 1). Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and count of products they supply with fast lead times, ordered by the product count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) FROM supplier AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.lead_days <= 7 AND t2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.sku) DESC

items.question: A VIP customer is a customer whose monthly segment was 'VIP' as of 2025-11-01. Show the customer ID, customer name, and count of orders they placed in November 2025, ordered by the order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t3.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id LEFT JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id AND t3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.month_dt = '2025-11-01' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t3.ord_id) DESC

items.question: An app-based order is an order where the sales channel code is 'APP'. Show the customer ID, customer name, and sum of order total amounts for app-based orders placed in 2026, ordered by the sum descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'APP' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC

items.question: A stockout risk item is a product where the current on-hand quantity in inventory is less than or equal to the reorder point. Show the SKU, warehouse ID, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for all such items in warehouse 'W1', ordered by on-hand quantity ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY on_hand_qty ASC

items.question: A discounted order line is an order line where the discount percentage is greater than 0. Show the SKU, product name, and total quantity ordered for all discounted order lines from orders placed in November 2025, ordered by the total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, SUM(t1.qty) FROM ord_line AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.disc_pct > 0.00 AND t3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm ORDER BY SUM(t1.qty) DESC

items.question: An approved refund request is a refund request where the status code is 'A'. Show the order ID, request date, and refund amount for all approved refund requests requested in November 2025, ordered by the refund amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND req_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-11-30' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC

items.question: An at-risk customer is defined as any customer whose loyalty tier code is 'S' standard and who has had a support ticket opened with a severity level of 1 critical since '2026-04-01'. Show the customer ID, customer name, and signup date for these at-risk customers, ordered by signup date ascending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, c.signup_dt FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'S' AND t.sev_lvl = 1 AND t.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY c.signup_dt ASC, c.cust_id ASC

items.question: A high-value payment is defined as a payment attempt where the payment amount is greater than 200.00 and the currency code is 'USD'. Show the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount for all high-value payments made on '2025-11-12', ordered by payment amount descending then payment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_amt > 200.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-12 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-11-13 00:00:00' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC

items.question: A late shipment is defined as a shipment where the delivery date is later than the ship date plus 5 days. Show the warehouse ID, the count of late shipments, and the average days between ship date and delivery date for each warehouse, considering only shipments dispatched in '2026-01', ordered by the count of late shipments descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS late_count, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_transit_days FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-01-31' AND deliv_dt > DATE_ADD(ship_dt, INTERVAL 5 DAY) GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY late_count DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: An active product is defined as any item in the product catalog with a list price above 50.00 and a discount flag of 0 indicating it is still sold. Show the SKU, product name, and list price of active products that belong to category code 'ELC', ordered by list price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 50.00 AND disc_flag = 0 AND categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, SKU ASC

items.question: A high-volume inventory item is defined as a product whose on-hand quantity exceeds its reorder point by at least 100 units in warehouse 'W1'. Show the SKU, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for these high-volume inventory items in warehouse 'W1', ordered by on-hand quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty >= reorder_pt + 100 ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC

items.question: A failed settling order is defined as an order that had at least one payment attempt with a payment status of 'F' failed, but ultimately has a payment with status 'S' settled. Show the order ID and the total settled amount across those settled payments for each such order, ordered by the total settled amount descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p1.ord_id, SUM(p1.pay_amt) AS total_settled FROM payment p1 WHERE p1.pay_status = 'S' AND p1.ord_id IN (SELECT p2.ord_id FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.pay_status = 'F') GROUP BY p1.ord_id ORDER BY total_settled DESC, p1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A bulky shipment carrier is a delivery carrier that handled shipments originating from warehouse 'W2' with a delivery date recorded in the first quarter of 2026 (between '2026-01-01' and '2026-03-31'). Show the carrier code and the total number of shipments they delivered meeting those criteria, ordered by the shipment count descending then carrier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_cnt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND deliv_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_cnt DESC, carrier_cd ASC

items.question: A stock adjustment event is a stock movement where the movement type code is 'ADJ'. Show the movement ID, SKU, warehouse ID, and movement quantity for all stock adjustment events that occurred in October 2025 (between '2025-10-01' and '2025-10-31') where the absolute movement quantity was greater than 50, ordered by movement quantity descending then movement ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, wh_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' AND ABS(qty) > 50 ORDER BY qty DESC, mv_id ASC

items.question: A premium channel order is an order placed through the phone channel code 'PHN' or web channel code 'WEB' with an order total amount greater than 300.00 in currency code 'USD'. Show the order ID, customer ID, order date, and order total amount for these orders, ordered by order date ascending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd IN ('PHN', 'WEB') AND ord_total_amt > 300.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A heavily discounted order line is an order line where the line discount percentage is 15.00 or higher. Show the order ID, line number, SKU, and unit price for order lines that are heavily discounted and belong to orders placed in '2026-04', ordered by unit price descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT l.ord_id, l.line_no, l.sku, l.unit_prc FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE l.disc_pct >= 15.00 AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY l.unit_prc DESC, l.ord_id ASC

items.question: A high-priority support ticket is a ticket with a severity level of 1 or 2 that was opened via the web channel code 'WEB'. Show the ticket ID, customer ID, opened timestamp, and severity level for such tickets opened in April 2026, ordered by severity level ascending then opened timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl IN (1, 2) AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC, opened_ts ASC

items.question: A recurring support customer is a customer who has raised more than one support ticket across all time. Show the customer ID and the total count of tickets for each recurring support customer, ordered by the ticket count descending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY tkt_count DESC, cust_id ASC

items.question: An expensive product supplier is a supplier who provides at least one product with a list price greater than 100.00 where the supplier relationship is marked as primary (is_primary = 1). Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and country for these suppliers, ordered by supplier name ascending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, s.country FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE p.list_prc > 100.00 AND ps.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC, s.sup_id ASC

items.question: A multi-payment order is an order that has had more than one payment attempt recorded. Show the order ID and the count of payment attempts for each multi-payment order, ordered by the attempt count descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY attempt_count DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A promotional order is an order that had at least one promotion applied during checkout. Show the promotion ID, the count of distinct orders that used that promotion, and the average discount percentage of the promotion for all promotions active in 2025 or 2026, ordered by the order count descending then promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.promo_id, COUNT(DISTINCT op.ord_id) AS order_cnt, p.disc_pct FROM promo p JOIN ord_op op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.disc_pct ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, p.promo_id ASC

items.question: A resolved critical ticket is a support ticket with a severity level of 1 critical that has a non-null closed timestamp. Show the ticket ID, customer ID, opened timestamp, and closed timestamp for resolved critical tickets handled in April 2026, ordered by opened timestamp ascending then ticket ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, closed_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC

items.question: A high-quantity order line is an order line where the ordered quantity is 4 units or more. Show the SKU, total quantity ordered across all high-quantity order lines, and the count of such lines for each SKU, ordered by the total quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) as line_count FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 4 GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC

items.question: A regional warehouse hub is a warehouse located in the 'NA' region code. Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and region code for all regional warehouse hubs, ordered by warehouse name ascending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: A refunded order is an order that has at least one refund request with an approval status code of 'A' approved. Show the order ID, customer ID, and order total amount for orders that have an approved refund and were placed in currency code 'USD', ordered by order total amount descending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT h.ord_id, h.cust_id, h.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN refund_req r ON h.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' AND h.currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY h.ord_total_amt DESC, h.ord_id ASC

items.question: A high-value refunded request is a refund request where the requested refund amount is greater than 70.00. Show the refund request ID, order ID, request date, and refund amount for high-value refund requests with a reason code of 'DMG' damaged, ordered by refund amount descending then refund request ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_amt > 70.00 AND reason_cd = 'DMG' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: A multi-channel customer session is a web event session where multiple channel codes were recorded. Show the session ID and the count of distinct channel codes used in the session for sessions having more than one channel, ordered by session ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_cd) AS channel_cnt FROM web_event GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT channel_cd) > 1 ORDER BY session_id ASC

items.question: A top-tier customer is a customer whose loyalty tier code is 'P' platinum and who belongs to the sales region code 'NA'. Show the customer ID, customer name, and signup date for top-tier customers, ordered by signup date ascending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: A stocked-out product is a product whose current inventory on-hand quantity is zero across all warehouses. Show the SKU and product name for all stocked-out products, ordered by product name ascending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > 0) ORDER BY p.prod_nm ASC, p.sku ASC

items.question: An active promotional campaign is any promotion record where the starts date is on or before '2025-11-01' and the ends date is on or after '2025-11-30'. Show the promotion ID, promotion code, promotion name, and discount percentage for active promotional campaigns, ordered by discount percentage descending then promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2025-11-01' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-30' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC

items.question: A Black Friday order is defined as any order placed using the promotion code 'BF25'. Show the customer ID, customer name, and the total order amount for every Black Friday order placed on 2025-11-28, ordered by the order total amount descending, with customer ID as the tie-breaker.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t2.cust_nm, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t4.promo_cd = 'BF25' AND t1.ord_dt = '2025-11-28' ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: An at-risk customer segment month is recorded when the segment code is 'RISK' in the customer segment history. Show the customer name and signup date for all customers who were classified in the at-risk segment during the month of 2026-04-01, sorted alphabetically by the customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-04-01' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A Flash Sale promotion is any promotion that has a discount percentage strictly greater than 20 percent. Show the promotion name, discount percentage, and the count of distinct orders that used each Flash Sale promotion, ordered by the order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, t1.disc_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t1.disc_pct > 20.00 GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm, t1.disc_pct ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t2.ord_id) DESC

items.question: An active promotional campaign is defined as any promotion that starts on or before 2025-11-01 and ends on or after 2025-11-30. List the promotion code and promotion name for all active promotional campaigns during that period, ordered by promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2025-11-01' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-30' ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: A web-only checkout session is a web browsing session where at least one checkout event occurred through the 'WEB' channel. Show the session ID and the count of web events associated with each such session during November 2025, sorted by the event count descending and session ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND channel_cd = 'WEB') AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: A repeat VIP customer is a customer with tier code 'P' who has placed more than 2 orders in total across all time. Show the customer ID, customer name, and the total count of orders placed by each such repeat VIP customer, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) > 2 ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC

items.question: An anonymous cart event is a clickstream event of type 'CART' where the customer ID is not logged in (i.e. NULL). Show the channel code and the total count of anonymous cart events recorded in November 2025, grouped by channel code, sorted by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND cust_id IS NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

items.question: A high-discount order is an order where at least one order line received a discount percentage of 20 percent or more. Show the order ID, order date, and order total amount for every high-discount order placed in 2026, ordered by order date ascending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND t2.disc_pct >= 20.00 ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A multi-promotion order is an order that has had two or more distinct promotions applied to it. Show the order ID and the count of distinct promotions applied for every multi-promotion order, sorted by promotion count descending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(DISTINCT promo_id) FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT promo_id) >= 2 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT promo_id) DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A lapsed customer is an active customer (is_actv = 1) who signed up before 2022-07-01 and has never placed any orders in the ord_hdr table. Show the customer ID, customer name, and signup date for all lapsed customers, sorted by signup date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt < '2022-07-01' AND cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY signup_dt ASC

items.question: A holiday promo order is any order placed in December 2025 that used a promotion with 'New' or 'Holiday' or 'Winter' or 'December' or 'Flash' or 'Black' in its name. Show the promotion name, order ID, and order total amount for these orders, ordered by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t3.promo_nm, t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN promo AS t3 ON t2.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' AND (t3.promo_nm LIKE '%New%' OR t3.promo_nm LIKE '%Holiday%' OR t3.promo_nm LIKE '%Winter%' OR t3.promo_nm LIKE '%December%' OR t3.promo_nm LIKE '%Flash%' OR t3.promo_nm LIKE '%Black%') ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC

items.question: A converted browsing session is a web event session that started with a 'VIEW' event and eventually resulted in a 'PURCHASE' event. Show the count of unique sessions that successfully converted during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM web_event WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW') AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE') AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59'

items.question: A loyal EU customer is a customer residing in the 'EU' sales region who holds a loyalty tier code of either 'G' or 'P'. Show the customer ID, customer name, and signup date for all loyal EU customers, sorted by signup date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' AND tier_cd IN ('G', 'P') ORDER BY signup_dt ASC

items.question: An app purchase event is a clickstream event where the event type is 'PURCHASE' and the channel code is 'APP'. Show the customer ID, count of app purchase events, and max order ID for each customer who made app purchases in November 2025, ordered by the event count descending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*), MAX(ord_id) FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

items.question: A tier-upgraded customer is a customer whose segment history changed from 'REG' in November 2025 to 'VIP' in December 2025. Show the customer ID and customer name for all such tier-upgraded customers, ordered by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'REG' AND t3.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND t3.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: A high-revenue promotion is any promotion that has generated a total order amount greater than 1,000 USD across all orders it was applied to. Show the promotion ID, promotion code, and total order sum for each high-revenue promotion, sorted by total order sum descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd HAVING SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) > 1000.00 ORDER BY SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) DESC

items.question: A regional new customer segment record is any entry in the customer segment history where the segment code is 'NEW' and the customer belongs to the 'AP' sales region. Show the customer name and month date for all regional new customer segment records in the first half of 2026, ordered by month date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.month_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND t1.region_cd = 'AP' AND t2.month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.month_dt <= '2026-06-30' ORDER BY t2.month_dt ASC

items.question: A non-discounted promo order is an order where a promotion was applied, but the promotion itself offers a discount percentage equal to zero. Show the order ID and promotion ID for all non-discounted promo orders, ordered by order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.promo_id FROM ord_promo AS t1 JOIN promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t2.disc_pct = 0.00 ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A web browsing drop-off is a session that recorded a 'VIEW' event but never recorded a 'CART', 'CHECKOUT', or 'PURCHASE' event. Show the count of such drop-off sessions that occurred during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM web_event WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59') AND session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type IN ('CART', 'CHECKOUT', 'PURCHASE'))

items.question: A premier customer with recent activity is any platinum customer (tier_cd = 'P') who has at least one web event recorded in December 2025. Show the customer ID and customer name for these customers, ordered by customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND t2.evt_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: A multi-channel customer is a customer who has placed orders through both the 'WEB' channel and the 'APP' channel across all time. Show the customer ID and customer name for every multi-channel customer, sorted alphabetically by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB') AND cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP') ORDER BY cust_nm ASC

items.question: A long-running promotion is any promotion whose active duration between starts_dt and ends_dt is greater than 90 days. Show the promotion ID, promotion code, and promotion name for all long-running promotions, ordered by promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE DATEDIFF(ends_dt, starts_dt) > 90 ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: A high-frequency web user is a customer who has generated more than 5 distinct web event sessions in total. Show the customer ID, customer name, and the count of distinct sessions for each high-frequency web user, ordered by session count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.session_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.session_id) > 5 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t2.session_id) DESC

items.question: A standard tier seasonal buyer is a customer with tier code 'S' who placed an order using a promotion in the Latin America ('LA') sales region. Show the customer ID, customer name, and order date for all such orders, ordered by order date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'S' AND t1.region_cd = 'LA' ORDER BY t2.ord_dt ASC

items.question: An at-risk customer is defined as someone whose customer segment in the month of 2026-03-01 is recorded as RISK. Show the customer name and signup date for these customers, ordered alphabetically by customer name with customer ID as the tie-breaker.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-03-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'RISK' ORDER BY T1.cust_nm ASC, T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: A discontinued electronic product is any item in the ELC category where the discontinuation flag is set to 1. List the product name and list price for such items, sorted by list price descending with SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: A primary supplier partnership is defined as a supplier relationship where the primary flag is 1 and the lead days exceed 30. Show the supplier name, SKU, and lead days for these records, sorted by lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, T1.sku, T1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.is_primary = 1 AND T1.lead_days > 30 ORDER BY T1.lead_days DESC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: A low-stock warehouse item is any record where the on-hand quantity is strictly less than the reorder point. Output the warehouse ID, SKU, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for these items, sorted by warehouse ID and SKU.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt ORDER BY wh_id ASC, sku ASC

items.question: A large stock adjustment is an inventory movement of type ADJ where the absolute quantity moved is greater than 50 units. List the movement ID, SKU, warehouse ID, movement timestamp, and quantity for such events, ordered chronologically by movement timestamp and movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, wh_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND ABS(qty) > 50 ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: A regional hub in the Americas refers to any warehouse located in the LA region code. Retrieve the warehouse ID and warehouse name for these locations, ordered by warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'LA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC

items.question: A late shipment is a shipped order where the delivery date is strictly later than 2025-11-10. Show the shipment ID, order ID, carrier code, and delivery date for these shipments, ordered by delivery date and shipment ID.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, carrier_cd, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt > '2025-11-10' ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: A high-value payment attempt is a settled payment where the payment status is S and the amount is greater than 100. Display the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount, ordered by payment amount descending with payment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND pay_amt > 100 ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC

items.question: A volume order line is an order line where the ordered quantity is 4 or more units. Show the order ID, line number, SKU, and ordered quantity, sorted by ordered quantity descending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, qty FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 4 ORDER BY qty DESC, ord_id ASC, line_no ASC

items.question: A heavy discount line is an order line where the applied discount percentage is 15.00 or higher. For these lines, output the product name, order ID, line number, and discount percentage, sorted by discount percentage descending with order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.prod_nm, T1.ord_id, T1.line_no, T1.disc_pct FROM ord_line AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY T1.disc_pct DESC, T1.ord_id ASC, T1.line_no ASC

items.question: A fulfilled return order is an order header whose status is returned, code R, and which has a recorded shipment. Find the order ID, order date, and order total amount for these orders, sorted by order date descending with order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ord_id, T1.ord_dt, T1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN shipment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.ord_status = 'R' ORDER BY T1.ord_dt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC

items.question: An active customer ticket is any support ticket belonging to the shipping category, code SHIP, that was opened on or after 2026-04-01 and remains unassigned, meaning the assigned employee ID is null. List the ticket ID, customer ID, and opened timestamp, ordered by opened timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'SHIP' AND opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND assigned_emp_id IS NULL ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC

items.question: A primary supplier audit identifies products where the primary supplier is located in the United States, code US. Retrieve the SKU, product name, and supplier name for these records, sorted by product name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T3.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku INNER JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 AND T3.country = 'US' ORDER BY T1.prod_nm ASC

items.question: A promotional order is any order that successfully applied a promotion with a discount percentage of 20.00 or more. Show the order ID, promotion ID, and order total amount for such orders, ordered by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T2.promo_id, T1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id INNER JOIN promo AS T3 ON T2.promo_id = T3.promo_id WHERE T3.disc_pct >= 20.00 ORDER BY T1.ord_total_amt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A web conversion session refers to any browsing session on the web channel that included a purchase event. For these sessions, list the session ID, customer ID, and event timestamp of the purchase, ordered by the event timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, session_id ASC

items.question: A pending high-value refund is a refund request where the status code is P and the requested amount is greater than 100. Show the refund request ID, order ID, request date, and requested amount, sorted by requested amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' AND rfd_amt > 100 ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: An active platinum customer is a customer whose loyalty tier is platinum, code P, and whose active flag is 1. Calculate the total number of such active platinum customers in each sales region. Output the region code and the customer count, sorted by the count descending with region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_count DESC, region_cd ASC

items.question: A high-volume product SKU is any product that appears across 3 or more order lines in total. For these SKUs, show the SKU, product name, and the total quantity ordered across all lines, ordered by the total quantity descending with SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm, SUM(T1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku GROUP BY T1.sku, T2.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY total_qty DESC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: A multi-payment order is an order header that has had more than one payment attempt recorded. List the order ID, order date, and order total amount for these orders, sorted by order total amount descending with order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.ord_dt, T1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN payment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id GROUP BY T1.ord_id, T1.ord_dt, T1.ord_total_amt HAVING COUNT(T2.pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY T1.ord_total_amt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A backed-up warehouse is a location where the total on-hand inventory quantity across all its stored products exceeds 1500 units. Retrieve the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the total on-hand quantity, sorted by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm HAVING SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) > 1500 ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, T1.wh_id ASC

items.question: A high-ticket support department is one where the average severity level of all tickets opened in the system is strictly less than 2.5. Show the category code and the average severity level, ordered by the average severity ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(sev_lvl) AS avg_sev FROM support_tkt GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(sev_lvl) < 2.5 ORDER BY avg_sev ASC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: An active supplier partner supplies 2 or more products where the relationship is flagged as primary. Output the supplier name and the count of primary products they provide, ordered by the product count descending with supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, COUNT(T1.sku) AS primary_prod_count FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY T2.sup_id, T2.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(T1.sku) >= 2 ORDER BY primary_prod_count DESC, T2.sup_nm ASC

items.question: A frequent-return customer is a customer who has placed orders associated with 2 or more refund requests in total. Display the customer ID, customer name, and the count of refund requests, ordered by the refund count descending with customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, COUNT(T3.rfd_id) AS rfd_count FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id INNER JOIN refund_req AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(T3.rfd_id) >= 2 ORDER BY rfd_count DESC, T1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: An active shopping session with multiple events is a web browsing session that recorded more than 2 total clickstream events. List the session ID, customer ID, and the total count of events for such sessions, ordered by event count descending with session ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event GROUP BY session_id, cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY event_count DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: Give me the total order amount in USD for each sales channel during July 2026, assuming an FX rate of 1.0 where currency is USD or not joined. Show channel code and total USD amount.
items.sql: SELECT t1.channel_cd, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(t2.rate_to_usd, 1.000000)) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr AS t1 LEFT JOIN fx_rate AS t2 ON t1.currency_cd = t2.currency_cd AND t2.eff_dt = '2026-07-01' WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t1.channel_cd

items.question: List the top 3 warehouses by the count of shipments they processed in the second quarter of 2026 (from 2026-04-01 through 2026-06-30). Show warehouse id and shipment count.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, COUNT(t1.ship_id) AS ship_cnt FROM shipment AS t1 WHERE t1.ship_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND t1.ship_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t1.wh_id ORDER BY ship_cnt DESC, t1.wh_id ASC LIMIT 3

items.question: Which products had more than 5 total units ordered in orders placed during January 2026? Return the sku and total quantity ordered, ordered by quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-01-31' GROUP BY t1.sku HAVING SUM(t1.qty) > 5 ORDER BY total_qty DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Calculate the average discount percentage given on order lines for each product category code during 2026. Show category code and average discount percentage.
items.sql: SELECT t2.categ_cd, AVG(t1.disc_pct) AS avg_disc_pct FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t2.categ_cd

items.question: Find all active customers in the NA region who signed up before July 2022. Show customer id and customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt < '2022-07-01'

items.question: What is the total quantity of items currently on hand across all warehouses for category ELC? Show total on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'ELC'

items.question: List each carrier code and the number of shipments handled by that carrier in 2025. Show carrier code and shipment count.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(ship_id) AS shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd

items.question: Show the count of support tickets opened by channel code during April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: Identify products where the current inventory on hand is strictly less than or equal to the reorder point. List the sku, warehouse id, and on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt

items.question: Find the total refund amount requested per reason code during the fourth quarter of 2025 (2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31). Show reason code and total refund amount.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reason_cd

items.question: Find customers who belong to the VIP segment in December 2025 and have placed at least one order in November 2025. Show customer id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND t1.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30'

items.question: Using a WITH clause, find the average order total in USD for each customer tier in 2026, considering exchange rates effective 2026-01-01. Show tier code and average USD amount, ordered by average amount descending.
items.sql: WITH order_usd AS (SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(t2.rate_to_usd, 1.000000) AS usd_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 LEFT JOIN fx_rate AS t2 ON t1.currency_cd = t2.currency_cd AND t2.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT t3.tier_cd, AVG(t4.usd_amt) AS avg_usd FROM cust_master AS t3 JOIN order_usd AS t4 ON t3.cust_id = t4.cust_id GROUP BY t3.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_usd DESC, t3.tier_cd ASC

items.question: With a CTE, find products whose total quantity ordered in 2026 is greater than the overall average quantity ordered per product. Return sku and total quantity.
items.sql: WITH prod_qty AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line JOIN ord_hdr ON ord_line.ord_id = ord_hdr.ord_id WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, tot_qty FROM prod_qty WHERE tot_qty > (SELECT AVG(tot_qty) FROM prod_qty)

items.question: Find warehouses that hold inventory for more than 5 distinct SKUs. Show warehouse id and distinct SKU count.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS sku_count FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sku) > 5

items.question: List suppliers who supply more than 2 products. Show supplier id and product count.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS prod_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id HAVING COUNT(sku) > 2

items.question: What is the total revenue (in USD, using fx rate for 2026-01-01) generated by each promotion during 2026? Show promotion id and total USD revenue.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(t3.rate_to_usd, 1.000000)) AS total_usd FROM ord_promo AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id LEFT JOIN fx_rate AS t3 ON t2.currency_cd = t3.currency_cd AND t3.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.promo_id

items.question: Calculate the percentage of support tickets that were closed within 24 hours of opening during April 2026. Show the percentage.
items.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts) <= 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(tkt_id) AS pct_fast_close FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL

items.question: Using a CTE, find customers who have placed orders in both November 2025 and April 2026. Show customer id.
items.sql: WITH nov_cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-11-30'), apr_cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30') SELECT t1.cust_id FROM nov_cust AS t1 JOIN apr_cust AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id

items.question: Find the top 5 SKUs by total units moved out of warehouses due to customer shipments (mv_type = 'OUT') during Q4 2025. Show sku and total units moved.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(-qty) AS units_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY units_out DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: Compare the average order total in USD between WEB and APP channels for orders in 2026 using 2026-01-01 FX rates. Show channel code and average USD amount.
items.sql: SELECT t1.channel_cd, AVG(t1.ord_total_amt * COALESCE(t2.rate_to_usd, 1.000000)) AS avg_usd FROM ord_hdr AS t1 LEFT JOIN fx_rate AS t2 ON t1.currency_cd = t2.currency_cd AND t2.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND t1.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP') GROUP BY t1.channel_cd

items.question: Find the ratio of refund requests approved vs denied during January 2026. Show approved count, denied count, and ratio of approved to denied.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS appr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS den_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS appr_den_ratio FROM refund_req WHERE decided_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND decided_dt <= '2026-01-31'

items.question: Using a CTE, find the warehouse with the highest total on-hand inventory across all its SKUs. Show warehouse id and total on-hand quantity.
items.sql: WITH wh_totals AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS tot_inv FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, tot_inv FROM wh_totals ORDER BY tot_inv DESC, wh_id ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: Find the funnel conversion rate from VIEW to PURCHASE in web events during November 2025. Show total views, total purchases, and conversion percentage.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cnt, (SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS conv_pct FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59'

items.question: For each loyalty tier, calculate the total number of distinct customers who signed up in 2022. Show tier code and customer count.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: Show the employee name and their direct manager's employee id for all staff in the management department.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_nm, T1.mgr_emp_id FROM emp AS T1 WHERE T1.dept_cd = 'MGT' ORDER BY T1.emp_id ASC;

items.question: List each customer name and their loyalty tier for active customers in the Asia Pacific region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the order id, order date, and total amount for orders placed through the web channel in USD currency.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find the refund request id, amount, and reason code for all pending refunds.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt, reason_cd FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' ORDER BY req_dt ASC, rfd_id ASC;

items.question: Show the ticket id, severity level, and opened timestamp for open support tickets in the billing category.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, sev_lvl, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL' AND closed_ts IS NULL ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC;

items.question: List the product name, list price, and category code for all discontinued products in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse name and region code for warehouses serving the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the promotion name and percentage off for promotions running on 2025-11-15.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE '2025-11-15' BETWEEN starts_dt AND ends_dt ORDER BY promo_id ASC;

items.question: Find the total order amount for each order status, showing the status code and total sum, ordered by total descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ord_status ASC;

items.question: Show the customer name and count of support tickets raised, for customers who have raised more than 2 tickets, ordered by the ticket count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.cust_nm, COUNT(T1.tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(T1.tkt_id) > 2 ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, T2.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: List each employee name and the count of support tickets assigned to them, for staff in the support department.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_nm, COUNT(T2.tkt_id) AS assigned_cnt FROM emp AS T1 LEFT JOIN support_tkt AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.assigned_emp_id WHERE T1.dept_cd = 'SUP' GROUP BY T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm ORDER BY assigned_cnt DESC, T1.emp_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the reason code and average refund amount for each refund reason on approved refund requests.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, AVG(rfd_amt) AS avg_rfd FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY avg_rfd DESC, reason_cd ASC;

items.question: For each sales channel, find the number of orders and the average order total amount for orders placed in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_cnt, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse id and total on-hand inventory quantity for each warehouse, ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id and total count of payment attempts made with credit cards.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, COUNT(T2.pay_id) AS cc_pay_cnt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN payment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.method_cd = 'CC' GROUP BY T1.cust_id ORDER BY cc_pay_cnt DESC, T1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Find the category code and average list price of products in each category, filtered to categories where the average list price is above 30.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 30.00 ORDER BY avg_price DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Find customers who have placed orders with a total amount greater than the average order total of all orders placed in 2026. Show customer name and order id.
items.sql: SELECT T2.cust_nm, T1.ord_id FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') ORDER BY T1.ord_total_amt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Identify support tickets that took longer to close than the average resolution time (in hours) of all closed tickets opened since 2026-04-01. Show ticket id and category code.
items.sql: WITH ticket_durations AS (SELECT tkt_id, categ_cd, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts) AS dur_hours FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL) SELECT tkt_id, categ_cd FROM ticket_durations WHERE dur_hours > (SELECT AVG(dur_hours) FROM ticket_durations) ORDER BY dur_hours DESC, tkt_id ASC;

items.question: Calculate the percentage of refund requests that were approved out of all decided refund requests (approved or denied) requested in 2025. Show the approved count, total decided count, and approval percentage.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_decided, (SUM(CASE WHEN status_cd = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS approval_pct FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd IN ('A', 'D') AND req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31';

items.question: For each loyalty tier, calculate the average order total amount for orders placed in 2026, comparing platinum, gold, and standard customers. Show tier code and average amount.
items.sql: SELECT T2.tier_cd, AVG(T1.ord_total_amt) AS avg_order_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY T2.tier_cd ORDER BY avg_order_amt DESC, T2.tier_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the top 3 warehouses by total order shipment volume (total quantity shipped from each warehouse across all orders). Show warehouse name and total shipped units.
items.sql: SELECT T2.wh_nm, SUM(T3.qty) AS total_shipped FROM shipment AS T1 JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id JOIN ord_line AS T3 ON T1.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T2.wh_id, T2.wh_nm ORDER BY total_shipped DESC, T2.wh_nm ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: Compute the conversion funnel for the web channel: count the total number of unique sessions that had a VIEW event, the number that had a CART event, the number that had a CHECKOUT event, and the number that had a PURCHASE event.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cart_count, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkout_count, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB';

items.question: Compare support ticket volume by severity level for tickets opened in April 2026 versus May 2026. Show severity level, April count, and May count.
items.sql: SELECT sev_lvl, SUM(CASE WHEN opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS apr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN opened_ts >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-06-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS may_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-06-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC;

items.question: For each employee who approved at least one refund request in 2025, show the employee name and the total sum of approved refund amounts, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.emp_nm, SUM(T1.rfd_amt) AS total_approved_amt FROM refund_req AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.approver_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T1.status_cd = 'A' AND T1.decided_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND T1.decided_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY T2.emp_id, T2.emp_nm ORDER BY total_approved_amt DESC, T2.emp_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the count of current inventory items sitting in each warehouse for the Newark Hub region.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.sku) DESC, t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the average list price for each product category code, but only include categories where the average price exceeds 50 USD.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 50.00 ORDER BY AVG(list_prc) DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: List each payment method code alongside the total successful payment amount collected using that method during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY SUM(pay_amt) DESC, method_cd ASC

items.question: For orders placed in 2026 using the web channel, calculate the total order value broken down by order status.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, ord_status ASC

items.question: Identify products whose total ordered quantity across all order lines exceeds 5 units. Show the SKU and the total quantity.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty) > 5 ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the carrier code and the total count of shipments handled by each carrier for shipments dispatched in the year 2026.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(ship_id) FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(ship_id) DESC, carrier_cd ASC

items.question: List the SKU and total stock movement quantity for every SKU that has experienced an inventory adjustment (ADJ) movement type.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Find all warehouses where the total on-hand inventory quantity across all products stored is greater than 1000 units. Show the warehouse ID and total quantity.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) > 1000 ORDER BY SUM(on_hand_qty) DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the order ID and the count of payment attempts made for every order that has had more than one payment attempt.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(pay_id) FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(pay_id) DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the products (SKU and product name) that are currently below their reorder point in at least one warehouse. Return unique SKUs ordered alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.on_hand_qty <= t2.reorder_pt ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Using a two-step aggregation, find the average order total for each sales channel, restricting to channels whose average order amount is above 200.
items.sql: WITH channel_avg AS (SELECT channel_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd) SELECT channel_cd, avg_amt FROM channel_avg WHERE avg_amt > 200.00 ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: Calculate the percentage of total shipments that were handled specifically by the DHL carrier during the year 2026.
items.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN carrier_cd = 'DHL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dhl_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT (dhl_count * 100.0 / total_count) FROM totals

items.question: Rank warehouses by their total inventory stock levels in descending order using a CTE, and return the warehouse ID along with its computed total stock.
items.sql: WITH wh_stock AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_stock FROM wh_stock ORDER BY total_stock DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Compare order volumes across channels: compute total sales per channel via a CTE and return channels whose total exceeds 500.
items.sql: WITH channel_sales AS (SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_sales FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd) SELECT channel_cd, total_sales FROM channel_sales WHERE total_sales > 500.00 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: Build a sales funnel metric: count the total sessions, total view events, and total purchase events from web events, showing each event type count.
items.sql: WITH event_counts AS (SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY evt_type) SELECT evt_type, cnt FROM event_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC, evt_type ASC

items.question: Using a multi-step CTE, find SKUs that have both high list prices (greater than 50) and have experienced inventory movements of type 'OUT'.
items.sql: WITH expensive_skus AS (SELECT sku FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 50.00), active_out AS (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') SELECT t1.sku FROM expensive_skus AS t1 JOIN active_out AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Calculate the ratio of successful payments to total payment attempts per currency code using a CTE approach.
items.sql: WITH pay_summary AS (SELECT currency_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS settled_attempts FROM payment GROUP BY currency_cd) SELECT currency_cd, (settled_attempts * 1.0 / total_attempts) AS success_ratio FROM pay_summary ORDER BY success_ratio DESC, currency_cd ASC

items.question: Find orders that have a total amount greater than the overall average order total across all orders.
items.sql: WITH avg_ord AS (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) AS overall_avg FROM ord_hdr) SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 CROSS JOIN avg_ord AS t2 WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > t2.overall_avg ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Determine the top warehouse by total inventory units stored using a CTE to aggregate stock per warehouse first.
items.sql: WITH ranked_wh AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS stock_sum FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, stock_sum FROM ranked_wh ORDER BY stock_sum DESC, wh_id ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: Find the average order line quantity for each product category by joining order lines with the product catalog inside a CTE.
items.sql: WITH line_cat AS (SELECT t2.categ_cd, t1.qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku) SELECT categ_cd, AVG(qty) FROM line_cat GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY AVG(qty) DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: Calculate the total inventory stock moved 'IN' per warehouse, restricting to warehouses where total IN movement quantity exceeds 100 units.
items.sql: WITH in_movements AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(qty) AS total_in_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_in_qty FROM in_movements WHERE total_in_qty > 100 ORDER BY total_in_qty DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the proportion of shipments that are marked with status 'D' (delivered) versus the total shipments in the table.
items.sql: WITH ship_metrics AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_ships, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_ships FROM shipment) SELECT (delivered_ships * 100.0 / total_ships) FROM ship_metrics

items.question: Using a CTE, find products whose list price is strictly greater than the average list price of all products in their respective category.
items.sql: WITH cat_avgs AS (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN cat_avgs AS t2 ON t1.categ_cd = t2.categ_cd WHERE t1.list_prc > t2.avg_price ORDER BY t1.list_prc DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find orders that used the payment method 'CC' and whose total amount is greater than 300, returning the order ID and total amount.
items.sql: WITH cc_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT ord_id FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC') SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cc_orders AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > 300.00 ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders that used each promotion code between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30, ordered by count descending then code ascending.
items.sql: WITH promo_counts AS (SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY t1.promo_cd) SELECT promo_cd, ord_cnt FROM promo_counts ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID and customer name for customers who are currently active (is_actv = 1) and belong to the VIP segment as of 2026-10-01, ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: List each promotion name and its discount percentage for promotions that start on or after 2026-01-01, ordered by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm ASC

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of web events of type PURCHASE recorded in November 2025, ordered by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(evt_id) AS pur_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY pur_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: For each loyalty tier code, list the tier code and the count of active customers, ordered by tier code.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and total order amount for all orders using each promotion code where the promotion started in 2025, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.starts_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t1.starts_dt < '2026-01-01' AND t3.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY t1.promo_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and name of customers who signed up in July 2022 and had a segment of 'NEW' on 2026-02-01, ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-07-31' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-02-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'NEW' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Find the session ID and event count for web sessions that had more than 3 events in November 2025, ordered by event count descending then session ID.
items.sql: WITH sess_evts AS (SELECT session_id, COUNT(evt_id) AS ev_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT session_id, ev_cnt FROM sess_evts WHERE ev_cnt > 3 ORDER BY ev_cnt DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and the average order total amount for orders using that promotion, restricted to promotions with an average order total greater than 300 USD, ordered by average amount descending.
items.sql: WITH promo_avg AS (SELECT t1.promo_cd, AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY t1.promo_cd) SELECT promo_cd, avg_amt FROM promo_avg WHERE avg_amt > 300.00 ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers in the AP region who were in the RISK segment on 2026-08-01, ordered by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'AP' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find promotions that were applied to more than 2 distinct orders, showing the promotion name and the count of orders, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: WITH prom_ord AS (SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_nm) SELECT promo_nm, ord_cnt FROM prom_ord WHERE ord_cnt > 2 ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, promo_nm ASC

items.question: Show the channel code and the distinct count of customers who generated web events in December 2025, ordered by customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID and name of customers who had both a VIEW event and a PURCHASE event in their web session history during November 2025, ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t2.cust_nm FROM web_event AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND t1.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND t1.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00') AND t1.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00') ORDER BY t2.cust_nm ASC

items.question: For each customer tier code, calculate the total order amount for orders placed in USD during 2026, and show the tier code and total amount, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS tot_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY t1.tier_cd ORDER BY tot_amt DESC, t1.tier_cd ASC

items.question: Identify customers who transitioned from segment 'REG' on 2026-05-01 to segment 'VIP' on 2026-06-01, listing their customer ID and customer name, ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-05-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'REG' AND t3.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND t3.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Calculate the conversion rate from CART to PURCHASE for each channel code in Q4 2025 (October 1 to December 31, 2025), showing the channel code, cart event count, purchase event count, and the ratio of purchases to carts, ordered by the ratio descending.
items.sql: WITH cart_agg AS (SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(evt_id) AS cart_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND evt_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd), pur_agg AS (SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(evt_id) AS pur_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd) SELECT c.channel_cd, c.cart_cnt, COALESCE(p.pur_cnt, 0) AS pur_cnt, (COALESCE(p.pur_cnt, 0) / c.cart_cnt) AS conversion_ratio FROM cart_agg AS c LEFT JOIN pur_agg AS p ON c.channel_cd = p.channel_cd ORDER BY conversion_ratio DESC, c.channel_cd ASC

items.question: Find the top 3 promotions by total order amount generated in USD across all orders between 2025-11-01 and 2026-03-31, showing the promotion name and total sales amount, ordered by total sales descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) AS total_sales FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY t1.promo_nm ORDER BY total_sales DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC LIMIT 3

items.question: For customers who signed up in 2022 and were in the 'VIP' segment in September 2026, list their region code, customer ID, and customer name, ordered by region code then customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND t1.signup_dt < '2023-01-01' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY t1.region_cd ASC, t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Find customers who placed orders in USD with a total amount exceeding 500.00 using a promotion code, showing the customer ID, customer name, and count of such high-value promo orders, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS high_val_cnt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t2.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t2.ord_total_amt > 500.00 GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY high_val_cnt DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Compare web and app traffic by calculating the total count of web events for each channel and event type during November 2025, returning the channel code, event type, and event count, ordered by event count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, evt_type, COUNT(evt_id) AS ev_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd, evt_type ORDER BY ev_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC, evt_type ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID and name of customers who had web events in both web and app channels (channel_cd 'WEB' and 'APP') during November 2025, ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t2.cust_nm FROM web_event AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND t1.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND t1.cust_id IS NOT NULL AND t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t1.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00') GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t2.cust_nm ORDER BY t2.cust_nm ASC

items.question: For each segment code active in October 2026, find the average customer signup year (extracted or derived via date range counts, or simply average of signup year), showing the segment code and count of customers in that segment, ordered by customer count descending.
