items.sql: SELECT t2.segment_cd, COUNT(t1.cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY t2.segment_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC, t2.segment_cd ASC

items.question: Find the promotion name and the count of unique customers who used each promotion in their orders placed during 2026, ordered by unique customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.cust_id) AS unique_cust_cnt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t1.promo_id = t3.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t3.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_nm ORDER BY unique_cust_cnt DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: Calculate the monthly active customer count who had at least one web session event in each respective month from November 2025 to January 2026, showing the month and active customer count, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m-01') AS evt_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS active_cust_cnt FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-02-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY evt_month ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and total units moved out of warehouses for all products in the ELC category that have had any stock movements since 2025-10-01, ordered by total units descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH elc_moves AS (SELECT m.sku, SUM(-m.qty) AS total_out FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_catalog p ON m.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY m.sku) SELECT sku, total_out FROM elc_moves ORDER BY total_out DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the count of inventory items where the current on hand quantity is strictly less than the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS low_stock_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY low_stock_count DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and the count of primary products they supply for all suppliers who provide more than 1 primary product, ordered by primary product count descending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH primary_counts AS (SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, COUNT(*) AS primary_cnt FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm) SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, primary_cnt FROM primary_counts WHERE primary_cnt > 1 ORDER BY primary_cnt DESC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products supplied by supplier ID 1 whose lead days are greater than the average lead days of all products supplied by supplier ID 1, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH sup1_leads AS (SELECT ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps WHERE ps.sup_id = 1), avg_lead AS (SELECT AVG(lead_days) AS avg_d FROM sup1_leads) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN sup1_leads s ON p.sku = s.sku JOIN avg_lead a ON s.lead_days > a.avg_d ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total units currently on hand across all SKUs stored in each warehouse, ordered by total units descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name of the top 3 products with the highest list price within the HOM category, ordered by list price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: Show the supplier ID and the average lead days for each supplier, considering only products in the KIT category, ordered by average lead days descending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ps.sup_id, AVG(ps.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY ps.sup_id ORDER BY avg_lead_days DESC, ps.sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products where the list price is higher than the overall average list price of all products in the catalog, ordered by list price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH avg_price AS (SELECT AVG(list_prc) AS mean_prc FROM prod_catalog) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN avg_price a ON p.list_prc > a.mean_prc ORDER BY p.list_prc DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold inventory for more than 5 distinct SKUs, ordered by warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH wh_sku_counts AS (SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, COUNT(i.sku) AS sku_count FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm) SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM wh_sku_counts WHERE sku_count > 5 ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and total inventory quantity on hand for products that are marked as discontinued (disc_flag = 1), ordered by total quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.disc_flag = 1 GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the category code and the count of products in each category, ordered by category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide products in all four categories (ELC, HOM, KIT, OFC), ordered by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.categ_cd) = 4 ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and the number of distinct suppliers that provide each product, for products supplied by 2 or more suppliers, ordered by supplier count descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH sup_counts AS (SELECT ps.sku, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.sup_id) AS sup_count FROM prod_supplier ps GROUP BY ps.sku) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, s.sup_count FROM prod_catalog p JOIN sup_counts s ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE s.sup_count >= 2 ORDER BY s.sup_count DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total absolute quantity moved due to stock adjustments (mv_type = 'ADJ') since 2025-10-01, ordered by total adjusted quantity descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_adj_qty DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that have never appeared in any order line, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM ord_line) ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name of products that have a list price greater than 100.00 and are currently stocked in warehouse 'W1', ordered by list price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.list_prc > 100.00 AND i.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY p.list_prc DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the region code and the total number of warehouses located in that region, ordered by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS wh_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price of the single most expensive product in the product catalog.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 1;

items.question: Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and the maximum lead days among all products supplied by each supplier, ordered by maximum lead days descending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, MAX(ps.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC, s.sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and total quantity ordered across all order lines for products where the total ordered quantity exceeds 10 units, ordered by total ordered quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH ord_qtys AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, total_qty FROM ord_qtys WHERE total_qty > 10 ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and the difference between list price and the average list price of its category, for all products where list price is above its category average, ordered by price difference descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH cat_avg AS (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, (p.list_prc - c.avg_prc) AS price_diff FROM prod_catalog p JOIN cat_avg c ON p.categ_cd = c.categ_cd WHERE p.list_prc > c.avg_prc ORDER BY price_diff DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the ratio of SKUs below their reorder point to total SKUs held in that warehouse, ordered by the ratio descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH wh_stats AS (SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS total_skus, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_skus FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, (low_skus * 1.0 / total_skus) AS low_ratio FROM wh_stats ORDER BY low_ratio DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who supply at least one product in the 'ELC' category and whose average lead days across all supplied products is less than 30, ordered by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH elc_suppliers AS (SELECT DISTINCT ps.sup_id FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC'), avg_leads AS (SELECT ps.sup_id, AVG(ps.lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier ps GROUP BY ps.sup_id) SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN elc_suppliers e ON s.sup_id = e.sup_id JOIN avg_leads a ON s.sup_id = a.sup_id WHERE a.avg_lead < 30 ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name of products that have both an 'IN' stock movement and an 'OUT' stock movement recorded in the movement table, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN') AND p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Which products in the electronics category have never been ordered via the web channel? Give me the SKU and product name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line AS t2 JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku AND t3.channel_cd = 'WEB')

items.question: Can you list the SKUs and names of products that were ordered both in an app order and in a phone order?
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.channel_cd = 'APP' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line AS t4 JOIN ord_hdr AS t5 ON t4.ord_id = t5.ord_id WHERE t4.sku = t1.sku AND t5.channel_cd = 'PHN')

items.question: Show me the customer ID and customer name for clients who placed orders in both the NA region and the EU region.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN warehouse AS t3 ON t2.channel_cd = 'STR' WHERE t1.region_cd = 'NA' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr AS t4 WHERE t4.cust_id = t1.cust_id AND t1.region_cd = 'NA')

items.question: List the customer ID and name for platinum tier customers who have never requested a refund.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr AS t2 JOIN refund_req AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id)

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for items that appear in order lines with a zero discount percentage but have never been sold with any discount.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.disc_pct = 0.00 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.disc_pct > 0.00)

items.question: Show the product SKU and name for items that have been ordered in the kitchen category and also appear in warehouse inventory with an on-hand quantity greater than 300.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND t2.on_hand_qty > 300 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku)

items.question: Which customers have placed orders totaling over 500 USD using either the credit card payment method or PayPal? Return the customer ID and name.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN payment AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND t3.method_cd IN ('CC', 'PP')

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items supplied by supplier ID 1 that are not present in any warehouse with a reorder point above 250.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.sup_id = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.reorder_pt > 250)

items.question: Retrieve the customer ID and name of customers who had a support ticket in the billing category and also placed an order in the store channel.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN support_tkt AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'BILL' AND t3.channel_cd = 'STR'

items.question: Find the SKU and name of home category products that were moved via stock adjustment ('ADJ') but never moved via restock ('IN').
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND t2.mv_type = 'ADJ' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.mv_type = 'IN')

items.question: Show the customer ID and name for standard tier customers from the Latin America (LA) region who signed up after July 1st, 2022.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'S' AND region_cd = 'LA' AND signup_dt > '2022-07-01'

items.question: List the order ID and total amount for orders placed in currencies other than USD that have an amount greater than 200.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd != 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 200.00

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for items whose list price is strictly between 50 and 100 dollars in the office category.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC' AND list_prc BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00

items.question: What are the warehouse ID and warehouse name for facilities located in regions other than North America (NA)?
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd != 'NA'

items.question: Show the SKU and list price for discontinued products in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1

items.question: List the refund request ID and requested amount for requests with a pending status.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P'

items.question: Give me the employee ID and full name of employees working in the finance (FIN) department.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN'

items.question: Find the promotion ID and promotion name for promotions that offer a discount percentage of 20 or more.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct >= 20.00

items.question: Show the customer ID and contact email address for active customers in the Asia Pacific region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, email_addr FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1

items.question: Retrieve the support ticket ID and severity level for open tickets where the closed timestamp is null and the severity is high (2).
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL AND sev_lvl = 2

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, and loyalty tier for all gold tier customers ordered alphabetically by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for the top 5 most expensive products in the product catalog, ordered from highest price to lowest price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: Find the order ID, order date, and total amount for orders placed in April 2026, sorted by order date descending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the SKU, product name, and category code for all products except those in the electronics category, sorted by category code and product name.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd != 'ELC' ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, prod_nm ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for those who placed an order in the web channel on 2026-04-03 and also raised a support ticket on that same day, sorted by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN support_tkt AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' AND DATE(t3.opened_ts) = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who have placed orders through the app channel but have never requested a refund, ordered by customer name alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'APP' AND t1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT t3.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS t3 JOIN refund_req AS t4 ON t3.ord_id = t4.ord_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Which customer IDs and names placed orders in both the web channel and the app channel? Return customer id and name ordered by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t1.cust_id IN (SELECT t3.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS t3 WHERE t3.channel_cd = 'APP') ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Give me the employee id and employee name of support department employees who have never been assigned a critical severity (1) support ticket, sorted by employee name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 WHERE t1.dept_cd = 'SUP' AND t1.emp_id NOT IN (SELECT t2.assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt AS t2 WHERE t2.sev_lvl = 1 AND t2.assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t1.emp_nm ASC

items.question: List the customer id and name of customers who either opened a support ticket categorized as billing (BILL) or placed an order totaling over 500.00, sorted by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 LEFT JOIN support_tkt AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id AND t2.categ_cd = 'BILL' LEFT JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id AND t3.ord_total_amt > 500.00 WHERE t2.tkt_id IS NOT NULL OR t3.ord_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Return the SKU and product name for items that appear in both order line items for orders placed in USD and order line items for orders placed in EUR, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t3.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t1.sku IN (SELECT t4.sku FROM ord_line AS t4 JOIN ord_hdr AS t5 ON t4.ord_id = t5.ord_id WHERE t5.currency_cd = 'EUR') ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of items that have been ordered at least once but have never had any stock movement recorded as adjustment (ADJ), sorted by product name.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sku NOT IN (SELECT t3.sku FROM inv_move AS t3 WHERE t3.mv_type = 'ADJ') ORDER BY t2.prod_nm ASC

items.question: List the employee id and full name of employees who have approved at least one refund request where the reason code was damaged (DMG), ordered by employee id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 JOIN refund_req AS t2 ON t1.emp_id = t2.approver_emp_id WHERE t2.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND t2.status_cd = 'A' ORDER BY t1.emp_id ASC

items.question: Show the support ticket category code and the count of tickets for each category where the severity level is 2 or higher, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl <= 2 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY tkt_count DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: What is the total refund amount requested for each reason code where the refund request status is pending (P)? Show the reason code and total amount, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_rfd FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY total_rfd DESC, reason_cd ASC

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of support tickets opened through each channel since 2026-04-01, ordered by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer id, customer name, and signup date for all active platinum tier customers in the North America (NA) sales region, sorted by signup date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1 ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the SKU, product name, and list price for all electronic (ELC) category products that are not discontinued, sorted by list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the employee id, full name, and hire date for employees hired in the finance (FIN) department, ordered by hire date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, hire_dt FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN' ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_id ASC

items.question: List the warehouse id, warehouse name, and region code for all warehouses serving the Asia Pacific (AP) region, ordered by warehouse name alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Display the refund request id, order id, and requested amount for all refund requests with a status of approved (A), ordered by request date descending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' ORDER BY req_dt DESC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: Give me the promotion ID, promotion code, and promotion name for active percentage-based promotions starting on or after 2025-11-01, sorted by start date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY starts_dt ASC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Find the order id, order date, and total amount for orders placed in the store (STR) channel with a status of delivered (D), ordered by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR' AND ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the supplier id, supplier name, and country for suppliers located in the United States (US) or Canada (CA), ordered by supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country IN ('US', 'CA') ORDER BY sup_nm ASC, sup_id ASC

items.question: List the ticket id, customer id, and severity level for support tickets categorized as shipping (SHIP) that have a severity level of 3, ordered by opened timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'SHIP' AND sev_lvl = 3 ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC

items.question: Combine the list of customer names who placed orders on 2026-04-03 and customer names who opened support tickets on that same day into a single distinct list, ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t2.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' UNION SELECT DISTINCT t4.cust_nm FROM support_tkt AS t3 JOIN cust_master AS t4 ON t3.cust_id = t4.cust_id WHERE DATE(t3.opened_ts) = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC

items.question: Find the employee id and name of employees who have either been direct managers of someone or have approved at least one refund request, sorted by employee id.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 WHERE t1.emp_id IN (SELECT t2.mgr_emp_id FROM emp AS t2 WHERE t2.mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL) UNION SELECT DISTINCT t3.emp_id, t3.emp_nm FROM emp AS t3 JOIN refund_req AS t4 ON t3.emp_id = t4.approver_emp_id ORDER BY emp_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and name for customers who are in the loyalty tier gold (G) and have placed at least two orders total, ordered by customer id.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'G' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) >= 2 ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that have a stock inventory on hand quantity less than or equal to their reorder point in any warehouse, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.on_hand_qty <= t1.reorder_pt ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse name and region code for all warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse ORDER BY wh_nm ASC, region_cd ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and on-hand quantity for items where the current stock is at or below the reorder point in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: What are the distinct carrier codes used in shipments from the Newark Hub warehouse?
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.carrier_cd FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' ORDER BY s.carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: Find all payment IDs and amounts where the payment method was credit card and the status was settled on or after 2025-11-01.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC;

items.question: Show the shipment ID and shipment date for orders shipped by DHL or FDX from warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND carrier_cd IN ('DHL', 'FDX') ORDER BY ship_dt DESC, ship_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and total movement quantity for stock adjustments (ADJ) recorded in inventory movements.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_adj_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for orders placed via the WEB channel in USD currency during January 2026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse name, count how many shipments have a delivery date recorded.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, COUNT(s.ship_id) AS delivered_shipments_count FROM warehouse w JOIN shipment s ON w.wh_id = s.wh_id WHERE s.deliv_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.wh_nm ORDER BY delivered_shipments_count DESC, w.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: Find products from the electronics category (ELC) that have an inventory record in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND i.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items that have had both an IN restock movement and an OUT customer shipment movement.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inv_move m1 ON p.sku = m1.sku AND m1.mv_type = 'IN' JOIN inv_move m2 ON p.sku = m2.sku AND m2.mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the payment method code and the total settled payment amount for each method, considering only settled payments.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY total_settled_amt DESC, method_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the order ID and order date for orders that were shipped from warehouse W1 but never had any payment attempt recorded.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr o JOIN shipment s ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id WHERE s.wh_id = 'W1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.ord_id = o.ord_id) ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC, o.ord_id ASC;

items.question: For each carrier code, list the carrier code and the number of shipments delivered in transit state 'D'.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS delivered_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY delivered_count DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name of items that appear in the inventory of warehouse W1 but do NOT appear in the inventory of warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i1 ON p.sku = i1.sku WHERE i1.wh_id = 'W1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.sku = p.sku AND i2.wh_id = 'W2') ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Find SKUs that have inventory stock recorded in both warehouse W1 and warehouse W2, showing the SKU and the sum of their on-hand quantities across both warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS combined_on_hand FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.wh_id IN ('W1', 'W2') AND p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1') AND p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2') GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY combined_on_hand DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: List the order ID, order total amount, and total payment amount for orders where the total sum of settled payment attempts is strictly less than the order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt, COALESCE(SUM(p.pay_amt), 0) AS total_paid FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN payment p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id AND p.pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt HAVING total_paid < o.ord_total_amt ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC, o.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find products that have both an inventory movement type 'IN' and an inventory movement type 'ADJ', returning their SKU and product name.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move m1 WHERE m1.sku = p.sku AND m1.mv_type = 'IN') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move m2 WHERE m2.sku = p.sku AND m2.mv_type = 'ADJ') ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for items that have received stock movements (IN) in warehouse W1 but have never been part of any shipment from warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inv_move m ON p.sku = m.sku WHERE m.wh_id = 'W1' AND m.mv_type = 'IN' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment s JOIN ord_line ol ON s.ord_id = ol.ord_id WHERE s.wh_id = 'W1' AND ol.sku = p.sku) ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: List warehouse IDs and the count of unique SKUs that currently have an on-hand quantity greater than their reorder point in that warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS healthy_stock_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY healthy_stock_count DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Find orders that have multiple distinct payment methods attempted, returning the order ID and the count of unique payment methods used.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(DISTINCT method_cd) AS method_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING method_count > 1 ORDER BY method_count DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products whose list price is greater than the average list price of all products in their respective category.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p.categ_cd) ORDER BY p.list_prc DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Identify SKUs that appear as inventory in warehouse W3 and also have inventory movements of type 'OUT', returning the SKU and warehouse ID W3.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.sku, i.wh_id FROM inventory i JOIN inv_move m ON i.sku = m.sku AND i.wh_id = m.wh_id WHERE i.wh_id = 'W3' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY i.sku ASC;

items.question: List the order ID, shipment ID, and carrier code for shipments where the shipment date is later than or equal to 2026-04-01 and the associated order was placed via the APP channel.
items.sql: SELECT s.ord_id, s.ship_id, s.carrier_cd FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON s.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE s.ship_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY s.ship_dt ASC, s.ship_id ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse, calculate the total absolute quantity moved across all inventory movement types, showing the warehouse ID and total absolute movement quantity.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_abs_moved FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_abs_moved DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for those who have a Platinum loyalty tier and are located in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: List the promotion id and promotion name for all promotions that have a discount percentage greater than 15.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the session id and customer id for all web events that occurred through the mobile app channel on 2025-11-09.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-09'

items.question: Display the customer id and month date for customers whose segment code was VIP during July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt = '2026-07-01'

items.question: Show the order id and order total amount for orders placed using the web sales channel in USD currency with a total amount over 500.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for active customers who signed up in the first half of 2022 (up to 2022-07-01) and belong to the Europe region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'EU' AND signup_dt <= '2022-07-01' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the promotion id and promotion name for promotions that were actually applied to at least one order.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_id, p.promo_nm FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who had a web event of type PURCHASE during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN web_event we ON cm.cust_id = we.cust_id WHERE we.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND we.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND we.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who were classified in the RISK segment in September 2026 and also in the VIP segment in October 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN cust_segment_hist csh1 ON cm.cust_id = csh1.cust_id AND csh1.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND csh1.segment_cd = 'RISK' JOIN cust_segment_hist csh2 ON cm.cust_id = csh2.cust_id AND csh2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND csh2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who placed an order using promotion id 1 AND also placed an order using promotion id 3.
items.sql: SELECT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN ord_promo op ON oh.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE oh.cust_id = cm.cust_id AND op.promo_id = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN ord_promo op ON oh.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE oh.cust_id = cm.cust_id AND op.promo_id = 3) ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who have signed up by 2022-07-07 and placed an order in 2026, but have never used any promotion on any order.
items.sql: SELECT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm WHERE cm.signup_dt <= '2022-07-07' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr oh WHERE oh.cust_id = cm.cust_id AND oh.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr oh JOIN ord_promo op ON oh.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE oh.cust_id = cm.cust_id) ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who had either a web event of type CHECKOUT or a web event in the APP channel during November 2025, but not both.
items.sql: SELECT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm WHERE cm.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' UNION SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00') AND cm.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' INTERSECT SELECT cust_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00') ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who were in the REG segment in June 2026 and placed at least one order in the same month.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN cust_segment_hist csh ON cm.cust_id = csh.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr oh ON cm.cust_id = oh.cust_id WHERE csh.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND csh.segment_cd = 'REG' AND oh.ord_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND oh.ord_dt < '2026-07-01' ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who registered in the Asia Pacific region and have placed orders with status Delivered.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN ord_hdr oh ON cm.cust_id = oh.cust_id WHERE cm.region_cd = 'AP' AND oh.ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the promotion id and promotion name for promotions that start on or after 2026-01-01 and have a discount percentage of exactly 20.00.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND disc_pct = 20.00 ORDER BY starts_dt ASC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the session id and customer id for browsing sessions where the event type was VIEW and the channel was WEB.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY session_id ASC

items.question: Display the customer id and customer name for customers who have a gold loyalty tier and belong to the Latin America region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' AND region_cd = 'LA' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who were in segment NEW in October 2026 and have never placed an order.
items.sql: SELECT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN cust_segment_hist csh ON cm.cust_id = csh.cust_id WHERE csh.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND csh.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr oh WHERE oh.cust_id = cm.cust_id) ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who placed orders using the phone channel and have an active status of 1.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN ord_hdr oh ON cm.cust_id = oh.cust_id WHERE cm.is_actv = 1 AND oh.channel_cd = 'PHN' ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who placed an order with total amount greater than 300 using promotion id 4.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN ord_hdr oh ON cm.cust_id = oh.cust_id JOIN ord_promo op ON oh.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE oh.ord_total_amt > 300.00 AND op.promo_id = 4 ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who have logged web events of type CART and also web events of type PURCHASE.
items.sql: SELECT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event we WHERE we.cust_id = cm.cust_id AND we.evt_type = 'CART') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event we WHERE we.cust_id = cm.cust_id AND we.evt_type = 'PURCHASE') ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who are in the Europe region and have placed at least one order in EUR currency.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm JOIN ord_hdr oh ON cm.cust_id = oh.cust_id WHERE cm.region_cd = 'EU' AND oh.currency_cd = 'EUR' ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who have active status (1), belong to the Platinum tier, and signed up before 2022-07-05.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'P' AND signup_dt < '2022-07-05' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who had web events in both the WEB channel and the APP channel across all time.
items.sql: SELECT cm.cust_id, cm.cust_nm FROM cust_master cm WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event we WHERE we.cust_id = cm.cust_id AND we.channel_cd = 'WEB') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event we WHERE we.cust_id = cm.cust_id AND we.channel_cd = 'APP') ORDER BY cm.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU and product name for all items supplied by Cedar Paper Mills (sup_id 3).
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 3 ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and list price of every electronics (ELC) product in the catalog.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for all warehouses located in the North America region (NA).
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and current on-hand quantity for products stored in the Newark Hub warehouse (W1).
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Display the SKU and product name for items that have their discontinued flag set to 1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and lead days for all supply records where the lead time is greater than 30 days.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30 ORDER BY lead_days DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the movement ID, SKU, and moved quantity for all stock adjustments (ADJ) recorded in inventory movements.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY mv_id ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers based in the United States (US).
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and average order unit price for products that have appeared in any order line with a quantity greater than 2.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, AVG(T1.unit_prc) FROM ord_line AS T1 WHERE T1.qty > 2 GROUP BY T1.sku ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and total stock movement quantity for each SKU that had an outgoing movement type (OUT) in the movement history.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and warehouse ID for inventory items where the on-hand quantity is strictly below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and total count of inventory items held in each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(sku) FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID and count of primary products supplied by each supplier where they are designated as the primary supplier (is_primary = 1).
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for items that are supplied by both supplier 1 and supplier 6.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 1 AND T1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 6) ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items supplied by supplier 1 but never supplied by supplier 2.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 1 AND T1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 2) ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that are stocked in both warehouse W1 and warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2') ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for items that appear in warehouse W1 but are not stocked in warehouse W3.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W3') ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that have a list price over 50.00 and have at least one stock movement recorded as 'IN'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN inv_move AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.list_prc > 50.00 AND T2.mv_type = 'IN' ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide at least one product in the electronics category (ELC).
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T1.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY T1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold inventory for any discontinued product (disc_flag = 1).
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.wh_id, T2.wh_nm FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T1.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY T1.wh_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that are supplied by suppliers in country 'US' combined using union with products having a list price above 100.00.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T1.sup_id = T3.sup_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T3.country = 'US' UNION SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 100.00 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for items whose lead time with any supplier is greater than 35 days and whose on-hand quantity in warehouse W1 is greater than 200.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku INNER JOIN inventory AS T3 ON T1.sku = T3.sku WHERE T1.lead_days > 35 AND T3.wh_id = 'W1' AND T3.on_hand_qty > 200 ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that have experienced an inventory movement of type 'OUT' and belong to category 'KIT'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN inv_move AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND T2.mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID, supplier name, and count of products they supply, restricted to suppliers who provide more than 1 product.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm, COUNT(T1.sku) FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(T1.sku) > 1 ORDER BY T1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer name and signup date for customers in the AP region who signed up before 2022-08-01, ordered alphabetically by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND signup_dt < '2022-08-01' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: List the product name and list price for all active products in the ELC category whose list price is above 100.00, sorted descending by list price.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0 AND list_prc > 100.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: What are the order id and order total amount for orders placed through the WEB channel in EUR currency with an amount greater than 500.00?
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'EUR' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the SKU, product name, and list price of products in the KIT category that have a list price lower than the overall average list price of all products in the KIT category.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND t1.list_prc < (SELECT AVG(t2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'KIT') ORDER BY t1.list_prc DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Retrieve the customer name and tier code for customers in the NA region who have placed at least one order with an order total amount exceeding 800.00.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm, c.tier_cd FROM cust_master AS c JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' AND o.ord_total_amt > 800.00 ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC, c.cust_id ASC

items.question: For each currency code, show the currency code and the maximum USD rate available across all effective dates in the fx_rate table, sorted by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, MAX(rate_to_usd) AS max_rate FROM fx_rate GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC

items.question: List the SKU and average unit price (across all order lines) for products where the average unit price is greater than 200.00, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_price FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING AVG(unit_prc) > 200.00 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Find the order id, order date, and order total amount for orders whose total amount is strictly greater than the average order total amount of all orders placed on the exact same date.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.ord_dt = t1.ord_dt) ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_total_amt DESC

items.question: Show the customer name and signup date for customers who have never placed an order, ordered by signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: List the product name and list price for products in the HOM category whose list price is higher than the maximum list price of any product in the KIT category.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND list_prc > (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT') ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who have placed orders in both EUR and USD currencies.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.currency_cd IN ('EUR', 'USD') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.currency_cd) = 2 ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC

items.question: For each order status, report the status code, the number of orders, and the average order total amount for orders placed in 2026 (from 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31), sorted by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) AS ord_count, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_count DESC, ord_status ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price of the single most expensive product in the ELC category.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: List the order id and order total amount for orders where the order total amount exceeds the average order total amount of all orders placed by the same customer.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC, t1.ord_total_amt DESC

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that have never appeared in any order line.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM ord_line) ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Retrieve the customer name, tier code, and signup date for customers in the EU region whose tier is Platinum ('P') and who signed up after 2022-06-01, ordered by signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, tier_cd, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' AND tier_cd = 'P' AND signup_dt > '2022-06-01' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: For each month in the customer segment history for the year 2025, show the segment code and the count of unique customers assigned to the 'VIP' segment, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS vip_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month_dt ORDER BY month_dt ASC

items.question: Find the order id, line number, SKU, and unit price for order lines whose unit price is higher than the average unit price of all lines belonging to the same order.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.line_no, t1.sku, t1.unit_prc FROM ord_line AS t1 WHERE t1.unit_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.unit_prc) FROM ord_line AS t2 WHERE t2.ord_id = t1.ord_id) ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC, t1.line_no ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products whose list price is greater than 50.00 and whose category code is either 'OFC' or 'KIT', ordered by category and price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 50.00 AND categ_cd IN ('OFC', 'KIT') ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who have placed orders on every single channel ('WEB', 'APP', 'STR', 'PHN').
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP', 'STR', 'PHN') GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.channel_cd) = 4 ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC

items.question: Find the order id, customer id, and order total amount for the single order with the highest total amount among all orders placed in the 'LA' sales region.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.cust_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS o JOIN cust_master AS c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'LA' ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC, o.ord_id ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: Retrieve the SKU and product name for products that belong to the product category with the highest average list price across all categories.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = (SELECT categ_cd FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY AVG(list_prc) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: For each sales channel, show the channel code, total count of orders, and average order total amount for orders placed in July 2026 (from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31), ordered by total order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: List the order id, order date, and order total amount for orders placed by customers in the 'AP' region whose order total amount is strictly greater than the average order total amount of all orders placed by customers in the 'AP' region.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS o JOIN cust_master AS c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'AP' AND o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS o2 JOIN cust_master AS c2 ON o2.cust_id = c2.cust_id WHERE c2.region_cd = 'AP') ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC, o.ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the employee name and hire date for staff hired before their direct manager.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_nm, t1.hire_dt FROM emp AS t1 JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.hire_dt < t2.hire_dt ORDER BY t1.emp_id ASC;

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for clients who placed an order with a total amount greater than the average order total of all orders.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the ticket ID and opened timestamp for support tickets that have never had a reply event logged.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE tkt_id NOT IN (SELECT tkt_id FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'REPLY') ORDER BY tkt_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and list price for products whose list price is above the average list price of their product category.
items.sql: SELECT p1.sku, p1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS p1 WHERE p1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p1.categ_cd) ORDER BY p1.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who have signed up but have zero orders placed in the ord_hdr table.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: Find the order ID and order total amount for orders whose total amount is the highest among all orders placed by the same customer.
items.sql: SELECT o1.ord_id, o1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS o1 WHERE o1.ord_total_amt = (SELECT MAX(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = o1.cust_id) ORDER BY o1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the employee ID and employee name for staff members who approved a refund request with an amount strictly greater than 500.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp AS e JOIN refund_req AS r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.rfd_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY e.emp_id ASC;

items.question: List the ticket ID, category code, and opened timestamp for the most recent support ticket opened by each customer.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tkt_id, t1.categ_cd, t1.opened_ts FROM support_tkt AS t1 WHERE t1.opened_ts = (SELECT MAX(t2.opened_ts) FROM support_tkt AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that are present in the inventory table with an on hand quantity lower than their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS p JOIN inventory AS i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: List the employee ID and employee name for employees who have never been assigned any support ticket.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id ASC;

items.question: Show the order ID and order date for orders that have multiple payment attempt records associated with them.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr AS o JOIN payment AS p ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id GROUP BY o.ord_id, o.ord_dt HAVING COUNT(p.pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY o.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find the refund request ID and refund amount for refund requests where the requested amount exceeds the average refund amount for the same reason code.
items.sql: SELECT r1.rfd_id, r1.rfd_amt FROM refund_req AS r1 WHERE r1.rfd_amt > (SELECT AVG(r2.rfd_amt) FROM refund_req AS r2 WHERE r2.reason_cd = r1.reason_cd) ORDER BY r1.rfd_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who have placed orders across more than one sales channel.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.channel_cd) > 1 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that have an entry in the prod_supplier table with a lead time greater than the average lead time of all products supplied by the same supplier.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS p JOIN prod_supplier AS ps ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE ps.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(ps2.lead_days) FROM prod_supplier AS ps2 WHERE ps2.sup_id = ps.sup_id) ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for orders that do not have any corresponding shipment records.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id NOT IN (SELECT ord_id FROM shipment) ORDER BY ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find the employee ID and employee name for employees who have decided on refund requests where the decision date was on or after '2025-12-01'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp AS e JOIN refund_req AS r ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE r.decided_dt >= '2025-12-01' ORDER BY e.emp_id ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold inventory for every SKU present in the product catalog.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT p.sku FROM prod_catalog AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT i.sku FROM inventory AS i WHERE i.wh_id = w.wh_id AND i.sku = p.sku)) ORDER BY w.wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who have raised support tickets with a severity level of 1.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c JOIN support_tkt AS s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.sev_lvl = 1 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Find the order ID and order total amount for orders whose total amount is greater than the order total amount of the immediately preceding order placed by the same customer based on order date.
items.sql: SELECT o1.ord_id, o1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS o1 WHERE o1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT o2.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = o1.cust_id AND o2.ord_dt < o1.ord_dt ORDER BY o2.ord_dt DESC, o2.ord_id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY o1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that have never been ordered in any order line.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM ord_line) ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Show the ticket ID and opened timestamp for support tickets that have more tkt_event records than the average number of events per ticket across all tickets.
items.sql: SELECT t.tkt_id, t.opened_ts FROM support_tkt AS t JOIN tkt_event AS e ON t.tkt_id = e.tkt_id GROUP BY t.tkt_id, t.opened_ts HAVING COUNT(e.evt_id) > (SELECT COUNT(evt_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT tkt_id) FROM tkt_event) ORDER BY t.tkt_id ASC;

items.question: Find the promotion ID and promotion name for promotions that have been applied to orders with an order total amount greater than 500.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_id, p.promo_nm FROM promo AS p JOIN ord_promo AS op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC;

items.question: List the employee ID and employee name for staff whose salary amount is higher than the average salary of their respective department.
items.sql: SELECT e1.emp_id, e1.emp_nm FROM emp AS e1 WHERE e1.salary_amt > (SELECT AVG(e2.salary_amt) FROM emp AS e2 WHERE e2.dept_cd = e1.dept_cd) ORDER BY e1.emp_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who have opened support tickets assigned to employee ID 'E-007'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c JOIN support_tkt AS s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.assigned_emp_id = 'E-007' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and on-hand quantity for any inventory item in warehouse W1 where the stock level is below the average on_hand_qty across all items in that same warehouse, sorted by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT i1.sku, i1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i1 WHERE i1.wh_id = 'W1' AND i1.on_hand_qty < (SELECT AVG(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = i1.wh_id) ORDER BY i1.sku ASC;

items.question: List every payment ID and its payment amount for orders where the payment amount is strictly greater than the average payment amount attempted for that specific order ID, ordered by payment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p1.pay_id, p1.pay_amt FROM payment p1 WHERE p1.pay_amt > (SELECT AVG(p2.pay_amt) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.ord_id = p1.ord_id) ORDER BY p1.pay_id ASC;

items.question: Find products whose list price is higher than the average list price of all products within their respective category code, showing SKU, category code, and list price, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT p1.sku, p1.categ_cd, p1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p1 WHERE p1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p1.categ_cd) ORDER BY p1.sku ASC;

items.question: Identify the latest stock movement ID and its movement timestamp for each SKU in warehouse W2, showing the SKU and movement timestamp, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT m1.sku, m1.mv_ts FROM inv_move m1 WHERE m1.wh_id = 'W2' AND m1.mv_ts = (SELECT MAX(m2.mv_ts) FROM inv_move m2 WHERE m2.sku = m1.sku AND m2.wh_id = m1.wh_id) ORDER BY m1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find any inventory records in warehouse W3 whose on-hand quantity is less than or equal to their defined reorder point, showing the SKU and on_hand_qty, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W3' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: List the shipment ID and delivery date for all shipments assigned to carrier 'DHL' that were dispatched from warehouse W1, ordered by shipment ID.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY ship_id ASC;

items.question: Show all warehouse IDs and warehouse names located in the North America region code ('NA'), sorted by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: Display payment IDs and paid timestamps for payments made using the credit card payment method ('CC') with a payment amount exceeding 200, ordered by paid timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, paid_ts FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_amt > 200.00 ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC;

items.question: Find the maximum payment amount recorded for each payment currency code, showing the currency code and the highest amount, sorted by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, MAX(pay_amt) AS max_amt FROM payment GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC;

items.question: Count how many shipments were handled by each carrier code for shipments dispatched on or after 2026-01-01, showing the carrier code and count, ordered by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_cnt DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for all discontinued electronics products (category code 'ELC' and disc_flag equals 1), ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Find SKUs from the product catalog that have never had any stock movement recorded in the inv_move table, showing the SKU and product name, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move m WHERE m.sku = p.sku) ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Identify orders in the order header table that do not have any corresponding shipment records in the shipment table, showing the order ID and order date, sorted by order date.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment s WHERE s.ord_id = o.ord_id) ORDER BY o.ord_dt ASC, o.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find warehouses that hold inventory for SKU 'ELC-024' with an on-hand quantity greater than 300, showing the warehouse ID and on-hand quantity, sorted by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'ELC-024' AND on_hand_qty > 300 ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: List all order IDs and their total amounts for orders placed via the web channel ('WEB') with an order status of delivered ('D'), sorted by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the average list price for each product category code in the product catalog, displaying the category code and average price, sorted by category code.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Retrieve the shipment ID, order ID, and shipment date for all shipments managed by the carrier 'UPS' that are currently in transit ('I'), ordered by shipment date.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND ship_status = 'I' ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC;

items.question: Find inventory items in warehouse W4 whose on-hand quantity exceeds the maximum reorder point found across all items in warehouse W1, showing SKU and on_hand_qty, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W4' AND on_hand_qty > (SELECT MAX(reorder_pt) FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1') ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: List the movement ID, SKU, and quantity for stock movements of type 'ADJ' where the moved quantity is greater than 100 units, ordered by movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty > 100 ORDER BY mv_id ASC;

items.question: Show the total payment amount successfully settled for each payment currency, restricted to settled payments ('S'), displaying the currency code and sum of amounts, ordered by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_settled FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the highest list price among all products in the product catalog.
items.sql: SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog;

items.question: List the order ID, order date, and total amount for the single largest order placed in currency 'USD', ordered by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC LIMIT 1;

items.question: Identify products that appear in the inventory table for all available warehouses, showing the SKU, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT i.sku FROM inventory i GROUP BY i.sku HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.wh_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse) ORDER BY i.sku ASC;

items.question: Display the payment ID, payment amount, and paid timestamp for the earliest payment attempt recorded for each order ID, sorted by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT p1.pay_id, p1.pay_amt, p1.paid_ts FROM payment p1 WHERE p1.paid_ts = (SELECT MIN(p2.paid_ts) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.ord_id = p1.ord_id) ORDER BY p1.ord_id ASC, p1.pay_id ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for all promotions that have never been applied to any order.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, T1.promo_nm FROM promo AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo AS T2 WHERE T2.promo_id = T1.promo_id) ORDER BY T1.promo_id

items.question: List the customer name and signup date for customers who signed up in 2022 and are currently active.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id

items.question: Show the promotion name and discount percentage for promotions that start on or after 2026-01-01 and have a discount greater than 15 percent.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_py AS disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm

items.question: What are the session id and event timestamp for web events of type PURCHASE that occurred on channel APP?
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, session_id

items.question: Show the customer id and segment code for customers whose segment code in July 2026 was VIP.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY cust_id

items.question: Retrieve the order id and order total amount for orders placed through the WEB channel in USD currency that exceed 500.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id

items.question: Show the promotion name and discount percentage for promotions whose discount percentage is strictly greater than the average discount percentage of all promotions.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > (SELECT AVG(disc_pct) FROM promo) ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm

items.question: List the customer name and loyalty tier for active customers located in the North America region who placed at least one order with a total amount exceeding 800.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_nm, T1.tier_cd FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.is_actv = 1 AND T1.region_cd = 'NA' AND T2.ord_total_amt > 800.00 ORDER BY T1.cust_nm

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of unique orders that used each promotion, ordered by the count descending then promotion code.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id GROUP BY T1.promo_id, T1.promo_cd ORDER BY COUNT(T2.ord_id) DESC, T1.promo_cd

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for customers who have never placed any order.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_hdr.cust_id = cust_master.cust_id) ORDER BY cust_id

items.question: Find the session id and customer id for browsing sessions that had a VIEW event on product ELC-025 followed by a PURCHASE event in the same session.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.session_id, T1.cust_id FROM web_event AS T1 JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.session_id = T2.session_id WHERE T1.sku = 'ELC-025' AND T1.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND T2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND T2.evt_ts > T1.evt_ts ORDER BY T1.session_id

items.question: Show the customer name and signup date for customers who were assigned to the REG segment in July 2026 and the RISK segment in August 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T3 ON T1.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'REG' AND T3.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND T3.segment_cd = 'RISK' ORDER BY T1.cust_id

items.question: List the customer name and loyalty tier for active customers whose total order value across all their orders is strictly greater than the average total order value of all customers who have placed orders.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.tier_cd FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, T1.tier_cd HAVING SUM(T2.ord_total_amt) > (SELECT AVG(cust_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) AS cust_total FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id) AS sub) ORDER BY T1.cust_nm

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who placed orders in every single quarter of the year 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT '2026-01-01' AS q_start, '2026-03-31' AS q_end UNION SELECT '2026-04-01', '2026-06-30' UNION SELECT '2026-07-01', '2026-09-30' UNION SELECT '2026-10-01', '2026-10-31') AS q WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr AS T2 WHERE T2.cust_id = T1.cust_id AND T2.ord_dt BETWEEN q.q_start AND q.q_end)) ORDER BY T1.cust_id

items.question: Show the promotion name and the number of distinct customers who used each promotion, considering only orders placed via the WEB channel.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.cust_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY T1.promo_id, T1.promo_nm ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T3.cust_id) DESC, T1.promo_nm

items.question: List the customer name and order date for customers whose order total amount was strictly higher than the average order total amount of all orders placed on that exact same order date.
