items.sql: SELECT T2.cust_nm, T1.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(T3.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS T3 WHERE T3.ord_dt = T1.ord_dt) ORDER BY T1.ord_dt, T2.cust_nm

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who had web events of type CHECKOUT during November 2025 but never completed a PURCHASE event via the web channel in the same month.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM web_event AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND T1.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T1.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event AS T3 WHERE T3.cust_id = T1.cust_id AND T3.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND T3.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T3.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T3.evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59') ORDER BY T1.cust_id

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for promotions that were applied to every order placed by customer C-1006.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, T1.promo_nm FROM promo AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr AS T2 WHERE T2.cust_id = 'C-1006' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo AS T3 WHERE T3.ord_id = T2.ord_id AND T3.promo_id = T1.promo_id)) ORDER BY T1.promo_id

items.question: List the customer name and segment code for customers whose segment changed from REG to VIP between June 2026 and July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T3.segment_cd FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T3 ON T1.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'REG' AND T3.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND T3.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY T1.cust_id

items.question: Find the session id and event timestamp of the very first web event for each session that started with a VIEW event.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event AS T1 WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND evt_ts = (SELECT MIN(T2.evt_ts) FROM web_event AS T2 WHERE T2.session_id = T1.session_id) ORDER BY evt_ts, session_id

items.question: Show the customer name and signup date for active customers who placed their very first order on the exact same day they signed up.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.is_actv = 1 AND T2.ord_dt = T1.signup_dt AND T2.ord_dt = (SELECT MIN(T3.ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr AS T3 WHERE T3.cust_id = T1.cust_id) ORDER BY T1.signup_dt, T1.cust_id

items.question: List the promotion name and discount percentage for promotions that have a discount percentage higher than every promotion starting in the year 2025.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > (SELECT MAX(disc_pct) FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND starts_dt <= '2025-12-31') ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who have placed orders across at least 3 different sales channels.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.channel_cd) >= 3 ORDER BY T1.cust_id

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders for promotions where the total order amount of all orders using that promotion exceeds 1000.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.promo_id, T1.promo_cd HAVING SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) > 1000.00 ORDER BY SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) DESC, T1.promo_cd

items.question: Show the product SKU and product name for all items supplied by 'Orion Electronics' that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T3.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics' AND T1.disc_flag = 0

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for facilities located in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: What is the SKU and stock level for products in warehouse W1 where the on-hand quantity is strictly below 300 units?
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty < 300

items.question: Give me the SKU, list price, and product name of electronics items where the list price is greater than 80 dollars.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 80.00

items.question: Find the product SKU and lead time in days for all supplier records associated with supplier ID 1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1

items.question: Show the movement ID, timestamp, and quantity for out-of-stock inventory movements that occurred at warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'OUT'

items.question: List the SKU and lead days for products where the supplier relationship is marked as the primary supplier.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and total on-hand inventory quantity summed across all items stored in each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id

items.question: List the supplier name and count of products they supply, ordered from highest count to lowest, breaking ties by supplier name alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY COUNT(T2.sku) DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: Which products have an inventory quantity on hand that is lower than their reorder point? Show the SKU, warehouse ID, on-hand quantity, and reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt

items.question: Show the product category code and the average list price for each category, restricting to categories where the average list price exceeds 50 dollars. Sort by average list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 50.00 ORDER BY AVG(list_prc) DESC

items.question: For each supplier, report their name and the maximum lead time among all products they provide. Sort by the maximum lead time descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, MAX(T2.lead_days) FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY MAX(T2.lead_days) DESC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items that have never appeared in any inventory movement records. Sort by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move AS T2 WHERE T2.sku = T1.sku) ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU, warehouse ID, and movement timestamp for the very latest movement record logged for each SKU and warehouse combination.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.wh_id, T1.mv_ts FROM inv_move AS T1 WHERE T1.mv_ts = (SELECT MAX(T2.mv_ts) FROM inv_move AS T2 WHERE T2.sku = T1.sku AND T2.wh_id = T1.wh_id)

items.question: Which products have a list price higher than the average list price of all products within their specific product category? Show the SKU, product name, category code, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.categ_cd, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE T1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(T2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS T2 WHERE T2.categ_cd = T1.categ_cd)

items.question: List the supplier name and product SKU for suppliers providing products where the lead days exceed the average lead days of all products supplied by that same supplier. Break ties by supplier name and SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T3.sup_nm, T1.sku FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T1.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T1.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(T2.lead_days) FROM prod_supplier AS T2 WHERE T2.sup_id = T1.sup_id) ORDER BY T3.sup_nm ASC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: Identify products whose current on-hand quantity in warehouse W1 is greater than the average on-hand quantity of that same product across all warehouses. Return the SKU and on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS T1 WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS T2 WHERE T2.sku = T1.sku)

items.question: Find products that are stocked in every single warehouse. Show the SKU and product name, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.wh_id) FROM inventory AS T2 WHERE T2.sku = T1.sku) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse) ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and SKU for inventory items whose on-hand quantity is strictly greater than the maximum reorder point found across any product in warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > (SELECT MAX(on_hand_qty) FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2')

items.question: List suppliers who supply at least one product whose list price is higher than 100 dollars, but do not supply any product in the kitchen category ('KIT'). Return the supplier ID and supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier AS T2 JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T2.sup_id = T1.sup_id AND T3.list_prc > 100.00) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier AS T4 JOIN prod_catalog AS T5 ON T4.sku = T5.sku WHERE T4.sup_id = T1.sup_id AND T5.categ_cd = 'KIT')

items.question: Find the SKU and warehouse ID for inventory records where the on-hand quantity exceeds the sum of absolute movement quantities for 'OUT' type movements on that product in that warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.wh_id FROM inventory AS T1 WHERE T1.on_hand_qty > COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(T2.qty)) FROM inv_move AS T2 WHERE T2.sku = T1.sku AND T2.wh_id = T1.wh_id AND T2.mv_type = 'OUT'), 0)

items.question: Which products have order line unit prices that are higher than the list price recorded for that product in the product catalog? Return the SKU, order ID, unit price, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.ord_id, T1.unit_prc, T2.list_prc FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.unit_prc > T2.list_prc

items.question: Identify warehouses that hold no inventory for any product from the office category ('OFC'). Return the warehouse ID and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS T2 JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T2.wh_id = T1.wh_id AND T3.categ_cd = 'OFC')

items.question: Find the SKU, warehouse ID, and maximum absolute movement quantity for any movement record whose quantity exceeds the average movement quantity of its movement type. Sort by SKU and warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.wh_id, ABS(T1.qty) FROM inv_move AS T1 WHERE ABS(T1.qty) > (SELECT AVG(ABS(T2.qty)) FROM inv_move AS T2 WHERE T2.mv_type = T1.mv_type) ORDER BY T1.sku ASC, T1.wh_id ASC
